t: 取消， 撤销； 删去
words.s: I had to cancel that order because we didn't have enough money to pay for it.
words.sz: 我们的钱不够，所以我只好把订单取消了。
words.d: To cancel means to decide that an event or a request will not happen.

t: 爆炸的； 极易引起争论的

words.s: I have numerous books on my bookshelf.
words.sz: 我有大量的书在我的书架上。
words.d: If something is numerous, there are many of those things.

t: 居支配地位， 占优势
分析； 分解； 解析
使泄气， 使灰心； 阻止， 劝阻
words.s: I didn't mean to discourage you.
words.sz: 我不想打擊你的。
words.d: To discourage is to make someone feel less excited about something.

words.s: The baby really resembles his father.
words.d: To resemble someone is to look like that person.

t: 遥远的； 偏僻的； 关系疏远的； 脱离的； 微乎其微的； 孤高的， 冷淡的； 遥控的
words.s: The TV remote control is under the couch.
words.sz: 电视遥控器在沙发下面。
words.d: A remote place is distant or far away.

words.s: A trip to America was equivalent to a two-year salary for her.
words.sz: 去美国旅行一次相当于她两年的工资。
words.d: A salary is how much money a person makes at his or her job.

words.s: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
words.sz: 環境污染正造成異常的天氣情況。

words.s: There's no need to pretend anymore.
words.sz: 已经不需要再伪装了。
words.d: To pretend means to make believe something is real.

words.s: The kettle is boiling.
words.sz: 茶壺沸了。
words.d: A kettle is a large metal pot used for boiling liquids or cooking food.

t: 失事；残骸；精神或身体已垮的人
words.s: You're going to wreck your eyesight if you play games all the time.
words.sz: 要是你老打游戏的话，你的视力会下降的。
words.d: To wreck something means to destroy or ruin it.

words.s: A drunk driver was responsible for the car accident.
words.sz: 喝醉的驾驶员对车祸有责任。

t: 计算； 估计； 计划
words.s: I calculated how much money I would need to buy the car.
words.d: To calculate is to find an answer using math.

t: 坚持的， 不屈不挠的； 持续不断的； 反复出现的
words.s: They made persistent attempts to get him to eat.
words.d: A persistent person does not give up and keeps on working.

words.s: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.
words.sz: 為了健康，我不再抽菸。
words.d: The sake of something is the reason for doing it.

t: 把…隐藏起来， 掩盖， 隐瞒
words.s: Tom couldn't conceal his disappointment.
words.sz: 汤姆不能掩饰他的失望。
words.d: To conceal something means to hide it.

t: 听众， 观众， 读者
words.s: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
words.sz: 大部分观众是年幼的儿童。
words.d: An audience is a group of people who gather to watch someone do something.

words.s: He wants to be a doctor in the future, but meanwhile, he works a regular job.
words.d: An action that happens meanwhile happens at the same time as another action.

words.s: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
words.sz: 得不到的东西就最想得到。
words.d: To possess something is to have it or own it.

t: 有能力的， 能胜任的
words.s: I've been told that you're a very competent person.
words.sz: 有人說你是個很有能力的人。
words.d: If someone is competent, they are able to think or act successfully.

t: 投资， 投资额； 投入
words.s: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
words.sz: 他們在這次的投資中得到百分之八的收益。

words.s: Switzerland is a neutral country.
words.sz: 瑞士是一个中立的国家。
words.d: If someone is neutral, then they do not help either of the two fighting sides.

t: 抓痕， 划痕； 抓， 搔， 刮
需要； 要求； 命令
words.s: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
words.sz: 老龄化的人口需要更多医疗保健支出。
words.d: To require something is to say that it is necessary.

t: 分析， 分析报告； 分解； 解析

words.s: Did you hear the click?
words.sz: 你聽到了點擊聲嗎？

words.s: It is very fashionable to wear a hat.
words.d: Something fashionable is what people like to wear and do now.

words.s: The thieves devised a plan to steal the diamonds.
words.d: To devise something means to come up with an idea or plan about it.

words.s: Her happiness was apparent from the smile on her face.
words.d: Apparent means clear or easy to see.

t: 新闻工作者， 新闻记者
words.s: You're an excellent journalist.
words.sz: 你是个优秀的记者。
words.d: A journalist is a person who writes news stories.

t: 暴露， 揭露； 曝光
调和， 使缓和； 【冶】使回火
words.s: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.
words.sz: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。
words.d: A temper is someone’s mood or a chance that they might get angry.

t: 从一边， 向一边； 在一边； 斜着， 侧身
words.s: Jim turned sideways in order to slow down and stop his snowboard.
words.d: If something moves sideways, then it moves to or from the side.

words.s: Everyone was welcome to attend the multicultural celebration.
words.d: When something is multicultural, it relates to many different cultures.

t: 实物， 物体； 目的， 目标； 对象， 客体； 宾语
words.s: Most Americans do not object to my calling them by their first names.
words.sz: 大多数美国人似乎不反对我直呼其名。
words.d: An object is a non-living thing that you can see or touch.

t: 谦逊的； 地位低下的； 简陋的
words.s: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.
words.sz: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。
words.d: People who are humble do not believe that they are better than other people.

words.s: We'll deal with this problem in Chapter 3.
words.sz: 我们在第三章讨论这个问题。
words.d: A chapter is a part of a book that usually has a number or a title.

t: 独立的， 自主的； 无偏见的； 不相关联的
words.s: He is independent of his parents.
words.sz: 他獨立於他的父母。
words.d: If something is independent, it is not controlled by something else.

words.s: We took a carriage ride in the park.
words.d: A carriage is a vehicle pulled by a horse.

words.s: They would have been killed if the car had gone over the cliff.
words.sz: 车子若是掉落悬崖他们早就没命了。
words.d: A cliff is a high and often flat wall of rock.

words.s: Many scientists believe that the universe is infinite.
words.d: If something is infinite, it has no limit or end.

t: 承认， 承认…为真； 承认失败； 允许， 让予； 让步， 认输
words.s: The student conceded that he had cheated on the test.
words.d: To concede is to admit against your wish that something is true.

t: 选举， 推选； 选择

words.s: Whether he comes or not, the result will be the same.
words.sz: 他来还是不来，结果是一样的。
words.d: A result happens because of something else.

words.s: They say that golf is very popular in Japan.
words.sz: 他们说高尔夫在日本很流行。
words.d: Golf is a sport with clubs and a small white ball.

words.s: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.
words.sz: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。

t: 性别偏见， 性别歧视
委任状；委员会；佣金，回扣；授权，委托
words.s: How much is the commission?
words.sz: 手续费是多少？
words.d: To commission someone is to pay that person to do some job.

t: 大字标题； 新闻提要
words.s: The headline on the front page was about the economy.
words.d: A headline is the title of a newspaper story.

t: 连接， 结合， 联系； 给…接通电话
words.s: Do you feel like you can't connect with other people?
words.sz: 您觉得您无法与他人交流吗？
words.d: To connect two things means to join them together.

t: 理性的， 理智的； 合理的
政策， 方针； 保险单
words.s: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
words.sz: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。
words.d: A policy is a rule.

t: 编辑的，主笔的，编者的；社论的，社论式的
重新开始， 继续， 恢复
摘要， 概要； 简历
words.s: I don't worry so much about my resume.
words.sz: 我對自己的履歷不那麼在意。
words.d: To resume something means to start it again after taking a break.

t: 重建， 改造； 复原

words.s: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.
words.sz: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。
words.d: A committee is a group of people who meet together to make decisions.

t: 艺术的， 艺术家的； 富有艺术性的， 精美的； 精彩的
words.s: He was raised in an artistic family.
words.sz: 他在艺术世家长大。

t: 工会， 联盟； 联合， 团结； 一致
words.s: The Cold War ended when the Soviet Union collapsed.
words.sz: 冷战以苏联解体结束。

t: 丰富的， 充足的； 大量的

words.s: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
words.sz: 当列车停止时，所有的乘客都想知道发生了什么。
words.d: To halt is to stop moving.

words.s: Computers have many different components, so they are complicated to build.
words.d: A component is a part of a larger machine.

t: 顾问； 会诊医师， 专科医生

words.s: Have you ever seen such a beautiful sunset?
words.sz: 你看過這麼美的夕陽嗎?

words.s: It's obvious why his stomach hurts.
words.sz: 他為什麼會胃痛的原因很明顯。
words.d: Obvious means clear or easy to see.

t: 说明， 图解， 例证
假扮，化装，伪装；掩盖，掩饰
用来伪装的东西； 伪装， 掩饰
words.s: Everyone knew that it was Dad in the Santa disguise.
words.d: A disguise is something you wear so people cannot tell who you are.

words.s: Please wrap it like a Christmas present.
words.sz: 請把它包裝得像一個聖誕禮物。
words.d: To wrap is to cover something on all sides.

t: 外科， 外科手术； 手术室
words.s: Cosmetic surgery is not covered by most insurance plans.
words.sz: 大部份的保險計劃不包含整容手術。
words.d: Surgery is medical treatment involving a doctor cutting into a body.

t: 心胸宽大的， 慷慨的； 自由的， 自由主义的
暴力引起的， 暴力的； 猛烈的， 剧烈的
words.s: The man was put into jail because he was violent.
words.d: A violent person or animal uses force to hurt others.

t: 调和， 协调， 和谐
words.s: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
words.sz: 我们必须学会与自然和谐共处。
words.d: Harmony is a feeling that everything is peaceful, balanced, and in agreement.

t: 解决， 解答； 决定， 决意
words.s: She resolved the problem with her children by giving them both a toy.
words.d: To resolve something means to find a solution.

t: 寒冷， 寒气； 风寒， 寒战
words.s: It's better to chill white wine before you serve it.
words.sz: 在你侍酒前最好先將白葡萄酒冷卻一下。
words.d: A chill is a feeling of cold.

t: 迎面遇到， 遭遇； 勇敢地面对， 正视； 使对质， 使当面对证
words.s: I confronted him as he left the meeting and told him I thought he was wrong.
words.d: When you confront someone, you meet them face to face to deal with a problem.

t: 在…中占首要地位；支配，统治，控制；耸立于，俯视
words.s: The loud man dominated the conversation.
words.d: To dominate someone or something is to control them.

t: 模仿， 仿效， 仿制
words.s: Parrots can imitate the human voice.
words.sz: 鸚鵡會模仿人的聲音。
words.d: To imitate someone or something is to act in the exact same way.

t: 忠诚的； 如实的； 尽职的
words.s: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
words.sz: 忠犬八公的雕像伫立在涩谷站前。

t: 复制， 再现； 繁殖， 生殖
words.s: The children tried to reproduce their house using toy blocks.
words.d: To reproduce is to make something exactly how someone else did it.

t: 协会； 制度， 习俗
words.s: Banks are vital institutions that businesses and people use every day.
words.d: An institution is an organization that works to help a city or group of people.

t: 垫，衬垫；便笺本；发射台，直升机起落场
words.s: Football players wear shoulder pads to keep them safe.
words.d: A pad is a thick piece of soft material used to protect or clean things.

t: 激怒， 刺激； 挑衅， 挑拨
雄心， 抱负； 野心； 期望得到的东西
words.s: Mary wanted to marry a man with ambition.
words.sz: 以前，玛丽想和一位有雄心壮志的男人结婚。
words.d: Ambition is the desire to succeed and to become the best at something.

t: 奖学金； 学问， 学识
words.s: Tom was able to go to college thanks to a scholarship.
words.sz: 因為一份獎學金，Tom得以上大學。
words.d: A scholarship is money given so someone can go to school.

t: 超过， 胜过， 超出
words.s: Don't exceed the speed limit.
words.sz: 不要超速。
words.d: To exceed is to be more than something.

words.s: Besides the piano, can you play any other instruments?
words.sz: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

t: 扩大， 扩展， 放大
words.s: The classrooms were enlarged over the summer to make room for more students.
words.d: To enlarge something means to make it bigger.

t: 工具， 器具， 用具
使生效， 履行， 实施
words.s: The school decided to implement a new teaching strategy.
words.d: To implement something means to ensure that what has been planned is done.

t: 输出， 出口； 输出品， 出口额
words.s: The United States exports many cereals and grains.
words.d: To export products means to sell them to other countries.

words.s: We are here in the name of Jesus Christ and King Charles.
words.sz: 我們這裡以耶穌基督和查理斯國王之名。

words.s: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
words.sz: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。

t: 非常恰当的， 适时的
words.s: I patted some lotion onto my face.
words.d: To pat something is to hit it softly with your hand.

t: 想象， 幻想； 想象的产物
words.s: He lives in a world of fantasy.
words.sz: 他住在一個奇幻世界裡。
words.d: A fantasy is a pleasant situation that people think about but is unlikely to happen.

t: 可见度， 能见度； 可见性， 明显性
words.s: The snow was reducing visibility.
words.sz: 大雪降低了能見度。

t: 邀请， 招待； 请柬； 吸引， 诱惑
words.s: She naturally accepted the invitation.
words.sz: 當然，她接受了邀請。

t: 用爪子抓， 用蹄扒； 翻找
words.s: The kitten cleaned its paws with its tongue.
words.d: A paw is an animal’s foot that has claws or soft pads.

words.s: My dog looks enormous next to yours.
words.d: Enormous people or things are very large.

words.s: If you breathe on a window, moisture from your breath collects on the glass.
words.d: Moisture is small drops of water in the air or on a surface.

t: 烘， 烤； 向…祝酒， 为…干杯
words.s: I always have coffee and toast for breakfast.
words.sz: 我的早餐總是咖啡和土司。

t: 使沮丧， 使灰心； 挫败， 使受挫折

words.s: Save it on the external hard drive.
words.sz: 把它保存在外接式硬碟。
words.d: When something is external, it is connected to an outer part.

words.s: The man stood aside and opened the door for me.
words.d: An action done aside is done toward the side of something or someplace.

t: 情况， 条件； 境遇， 境况； 经济情况
words.s: There were many circumstances behind their success, like hard work.
words.d: A circumstance is an event that makes a situation what it is.

t: 修订， 修改； 复习
words.s: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
words.sz: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。
words.d: To revise something means to change it, or update it to make it better.

t: 官方； 权力； 当权者， 行政管理机构； 权威， 专家
words.s: He gave me authority to fire them.
words.sz: 他授權給我解僱了他們。
words.d: An authority is someone who has the power to make decisions and enforce rules and laws.

t: 创造物， 产物； 生物， 动物， 家畜
words.s: Tom says that he's a creature of habit.
words.sz: 汤姆说他是习惯的产物。
words.d: A creature is an animal or person.

words.s: I don't wish to harm you.
words.sz: 我不想傷害你。
words.d: To cause harm is to hurt someone or damage something.

words.s: I told her not to let go of the rope, but she did.
words.sz: 我叫她不要松开绳子，但是她做了。

words.s: I don't mind lending you the money provided you pay it back within a month.
words.sz: 假如能一个月之内还上的话，我可以把钱借给你。

t: 仪器， 工具； 乐器
words.s: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?
words.sz: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？
words.d: An instrument is something designed to do a certain task like play music.

words.s: There is a good chance that gasoline prices will go up.
words.sz: 油价上涨的可能性很高。

t: 必不可少的， 必需的
words.s: Water is indispensable to life.
words.sz: 水是生命所不可缺少的。

t: 透镜， 镜片， 镜头
words.s: I'm looking for my contact lens.
words.sz: 我在找我的隱形眼鏡。

t: 智慧， 才智； 名言
致命的， 命运的； 重大的， 决定性的
words.s: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.
words.sz: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。
words.d: Something that is fatal results in someone’s death.

words.s: Tom had nowhere to return to.
words.sz: 汤姆无处可归。
words.d: Nowhere means no place or not existing.

words.s: Jealousy was the motive for the murder.
words.sz: 嫉妒是謀殺的動機。
words.d: Your motive is your reason for doing something.

t: 浪漫的； 多情的； 有浪漫色彩的， 传奇性的； 不切实际的， 空想的
words.s: He's a very romantic boyfriend who brings me flowers each night.
words.sz: 他是箇非常浪漫的男朋友，每晚都給我送花。
words.d: Romantic means related to or about love.

t: 作为…的动机； 激励， 激发
损坏，糟蹋；宠坏，溺爱；变质
words.s: I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
words.sz: 我不想把結局提前透露給你。
words.d: To spoil is to rot or to make bad.

words.s: The airline has excellent customer service.
words.d: An airline is a company that takes people to different places by plane.

words.s: In the past year, the number of people at work has multiplied by ten percent.
words.d: To multiply is to increase in number.

t: 脊， 山脊； 垄， 埂， 脊状突起
words.s: Is this the bus for Park Ridge?
words.sz: 這是去帕克里奇的巴士？
words.d: A ridge is a long, narrow piece of raised land.

words.s: My dream is to become a pilot.
words.sz: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。

words.s: By the way, did you find the umbrella you said you'd lost the other day?
words.sz: 对了，前些时间你说伞不见了，现在找到了吗？

t: 赞成， 同意， 批准
words.s: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
words.sz: 如果您同意,我想給他這份工作。

t: 运动的； 流动的； 多变的
words.s: I need to charge my mobile phone.
words.sz: 我需要給手機充電。
words.d: If something is mobile, it can be moved easily.

t: 做， 履行， 完成； 表演， 演出； 工作情况， 表现
words.s: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.
words.sz: 医生们拒绝做第二次手术。
words.d: To perform is to do something in front of people who watch.

words.s: When the stunt went wrong, the man suffered multiple injuries.
words.d: If there are multiple things, there are many of them.

t: 达到高峰， 达到最大值
words.s: There is snow on the peaks of those mountains.
words.d: The peak is the very top of a mountain.

t: 进化， 演化， 发展

words.s: I saw many religious portraits when I went to the museum.
words.d: A portrait is a painting or photograph of someone.

t: 半路地； 在中途， 在半途
中途的；部分的；不彻底的
words.s: We went halfway up the mountain.
words.sz: 我們爬到了半山腰。

words.s: He took off his shirt to expose his costume.
words.d: To expose is to make known something that is hidden.

t: 全神贯注，全力以赴；集中，聚集；浓缩
words.s: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.
words.sz: 由于噪音，我无法集中精力工作了。
words.d: To concentrate is to give one’s full attention to something.

t: 磁铁， 磁体； 有吸引力的人或事物
words.s: I used a magnet to pick up the nails that were scattered on the floor.
words.d: A magnet is a piece of iron or other material which attracts iron toward it.

t: 爆炸， 爆发， 炸裂； 激增， 扩大
words.s: Yesterday, an explosion occurred at the fireworks factory.

words.sz: 我怀疑他是否会来。

words.s: Despite his riches, he's not contented.
words.sz: 尽管他很富有，他还是不满足。
words.d: Despite shows a difference from what is expected.

t: 口子， 洞， 孔； 开始； 空缺
words.s: The opening ceremony of the Olympics has already begun.
words.sz: 奥运会已经开幕了。

words.s: Many people work in industrial towns.
words.sz: 许多人在工业城市工作。

words.s: They don't always obey their parents.
words.sz: 他們並不總是服從他們的父母。
words.d: To obey means to follow what a law or a person says to do.

t: 举止， 行为； 指导； 管理； 实施
进行； 管理， 指挥， 引导； 传输， 传导
words.s: One must be responsible for one's conduct.
words.sz: 人要为自己的行为负责。
words.d: Conduct is the way that someone acts.

t: 稳定的，不变的；沉稳的，持重的
words.s: The chair is stable. Its legs are strong.
words.d: A stable thing will not move, change, or fall over.

t: 羔羊， 小羊； 羔羊肉

words.s: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
words.sz: 給我一個枕頭和毛毯好嗎？

t: 极好的， 极出色的， 了不起的； 极大的； 难以相信的； 异想天开的， 不实际的； 奇异的， 古怪的
words.s: The student did a fantastic job on his project and got an award.
words.d: A fantastic thing is really good.

t: 绘…的略图， 画…的素描； 概述
words.s: Tom ripped a page out of his sketch book.
words.sz: 汤姆从他的绘画本上撕下了一页。

words.s: The cottage was clean and tidy.
words.sz: 小屋干净又整洁。
words.d: A tidy place or person is clean and in order.

t: 回答， 答复； 作出反应， 响应
words.s: He didn't respond to my question.
words.sz: 他沒有回答我的問題。
words.d: To respond is to give an answer to what someone else said.

words.s: The incident made everyone feel more embarrassed.
words.sz: 這件事弄得大家都比較尷尬。
words.d: An incident is an event that is usually not pleasant.

t: 维持； 保养； 抚养费
娶， 嫁； 为…证婚； 结婚， 结合
words.s: I told him, once and for all, that I would not marry him.
words.sz: 我告訴他，我永遠不會嫁給他。

words.s: Salt helps to preserve food from decay.
words.sz: 鹽可以幫助保存食物避免腐爛。
words.d: Decay is the result of something slowly being broken down or destroyed naturally.

t: 吸收； 吸引…的注意， 使全神贯注； 把…并入， 同化
words.s: He used a sponge to absorb the water on the floor.
words.d: To absorb a liquid means to take it inside.

words.s: When his food supply ran short, he had to look for a new place to live.
words.sz: 他的食物供给不足的的时候，他不得不去找新的地方居住。
words.d: To supply something means to give people what they need or want.

t: 关切的事，有关的事；关心，挂念；关系，关联；公司，企业
涉及， 有关； 使关心， 使担心
words.s: Your problems don't concern me.
words.sz: 你的问题和我没有关系。
words.d: Concern is a feeling of worry.

t: 循环， 流通； 流传， 散布， 传播
words.s: The fan helped to circulate cool air through the room.
words.d: To circulate is to spread something around, especially in a circular way.

t: 自由； 许可， 准许； 过于随便， 放肆
words.s: To many people, the Statue of Liberty is a symbol of freedom.
words.d: Liberty is freedom to do what one wants.

words.s: You're liable for the debt.
words.sz: 你有义务还债。
words.d: If something is liable to happen, it is very likely that it will happen.

words.s: The cargo ship arrived four hours early.
words.sz: 货船早到了四小时。
words.d: Cargo is the items carried by a ship or an airplane.

t: 秘密的， 机密的； 亲信的
words.s: It's confidential.
words.sz: 这是机密。
words.d: If something is confidential, it must be kept secret.

t: 漂流； 大意， 主旨； 趋势
words.s: The large chunk of ice drifted in the water.
words.d: To drift means to be moved slowly by wind or water.

t: 成分， 要素， 元素； 基础， 纲要； 自然力
words.s: Tackling an opponent is Johnny’s favorite element of American football.
words.d: An element of something is a particular part of it.

words.s: His presentation was in chaos. I couldn’t understand what he meant.
words.d: Chaos is a situation that is confusing and not ordered.

t: 丰富的， 富裕的； 大量的， 充足的
words.s: The United States is abundant in natural resources.
words.sz: 美国的自然资源很丰富。
words.d: If something is abundant, then it is available in large quantities.

words.s: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.
words.sz: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。
words.d: The pace of something is the speed at which it happens.

words.s: The singer interrupted the applause to exclaim his thanks after his performance.
words.d: To exclaim something is to say it loudly, suddenly, and excitedly.

words.s: According to the weather forecast, the rainy season will set in next week.
words.sz: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。
words.d: A forecast is an idea about what the weather will be like in the future.

t: 揭露， 暴露； 揭开…的盖子
认出， 识别； 承认； 赏识， 表彰， 报偿
words.s: You have changed so much that I can hardly recognize you.
words.sz: 你变了那么多，以至于我几乎认不出你了。
words.d: To recognize something is to know it because you have seen it before.

t: 捆扎，把…打包；使挤在一起，塞满
words.s: She helped me pack my suitcase.
words.sz: 她幫我打包我的手提箱。

t: 抑制， 限制， 克制； 约束措施， 约束条件
输入；投入的资金；输入的数据
words.s: Type the input into the computer program.
words.d: Input is information that is put into a computer.

t: 现实， 实际； 真实
words.s: She looks young, but in reality she's over 40.
words.sz: 她看起来是年轻的，但实际上她四十多岁了。

t: 陈规，老套，固定的模式；铅版
把…浇铸成铅版； 对…形成固定看法
words.s: There’s a stereotype that pigs are dirty animals. But they are rather clean.
words.d: A stereotype is a general but often incorrect idea about a person or thing.

words.s: The students had to enroll in the class one semester in advance.
words.d: To enroll in something is to put one’s name on a list as a member of a group.

t: 冒犯， 伤害…的感情； 使厌恶； 违反
words.s: I didn't mean to offend anyone.
words.sz: 我不想冒犯任何人。
words.d: To offend is to make someone angry or upset.

words.s: A tiny drop of water is made up of many billions of molecules of water.
words.d: A molecule is the smallest basic unit that makes up a physical substance.

t: 辞去， 放弃； 使听从， 使顺从
words.s: You should do the honorable thing and resign.
words.sz: 你應該光榮地辭職。
words.d: To resign means to quit a job.

words.s: I bathe once a day.
words.sz: 我每天洗一次澡。
words.d: To bathe means to wash oneself with water.

t: 工人， 劳动者， 工匠
老于世故的； 高级的； 精密的， 复杂的； 高雅的
words.s: Jake is one of the most sophisticated people I’ve ever met.
words.d: If someone is sophisticated, they know many things about the world.

words.s: We woke up very early in order to see the sunrise.
words.sz: 我们起得很早为了看到日出。

t: 娱乐， 文娱节目， 表演会； 招待， 款待， 请客

words.s: This document was actually written by Tom.
words.sz: 這文件其實是湯姆寫的。
words.d: A document is a written text, usually not in the form of a book.

words.s: Do you know how many people in the world starve to death every year?
words.sz: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？
words.d: To starve is to not get enough food for a long period of time.

t: 电池， 蓄电池； 排炮， 炮组； 一系列， 一套
words.s: Remove the battery.
words.sz: 卸下電池。
words.d: A battery is an object placed inside something to supply it with electricity.

t: 追逐， 追赶； 追求
words.s: This cat doesn't chase mice.
words.sz: 这只猫不抓老鼠。
words.d: You chase people when you run after them and try to catch them.

words.s: If he had been a little more careful, the accident would have been avoided.
words.sz: 如果他当时再小心一点点，事故就不会发生了。
words.d: An accident is unexpected, and may cause some trouble.

t: 海的， 海生的； 海事的， 海军的， 海运的
words.s: Tom is studying to become a marine biologist.
words.sz: 湯姆爲了當海洋生物學家學習。
words.d: Marine describes something related to the sea.

t: 黏土， 泥土； 肉体
words.s: She made a bowl out of the clay.
words.d: Clay is a type of heavy, wet soil used to make pots.

t: 无论如何， 至少； 不论以何种方式， 无论从什么角度
words.s: We're all going to die anyway.
words.sz: 不管怎样，我们所有人都将死。

t: 促进， 增进， 发扬； 提升； 宣传， 推销
words.s: After two years at the company, she was promoted to manager.
words.d: To promote someone means to raise them to a higher position or rank.

t: 例行公事，惯例，惯常的程序
words.s: My father’s daily routine includes shaving right before breakfast.
words.d: A routine is a way of doing things that is the same every time.

words.s: The enemy made a strong attack on that building.
words.sz: 敵人對那棟建築物使出了強力攻擊。
words.d: To attack something is to hurt or damage it.

t: 幽默， 诙谐， 幽默感
离婚； 分离， 脱离
words.s: Marriage is the main cause of divorce.
words.sz: 婚姻是造成離婚的主因。
words.d: Divorce is the process of ending a marriage.

t: 通货， 货币； 通行， 流行
words.s: The currency in China is different from that in Australia.
words.d: The currency of a country is the type of money used in that country.

words.s: This ship is too big to pass through the canal.
words.sz: 这艘船太大，没法通过运河。
words.d: A canal is a path for water to travel through.

t: 缚， 系， 贴； 附加； 使依恋， 使喜爱； 使附属； 认为有
words.s: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
words.sz: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。
words.d: To attach is to put two things together.

t: 分发， 分送； 分布
words.s: The teacher distributed crayons and markers to her students.
words.d: To distribute something is to give it to a number of people.

words.s: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
words.sz: 她锻炼时扭伤了脚踝。
words.d: An ankle connects your leg to your foot.

t: 证明…有罪， 宣判…有罪
words.s: He was convicted of the crime and sent to jail.
words.d: To convict means to prove that someone did a bad thing.

t: 法律， 法规； 立法， 法律的制定
条款； 从句， 分句
智力竞赛，问答比赛；小测验
words.s: We had a history quiz this morning.
words.sz: 我們今天早上有歷史小考。

t: 参与， 参加； 分享
words.s: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.
words.sz: 我不想参加典礼。
words.d: To participate is to be active and do something.

t: 组成部分， 成分； 原料； 要素， 因素
words.s: The main ingredients in cake are eggs, sugar, and flour.
words.d: An ingredient is something that is part of a food dish.

words.s: The store sold their surplus items on sale.
words.d: A surplus is an extra amount of something.

t: 信件， 函件； 通信， 通信联系； 符合， 一致， 相似
振作精神， 恢复活力
words.s: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.
words.sz: 适度的运动让身心焕然一新。

words.s: I only tell my secrets to my most intimate friends.
words.d: When a relationship is intimate, the two things are very closely connected.

words.s: The reporter criticized the politician.
words.sz: 記者批評了政治家。

t: 宣布， 宣告； 宣言， 声明； 申报

words.s: John came home late, so he had to disclose his activities to his wife.
words.d: To disclose something means to tell it to someone else.

words.s: I am interested in Chinese religion.
words.sz: 我对中国宗教感兴趣。
words.d: A religion is a belief in a god or gods.

t: 图解， 图表， 简图
words.s: By following the diagram, I was able to put the desk together.
words.d: A diagram is a simple drawing that explains what something is or how it works.

words.s: Greg thought that writing the essay was torture.
words.d: Torture is action that causes physical or mental pain.

t: 祷告， 祈祷； 祷文； 祈求， 祈望
悲剧， 惨事， 惨案； 悲剧艺术
words.s: It was a tragedy when his house was struck by lightning and burned.
words.d: A tragedy is a very sad event.

t: 迷人的特性，魅力；符咒，咒文
words.s: The old cottage has a certain charm about it.
words.sz: 旧村屋有它自己一定的魅力。
words.d: To charm someone is to please them with your personality.

words.s: After the speech, everyone in the crowd clapped their hands for the speaker.
words.d: To clap means to hit one’s hands together to express pleasure or get attention.

words.s: I like the gray sweater more than the purple one.
words.sz: 比起紫色的毛衣，我更喜歡灰色的毛衣。

t: 停止， 放弃； 离开， 辞
words.s: Tom told Mary that she should quit pretending to be intoxicated.
words.sz: 汤姆告诉玛丽她应该停止假装醉酒。
words.d: To quit something means to stop doing it.

words.s: London was very important for economical and cultural reasons.
words.sz: 倫敦過去因為經濟和文化的緣故，十分重要。

words.s: I got him to polish my shoes.
words.sz: 我要他擦亮我的皮鞋。
words.d: To polish something is to rub it in order to make it shiny.

words.s: The tablecloth is in the cabinet.
words.sz: 桌布在櫥櫃裡。

t: 用图表表示， 在图上表示
words.s: We used a chart to see how we had improved.
words.d: A chart is a list of information.

t: 眼的， 光学的， 视觉的
样子， 方式； 时尚； 流行款式
words.s: You may think those shoes are in fashion, but they aren't.
words.sz: 你可能認為那些鞋子很時髦,但是他們不是。

words.s: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
words.sz: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

t: 序言， 前言， 引言
原则， 原理， 道义； 基本信念， 信条
words.s: To maintain principles, it’s vital to watch, listen, and speak carefully.
words.d: A principle is a belief about the correct way to behave.

words.s: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
words.sz: 生产日期在盖子上。

t: 冗长乏味的， 沉闷的
河的源头， 根源； 来源， 出处
words.s: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
words.sz: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。
words.d: A source of something is the place that it comes from.

t: 安全的，可靠的；牢固的，稳固的；无忧虑的，安心的
得到， 获得； 使安全， 保卫； 缚牢
words.s: I was able to secure a good grade on my test after weeks of studying.
words.d: To secure something means to get it after a lot of effort.

t: 本国的； 家庭的； 驯养的
words.s: The airline has fifty domestic flights daily.
words.d: Domestic refers to something that happens within a particular country.

t: 欺骗； 诡计， 骗局
words.s: The magic looked very real, but it was only deception.
words.d: Deception is the act of lying or tricking someone.

t: 基本上， 从根本上说
捐款， 捐赠物； 捐赠， 赠送
林荫道， 道路， 大街
words.s: I'd like to do shopping on Fifth Avenue in New York.
words.sz: 我想在紐約的第五大道購物。
words.d: An avenue is a road, often a large one with buildings on each side.

words.s: An immense amount of money was needed to buy such a large boat.
words.d: If something is immense, it is very large.

t: 低廉的， 收费公道的
words.s: We are traveling on a tight budget.
words.sz: 我們很節省地旅行。
words.d: A budget is the amount of money available to spend on something.

t: 规定的，特定的；假设的；已知的；有癖好的，有倾向的
words.s: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
words.sz: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。

words.s: I need to buy some more hay for the horse to eat.
words.d: Hay is dry grass used to feed animals and can be used for different purposes.

t: 胸腔， 胸膛； 箱子
words.s: Tom had a pain in his chest, so he went to the hospital.
words.sz: 汤姆胸痛，所以去了医院。
words.d: The chest is the front part of a body between the neck and stomach.

t: 紧张， 不安； 拉紧； 张力， 拉力

words.s: I cannot give you a definite answer today.
words.sz: 我今天无法给您一个最终的答复。
words.d: A definite thing is certain or sure to be true.

t: 映像， 倒影； 反射； 反映， 表达； 非议； 沉思， 反省
words.s: Tom looked at his reflection in the mirror.
words.sz: 汤姆看他在镜中的映像。
words.d: A reflection is an image that is seen in a mirror or other shiny surface.

words.s: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
words.sz: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。
words.d: When something is ultimate, it is the final result or aim of a long series of events.

words.s: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
words.sz: 我把他带到校区里最贵的餐馆去了。

words.s: I'm slow to adapt to new situations.
words.sz: 我适应新环境很慢。
words.d: To adapt means to change in order to deal with a new situation.

t: 快乐的， 愉快的； 使人感到愉快的
words.s: I get a kick out of her cheerful personality.
words.sz: 她開朗的個性使我覺得快樂。
words.d: A cheerful person is happy and pleasant.

t: 长处，优点，价值；功劳，成绩
words.s: The actor received an award for his merits in the movie.
words.d: A merit is a positive or good quality.

words.s: Please don't misunderstand me.
words.sz: 千万别误会我的意思。

words.s: If he is innocent, it follows that his wife is guilty.
words.sz: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。
words.d: Guilty people feel bad for something they did.

t: 分量； 尺寸； 量具； 计量单位； 量度， 测量； 措施， 办法
words.s: There are several ways to measure speed.
words.sz: 测速的方法有很多。
words.d: To measure something means to find out the quality, value, or effect of it.

t: 全面的， 总体的， 全部的
words.s: Overall, the party was a huge success.
words.d: When a thing is talked about overall, the whole thing is considered.

t: 发票， 收据； 收入， 进款； 收到， 接到
words.s: I'd like a receipt, please.
words.sz: 麻煩我要一張收據。
words.d: A receipt is a paper that proves that something was received or bought.

t: 假定， 假设， 臆断； 承担， 担任； 呈现
words.s: Let's assume that'll happen.
words.sz: 讓我們假定那會發生。
words.d: To assume something is to think that it is true, even with no proof.

words.s: I seasoned the fish with salt and pepper.
words.sz: 我在魚上灑鹽和胡椒作調味。

t: 概念， 观念， 设想
words.s: I understand the concept.
words.sz: 我明白这概念。
words.d: A concept is an idea about something.

t: 抵抗的， 抗…的， 耐…的

words.s: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
words.sz: 已經花費了很多的時間和精力。
words.d: Effort is hard work or an attempt to do something.

words.s: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
words.sz: 我在那商店花低價買了臺錄像機。

t: 灾难， 灾祸， 天灾； 彻底的失败
words.s: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.
words.sz: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。
words.d: A disaster is a really bad thing that happens.

words.s: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
words.sz: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
words.d: Agriculture is the growing of plants and raising of animals for food.

words.s: Patience is sometimes the most effective weapon.
words.sz: 耐心有时候是最有效的武器。
words.d: A weapon is an object used to hurt people.

words.s: Our grocer, Mr. Smith, is a very kind man.
words.d: A grocer is a person who sells food.

words.s: It isn't polite to stare at people.
words.sz: 盯著人看是不禮貌的。

t: 疼痛的， 引起疼痛的； 困难的； 令人不快的
words.s: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
words.sz: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。

t: 票，选票；选举，投票，表决；表决结果，投票总数
words.s: In the U.S., most people can vote when they reach eighteen years of age.
words.sz: 在美國，大多數人能在十八歲以後投票。

t: 稳的，平稳的；稳定的，持续的；稳固的
words.s: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.
words.sz: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。
words.d: Steady shows that someone or something does not change much.

t: 提高， 增加， 加强
words.s: Amy’s blue shirt really enhances the color of her eyes.
words.d: To enhance something is to make it better.

t: 围住， 圈起； 附上； 把…装入信封
words.s: The cows in the field were enclosed by a fence.
words.d: To enclose something is to contain it.

t: 习俗， 惯例； 公约； 会议
words.s: In the US, a popular convention is to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.d: A convention is behavior that is considered to be common or polite.

t: 病， 疾病； 不健全； 弊端
words.s: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
words.sz: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。
words.d: A disease is an illness that causes specific problems.

t: 圆心， 正中； 中心
words.s: The bus will take you to the center of the city.
words.sz: 巴士会把你们带到市中心。
words.d: The center of something is the middle of it.

t: 怀疑， 疑心， 猜疑； 一点儿， 少量
words.s: The police had a suspicion that the driver had stolen the purse.
words.d: A suspicion is a feeling that something is possible or true in a crime.

words.s: You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
words.sz: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。

words.s: I interpreted her silence as a refusal.
words.sz: 我認為她的沉默就是表示拒絕。

t: 【生物】 属的， 类的； 一般的， 普通的
天才， 天赋， 天资； 天才人物
words.s: He thought that he was a genius.
words.sz: 他認為他是個天才。
words.d: A genius is a very smart person.

t: 一样地， 相似地； 同样程度地
words.s: Those two are exactly alike.
words.sz: 那兩個是一模一樣的。
words.d: If two people or things are alike, they are similar to each other.

words.s: We all put money into our club’s fund.
words.d: A fund is an amount of money that people have.

t: 重力， 引力； 严重性； 严肃， 庄重
words.s: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
words.sz: 让卫星环绕地球的是重力。
words.d: Gravity is the force that makes things fall to Earth.

words.s: I find that it's typical for him to come too late.
words.sz: 我發現他就是會很晚才來這樣的人。
words.d: If something is typical, it is normal, or something that usually happens.

t: 引文， 引语， 语录； 报价， 牌价， 行情
财政，金融；财源，财务情况
words.s: The government financed the scientist’s experiments with new weapons.
words.d: To finance someone or something means to provide money for them.

t: 画室， 摄影室； 播音室， 录音室， 摄影棚

words.s: The waiter brought our food on a tray.
words.d: A tray is a fat plate used to hold food.

t: 管理， 控制； 调整， 调节
words.s: The bank regulates how much money people can borrow.
words.d: To regulate something is to control how it happens.

t: 手掌， 掌状物； 棕榈树
words.s: I am interested in palm reading.
words.sz: 我对掌上阅读很感兴趣。

words.s: Airships used to be filled with hydrogen, but it exploded easily.
words.d: Hydrogen is a gas that has no taste, color, or smell.

words.s: The infant cried all night.
words.d: An infant is a baby.

words.s: That fox must have killed the hen.
words.sz: 那隻狐狸殺了一隻母雞。

t: 谁； 无论谁； 究竟是谁
words.s: Whoever said money can't buy happiness simply didn't know where to go shopping.
words.sz: 那些说钱不能买来幸福的人，只是不知道上哪里去买而已。

words.d: Carbon is a chemical element.

t: 卸， 卸货； 下客； 退出子弹； 卸下胶卷

words.s: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
words.sz: 我们会用银行转帐付款。
words.d: When you make a payment, you give someone some money for what you get.

t: 特别地， 特定地； 明确地， 具体地
引起争论的， 有争议的
words.s: This theory is very controversial.
words.sz: 这个理论很有争议。

t: 达到， 获得， 完成
words.s: If you want to attain a healthy body, you must exercise every day.
words.d: To attain something is to succeed at something or to get something you want.

t: 陷阱，捕捉器；圈套，诡计；困境
words.s: We set a trap to catch a fox.
words.sz: 我们设了个陷阱来抓狐狸。
words.d: To trap people or animals is to capture them so they cannot get away.

t: 画廊， 美术馆； 楼座； 旁听席； 回廊， 走廊
words.s: The art gallery displayed beautiful paintings.
words.d: A gallery is a large space where people can see works of art.

t: 副职， 副手； 代表， 代理人
words.s: He will be my deputy while I am away.
words.sz: 我不在的时候，他将是我的代理人。

t: 暖和， 温暖； 热烈， 热情， 热心
最高的， 最大的； 极度的， 最重要的
words.s: The supreme officer was in charge of keeping the citizens calm.
words.d: Supreme means of the highest level or best quality.

words.s: Do you need an ambulance?
words.sz: 你需要救護車嗎?
words.d: An ambulance is a vehicle that transports people in a medical emergency.

t: 优先， 重点； 优先考虑的事
words.s: My priority is to get good grades in school.
words.d: A priority is something that is more important than other things.

words.s: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
words.sz: 這條小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。
words.d: A slope is ground that is not flat.

t: 哲学， 哲理， 人生哲学
words.s: Philosophy is not a thing one can learn in six months.
words.sz: 哲学不是我们用六个月就能学的东西。
words.d: A philosophy is a way to think about truth and life.

words.s: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
words.sz: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

words.s: I'm not a junior high school student.
words.sz: 我不是個初中生。
words.d: A junior person is younger or less experienced.

t: 分配， 分派， 把…拨给
words.s: The government allocated $100 million to aid the disaster relief effort.
words.d: To allocate something means to put it aside for a certain purpose or person.

words.s: He has a wife and two young children to provide for.
words.sz: 他有一个妻子和两个孩子要养活。
words.d: To provide something means to supply it.

words.s: Take your hat off when you enter a house of worship.
words.sz: 當你進入禮拜堂時，把你的帽子脫下來。
words.d: To worship means to like and honor a person, thing, or religious figure.

t: 草地， 草坪， 草场
words.s: I didn't charge Tom anything to mow his lawn.
words.sz: 我修剪湯姆的草坪，沒有向他收取任何費用。
words.d: A lawn is an area covered in grass.

t: 首要的， 主要的； 基本的； 最初的， 初级的
words.s: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
words.sz: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。
words.d: If something is primary, it is the most important thing.

words.s: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
words.sz: 在加拿大有很多區域砍伐樹木是非法的。
words.d: A log is a thick piece of wood that is cut from a tree.

t: 太阳的， 日光的； 太阳能的
words.s: The nearest star to our solar system is Proxima Centauri.
words.sz: 離我們太陽系最近的恆星是比鄰星。
words.d: If something is solar, it is related to the sun.

t: 消费， 吃完， 喝光； 毁灭； 使着迷， 充满
words.s: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.
words.sz: 瑞士人消耗不少啤酒。
words.d: To consume something means to eat or drink it.

t: 形成， 构成， 形成物； 队形， 排列
words.s: The formation of ice happens when water freezes.
words.d: A formation is the way that something is made.

words.s: There was a layer of snow on the tops of the houses this morning.
words.d: A layer covers over something or is one of several pieces lying on top of each other.

words.s: That discovery was quite accidental.
words.sz: 那个发现纯属偶然。

t: 使确信； 确保， 向…保证
words.s: He assured the boss that the building would be done on time.
words.d: To assure people is to tell them something is true to make them less worried.

t: 请教； 查阅； 商议
words.s: I don't know who to consult with.
words.sz: 我不知道该和谁商量好。
words.d: To consult means to ask someone for help.

words.s: What is the theme of his latest novel?
words.sz: 他最后一本小说的主题是什么？
words.d: A theme is the main subject of a book, movie, or painting.

t: 粉碎，打烂；狠打，猛击；破灭，失败；猛撞，猛冲
破碎 ； 猛击， 猛撞； 轰动的演出， 巨大的成功
words.s: Jacob smashed the window with a rock.
words.d: To smash something is to break it into many small pieces.

words.s: He said it merely as a joke.
words.sz: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。

t: 矛盾， 不一致； 否认， 反驳
忙乱； 大惊小怪， 小题大做； 烦恼， 过于忧虑
words.s: The child made an awful fuss because she didn’t want to go to bed.
words.d: A fuss is excited or annoyed behavior that is not useful in any way.

t: 财富， 财产； 丰富
words.s: Because of his wealth, he was able to become a member of that club.
words.sz: 由於他的財富，他能夠成為這個俱樂部的成員。
words.d: Wealth is the total of one’s possessions (money, land, etc.).

t: 编辑， 编者， 校订者
words.s: You don't want to be an editor?
words.sz: 你不想做编辑？

words.s: There was an empty barrel outside the house.
words.d: A barrel is a round thing that you can keep liquids in.

t: 方法， 手段， 工具； 金钱， 财产
words.s: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.
words.sz: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。

words.s: There are no people who don't desire peace.
words.sz: 沒人不渴望和平。
words.d: To desire is to want something.

t: 从…逃出，幸免于；从中挺过来；比…活得长
words.s: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
words.sz: 那個地點的書店無法賺足夠的錢生存下去。
words.d: When something survives, it manages to continue to live in spite of difficult circumstances.

t: 效率高的； 有能力的
words.s: There is no denying that she is very efficient.
words.sz: 无可否认她非常有能力。
words.d: If something or someone is efficient, they do not waste energy.

words.s: The initial step when writing a paper is to find a good topic.
words.d: Initial shows that something is first.

words.s: Unfortunately, I have to get up early every morning.
words.sz: 不幸的是，我必须每天早起。

t: 坚持的， 一贯的； 一致的， 符合的
words.s: Sara comes in every day and is our most consistent worker.
words.d: If a person is consistent, they always have the same behavior or attitude.

t: 撤销，推翻；反向，倒转；彻底改变
反向的， 相反的， 倒转的
相反，对立面；反面，背面，后面；挫折，逆境
words.s: He did the reverse of what I asked.
words.sz: 他做的和我要求的相反。
words.d: When a car reverses, it goes backwards.

t: 异种， 异质， 不同成分

words.s: They used to use swords in battles in ancient times.
words.d: A sword is a long sharp weapon.

words.s: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
words.sz: 正式工比临时工要好。
words.d: Something permanent lasts for a long time or forever.

t: 仅仅， 只不过， 几乎不
words.s: Tom always speaks in such a low voice that I can barely understand what he says.
words.sz: 汤姆总是说话声音太小，我几乎听不懂他在说什么。
words.d: Barely means by the smallest amount, almost not.

t: 概括， 概述， 总结
小伙子， 男人， 家伙
设备； 容易； 场所
words.s: There are many educational facilities in big cities.
words.d: A facility is a building that exists for a particular purpose.

t: 面露喜色； 定向发出， 播送
words.s: Modern skyscrapers are made with many beams.
words.d: A beam is a heavy bar.

words.s: The junior executives formed an alliance with each other.
words.d: An alliance is a group of people who work together.

t: 文明， 文化； 开化
小说； 虚构， 杜撰
words.s: He's very fond of science fiction.
words.sz: 他非常喜欢科幻小说。
words.d: Fiction is a story that is not true.

t: 有， 所有； 所有物
words.s: The ball is that boy's prized possession.
words.sz: 这个球是那个男孩的宝贝。

t: 代替， 取代； 更换， 调换； 把…放回原处
words.s: Because of the problem of air pollution, the bicycle may some day replace the automobile.
words.sz: 因為空氣汙染的問題，也許有一天自行車會取代汽車。
words.d: To replace something is to put it in the place of something else.

t: 任命； 约定； 约会； 委任的职位
words.s: Make another appointment at the front desk.
words.sz: 在服務台另外預約。

words.s: I wish you a Merry Christmas.
words.sz: 祝你圣诞节快乐。
words.d: A merry person is happy and pleasant.

words.s: This dam supplies us with water and electricity.
words.sz: 这个水坝给我们提供水和电。

words.s: Don't be so pessimistic.
words.sz: 不要感觉那么悲观。
words.d: If someone is pessimistic, they believe that the worst will happen.

t: 花，开花，开花期；青春焕发
words.s: This week the cherry blossoms in the park are in full bloom.
words.sz: 本周公园樱花盛开。
words.d: To bloom is to produce an open flower.

words.s: What do you plan to major in at college?
words.sz: 你计划去大学后主修什么吗？
words.d: A major event is a very important event.

t: 地区， 区域， 范围
words.s: Firefighters often work in danger zones.
words.d: A zone is an area that has different qualities from the ones around it.

t: 强调； 重点， 重要性
words.s: He placed emphasis on the importance of education.
words.sz: 他强调了教育的重要性。
words.d: When you put an emphasis on prevention, you give special attention to prevention.

t: 打断， 打扰， 中断
words.s: I didn't mean to interrupt anything.
words.sz: 我沒想要打擾什麼事。

t: 开； 吩咐采用； 规定， 指定
words.s: When I was sick, the doctor prescribed me flu medicine for me to take.
words.d: To prescribe medicine means to tell someone to take it.

words.s: Every man is a potential corpse.
words.sz: 每个人都可能变成尸体。
words.d: Potential means capable of being but not yet actual or real.

words.s: There are many different kinds of beans to eat.
words.d: A bean is a plant seed that is good to eat.

words.s: He quickly accustomed himself to his new surroundings.
words.sz: 他很快就适应了新环境。

t: 结合， 联合； 化合
words.s: Jazz fusion is a combination of rock and jazz.
words.sz: 融合爵士是搖滾樂與爵士樂的融合。

t: 获得； 通用， 流行； 存在
words.s: After I passed the test, I obtained my driver’s license.
words.d: To obtain is to get something you want or need.

t: 一再， 再三， 多次地
words.s: I can't believe you are eating something the doctor has told you repeatedly you shouldn't eat.
words.sz: 真的不敢相信你在吃医生叮嘱不要食用的东西。

t: 好奇， 好奇心； 奇物， 奇事， 珍品
总的； 严重的； 粗俗的； 臃肿的
words.s: The food was so gross that the dog couldn’t eat it without feeling sick.
words.d: If something is gross, then it is disgusting.

t: 车间， 作坊， 创作室； 研讨会， 讲习班
words.s: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.
words.sz: 我把车库改造成车间使用。

t: 抵抗， 反抗， 抵制； 抗， 耐； 忍住， 拒受…的影响
words.s: I can't resist sweet things.
words.sz: 我抵抗不了甜食的诱惑。
words.d: To resist something is to fight against it.

t: 设计，安排；格式，样式，版式
牺牲； 供奉； 祭品
words.s: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
words.sz: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？
words.d: To sacrifice is to give up something in order to get something you want or do something else for someone.

words.s: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
words.sz: 在加拿大有很多區域砍伐樹木是非法的。

t: 刺激， 激励， 激发
words.s: Doctors sometimes use electric shock to stimulate a patient’s heartbeat.
words.d: To stimulate something means to cause or to increase activity in it.

words.s: There's no need for you to prepare a formal speech.
words.sz: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。
words.d: A formal thing is official or serious.

words.s: Bill and Angela congratulated each other on a job well done.
words.d: To congratulate someone is to tell them that you are happy for them.

words.s: Did you see the rainbow this morning?
words.sz: 你见到今天早上的彩虹了吗？

t: 猛增， 剧增； 高飞， 升腾； 高涨； 高耸， 屹立
words.s: The temperature today will soar to a high of 100 degrees Fahrenheit.
words.d: To soar is to increase quickly to a high level.

words.s: He makes a living as a salesman.
words.sz: 他當推銷員為生。

t: 干涉， 干预， 阻碍
保持， 使持续下去； 供养， 维持； 支持， 支撑； 经受， 遭受
words.s: Wind power is a clean way to sustain a city with energy.
words.d: To sustain something is to keep it going.

t: 使欢乐； 招待， 请客
words.s: The clown entertained the kids at the party.
words.d: To entertain someone is to do something that they enjoy.

t: 海拔， 高度； 高处

words.s: The biologist classified the plant as a completely new species.
words.d: To classify things is to put them into groups based on their type.

words.s: I am very ill at ease with strangers.
words.sz: 我面对陌生人很不自在。
words.d: Ease is a condition without difficulty or hard work.

words.s: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
words.sz: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

t: 殖民地； 侨居地， 聚居地； 群体， 集群
words.s: Some say that China was like a Russian colony.
words.sz: 有人說中國像是俄國的殖民地。
words.d: A colony is a country controlled by another country.

words.s: Mathematics is an easy subject for me.
words.sz: 數學對我來說是一個容易的科目。

t: 四轮马车， 大篷车； 铁路货车， 客货两用车
words.s: He used his wagon to carry some of his gifts.
words.d: A wagon is a cart used to carry heavy things.

t: 透入， 渗入， 进入； 刺穿； 洞察， 了解
words.s: The knife easily penetrated the surface of the orange.
words.d: To penetrate something means to enter into it.

t: 负责人， 校长； 资本， 本金； 主要演员， 主角
words.s: Our school's principal is very old.
words.sz: 我校校长很老了。
words.d: A principal is a person in charge of a school.

t: 照管， 照料， 护理
words.s: Lonely people tend to be afraid of meeting others, which ensures they will always be lonely.
words.sz: 孤獨的人會孤獨，是因為他畏懼他人。
words.d: To tend to do something is to be likely to do it or to do it often.

t: 样本， 标本， 样品
轻松， 宽慰； 缓解； 调剂， 消遣； 接替
words.s: This medicine will give you some relief.
words.sz: 这药会让你舒服些。
words.d: Relief is a good feeling after something bad or challenging ends.

t: 尺寸， 尺度； 方面， 特点； 面积， 规模
介绍， 引进； 引言

words.s: You don't deserve the salary they're paying you.
words.sz: 你不应该得到他们给你的薪水。
words.d: To deserve is to be worthy of something as a result of one’s actions.

words.s: The whole process will take months.
words.sz: 整个过程需要耗费数月。
words.d: A process is the steps to take to do something.

words.s: I wanted to become a philosopher.
words.sz: 我想成爲哲學家。

t: 恢复， 使回复； 修复， 整修； 归还， 交还
words.s: Victor restored the old car.
words.d: To restore something is to put it back the way it was.

words.s: Demand for occupational therapy has surged in recent years.
words.sz: 这几年对作业疗法的需求在迅速增长。
words.d: Therapy is treatment for a particular physical or mental illness or condition.

t: 两者选一的， 供选择的； 另类的
替换物，选择；选择的自由
words.s: Her first plan to make extra money seemed weak, so she chose an alternative.
words.d: An alternative is something that you can choose instead of your first choice.

t: 集中； 专注， 专心； 浓缩， 浓度

words.s: I encountered a sea turtle while I was swimming.
words.d: To encounter is to find or meet a person or thing.

t: 碳酸钠， 纯碱； 汽水， 苏打水
words.s: Do you want a glass of soda?
words.sz: 你想來杯汽水嗎？

words.s: I'm a colleague of Tom's.
words.sz: 我是汤姆的一位同事。
words.d: A colleague is somebody you work with.

t: 感激， 感谢， 感恩
words.s: The kids showed Aunt Tess much gratitude for visiting them.
words.d: Gratitude is a feeling of being thankful.

t: 赞成， 称许； 批准
words.s: That's why I don't approve of your plan.
words.sz: 那就是我不赞同你的计划的原因。
words.d: To approve of something means you like or agree with that thing.

words.s: I always chew my food carefully before swallowing it.
words.d: To chew is to break up food by using the mouth and teeth.

t: 干涉， 干预， 妨碍
words.s: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.
words.sz: 你沒有干涉他人事務的權力。
words.d: To interfere is to cause problems and keep something from happening.

words.s: We have a warrant to search your apartment.
words.sz: 我们有权搜查你的公寓。
words.d: An apartment is a set of rooms in a building where people live.

words.s: We must take into account the wishes of all the family in planning a trip.
words.sz: 筹划旅行的时候，我们必须考虑到全家人的意愿。
words.d: An account with a bank is an arrangement to keep one’s money there.

t: 心神不安的， 忧虑的
words.s: I understand that you feel uneasy, but don't worry.
words.sz: 我知道你不自在，但别急。

t: 忍受， 容忍； 容许， 承认
words.s: I can't tolerate this noise any longer.
words.sz: 我不能再忍受這個噪音了。
words.d: To tolerate something means to be able to accept it even when it is unpleasant.

words.s: Tom put a stack of letters on Mary's desk.
words.sz: 湯姆把一疊信放在瑪麗桌上。
words.d: A stack is a pile of different things.

t: 在…下面画线； 强调， 使…突出
清白的； 幼稚的； 没有恶意的
words.s: The court declared him innocent on the charge of murder.
words.sz: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。
words.d: An innocent person is not guilty of a crime.

words.s: I remember my mother teaching me the alphabet.
words.sz: 我记得我母亲教我认字。

t: 爆裂； 噼啪地响； 打， 击
words.s: The old window was covered with cracks.
words.d: A crack is a narrow space between the parts of something broken.

t: 捆绑， 包扎； 装订； 约束； 使结合， 使黏合
words.s: The victims of the flood were bound by their need to help each other.
words.d: To bind people is to make them feel united together.

words.s: Did you trim the apple trees?
words.sz: 你修剪過蘋果樹嗎？
words.d: To trim something is to cut it a little bit.

t: 重视， 赏识； 领会， 体会； 感谢； 增值
words.s: I appreciate your help in clarifying this.
words.sz: 感謝你幫我解釋明白。
words.d: To appreciate something is to understand its good qualities.

t: 不一样的， 相异的； 多种多样的
words.s: Big cities have diverse populations with people of different races and ages.
words.d: When a group of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.s: I'm sitting in the railway station.
words.sz: 我坐在火車站裡。

words.s: This is an ice cube.
words.sz: 這是冰塊。
words.d: A cube is a solid object with six square surfaces that are all the same size.

t: 集合， 团结； 恢复， 重新振作
words.s: The school had a rally in the gym to support the basketball team.
words.d: A rally is a large public meeting in order to support something.

words.s: The Prime Minister's speech was calculated to anger the opposition parties.
words.sz: 總理的發言估計激怒了在野黨。
words.d: Prime shows that something is the most important one.

t: 发生； 碰巧， 恰好
words.s: Had he known what was about to happen, he would have changed his plan.
words.sz: 要是他知道会发生什么，他就会改变计划。
words.d: If someone happens to do something, he or she does it by chance.

words.s: They helped one another to make the school festival a success.
words.sz: 他们互帮互助，把校庆搞得很成功。
words.d: A festival is an event that is held to celebrate a particular thing.

t: 温柔的； 温暖的； 轻微的
words.s: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
words.sz: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

t: 侧面；人物简介；轮廓，形象；姿态，引人注目的状态
words.s: The drawing of Olivia’s profile came out very well.
words.d: A profile is an outline of a face, usually as seen from the side.

words.s: The three friends are very loyal to each other.
words.d: Loyal people always help or support a certain person or thing.

t: 喜爱， 偏爱； 偏爱的事物； 优先
影响， 作用， 冲击
words.s: My grandmother had a great impact on my life.
words.d: An impact is the effect someone or something has.

words.s: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.
words.sz: 你所要做的便是好好把握這千載難逢的機會。
words.d: An opportunity is a chance to do something.

t: 活跃的， 积极的； 主动的； 起作用的
words.s: The volcano has become active again.
words.sz: 這座火山又開始活動了。
words.d: When someone is active, they move a lot or have a lot of things to do.

words.s: Have you gotten used to living in the dorm?
words.sz: 你習慣在宿舍生活了嗎？

t: 无论哪个， 无论哪些
words.s: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.
words.sz: 不管你选哪条路，你都能按时到那里。

t: 法院， 法庭； 庭院； 宫廷； 球场
words.s: Anything you say may be held against you in a court of law.
words.sz: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。

words.s: Even though it was dangerous, they ventured up the mountain.
words.d: To venture is to go to a place that may be dangerous.

t: 磨坊；碾磨机；制造厂，工厂
words.s: The farmer took his wheat to the mill to make it into flour.
words.d: A mill is a building in which wheat is ground into flour.

t: 水桶， 吊桶； 铲斗
words.s: Please fill this bucket with water.
words.sz: 請把這個桶子裝滿水。
words.d: A bucket is a round container to put things in.

t: 资格较老的，地位较高的；年长的
较年长者； 毕业班学生
words.s: She gave her seat to a senior citizen.
words.sz: 她把她的座位让给了一个老人。
words.d: A senior person is older or more experienced.

t: 剂量， 用量， 一剂
words.s: My mother gave me a dose of medicine before I went to bed.
words.d: A dose is a certain amount of medicine taken at one time.

words.s: Whichever route you take, you will get there in time.
words.sz: 不管你选哪条路，你都能按时到那里。
words.d: A route is the way you go from one place to another.

t: 热情， 热心， 热忱； 巨大兴趣
words.s: Tom doesn't share Mary's enthusiasm.
words.sz: 汤姆没有感受到玛丽的热情。
words.d: Enthusiasm is a very strong good feeling about something.

words.s: The tree branch was so flexible it could be bent into a circle and not break.
words.d: If something is flexible, then it can bend easily without breaking.

t: 成年的； 成年人的， 适宜于成年人的
words.s: Two adult tickets and three children's tickets to London, please.
words.sz: 请给我两张到伦敦的成人票，三张儿童票。
words.d: An adult is a person who is more than 18 years old.

t: 态度， 看法； 姿势
words.s: You can't fight a good fight with such a defeatist attitude.
words.sz: 抱著失敗主義的態度你無法打一場漂亮的仗。
words.d: Someone’s attitude is the way they feel and think.

words.s: Tom is a distant relative of mine.
words.sz: 湯姆是我的遠亲。
words.d: A relative is a family member.

t: 器官； 机构； 管风琴； 新闻媒介
words.s: Do you know how to play the organ?
words.sz: 你会弹管风琴吗?

words.s: The average height of girls in this class is over 155 centimeters.
words.sz: 这个班的女生平均身高超过了155公分。
words.d: If something is average, it is at a normal level.

t: 待遇； 治疗， 疗法； 对待， 处理
words.s: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
words.sz: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。

t: 比较， 对照； 把…比作
words.s: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
words.d: To compare means to say how two things are the same and different.

t: 多重性； 兼职， 兼任
有影响的； 有权势的
words.s: He is very influential in the world of medicine.
words.sz: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。

words.s: I got shivers on my way home because it was so cold.
words.d: A shiver is a shaking movement the body makes when someone is cold or scared.

words.s: According to the Bible, God created the world in six days.
words.sz: 根据圣经记载，上帝用6天创造了世界。
words.d: The Bible is the book of sacred writing in the Christian religion.

words.s: Lips that touch liquor shall not touch mine.
words.sz: 碰過酒的嘴唇就別想碰我的唇。

t: 光荣的； 可敬的； 正直的

words.s: I got over the difficulty with my characteristic tenacity.
words.sz: 我凭韧性克服了困难。
words.d: A characteristic is something that shows what a person or a thing is like.

t: 透明的； 易识破的； 明显的， 清楚的

words.s: They looked at the interior of the box.
words.d: An interior is the inside of something.

t: 惊起； 唤起； 唤醒
日报， 杂志， 日志
words.s: My dad keeps a journal every day.
words.sz: 我爸爸每天都记日记。
words.d: A journal is a type of magazine that deals with an academic subject.

words.s: He has a good grasp of English.
words.sz: 他精通英文。
words.d: To grasp something means to hold it.

words.s: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.
words.sz: 一点火花让火药爆炸。

words.s: The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
words.sz: 不像狗,這隻鶴從來沒有夢想過飛翔。
words.d: Unlike is used in place of “completely different from a particular person or thing.”

t: 立法机构； 议会； 集合； 集会的人们； 装配， 组装
words.s: The students had an assembly to talk about their interests.
words.d: An assembly is a group gathered together for the same reason.

t: 听力， 听觉； 听力所及之距离； 意见听取会； 申辩的机会
words.s: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this matter.
words.sz: 我期待听到你在这件事上的想法。

t: 取得， 获得， 习得； 获得物， 增添的人
words.s: Marty was happy with his new acquisition: a very fast bicycle.
words.d: An acquisition is something that a person buys or gets in some way.

words.s: The volcano erupted suddenly, killing many people.
words.sz: 火山突然喷发，造成了多人死亡。
words.d: A volcano is a mountain with a hole on top where hot liquid comes out.

t: 严格的； 死板的； 刚硬的， 僵硬的
words.s: Societies often have rigid rules about the way that people are supposed to act.
words.d: When rules or systems are rigid, they are severe because they cannot be changed.

words.s: You must get the job done before the deadline.
words.sz: 你必须在到期前完成这项工作。
words.d: A deadline is the time by which you need to have something completed.

t: 感激的； 令人愉快的
words.s: I'd be grateful to you if you could teach me to do that.
words.sz: 如果你能教我怎麼做，我會很感激。
words.d: A grateful person feels thankful about something.

t: 屑片， 碎片； 炸土豆条； 集成电路片， 集成块； 缺口， 瑕疵
words.s: Tom baked some chocolate chip cookies.
words.sz: 汤姆烤了些巧克力脆饼。

words.s: Luke pointed to the hair on his chin.
words.d: A chin is the hard part at the bottom of a person’s face.

words.s: I agree on an emotional level, but on the pragmatic level I disagree.
words.sz: 我感情上支持，但是理性上反对。

t: 运转的； 可使用的； 操作上的

words.s: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
words.sz: 全体销售人员通宵达旦地工作了一周。
words.d: A staff is a group of people working together in a company.

t: 使卷入， 牵涉； 包含， 含有
words.s: I didn't mean to involve you.
words.sz: 我沒想要讓你牽扯進來。
words.d: To involve means to include as an active participant.

words.s: There are noticeable differences between the two.
words.sz: 两者之间有显著的差别。

t: 集合， 召集； 装配
words.s: This bookcase is easy to assemble.
words.sz: 這個書架組裝起來很簡單。
words.d: To assemble means to get together in one place.

words.s: News of the recent blast is all over the radio.
words.sz: 收音機廣播充斥著有關最近爆炸的新聞。

t: 一系列， 连续； 丛书， 连续剧
words.s: He has just published an interesting series of articles.
words.sz: 他刚发表一系列有趣的文章。

words.s: Computers are capable of doing extremely complicated work.
words.sz: 电脑可以做极为复杂的工作。

t: 耕作， 种植； 培养， 陶冶
words.s: A research company is cultivating new kinds of rice to aid poor countries.
words.d: To cultivate plants is to care for them and help them grow.

t: 最大的， 最高的， 顶点的
words.s: The maximum driving speed here is 80 km/h.
words.d: Maximum is the highest amount of anything allowed.

t: 兴旺， 繁荣， 旺盛
words.s: He may be an old man, but he continues to thrive.
words.d: To thrive means to do well and be successful, healthy, or strong.

words.s: It was not until I reached home that I missed my purse.
words.sz: 那是在我到家以后，我才不见了我的钱包。
words.d: A purse is a bag in which women keep money, makeup, keys, etc.

t: 作为…的代表； 表示， 象征； 描绘， 表现
words.s: The blue lines on the map represent rivers.
words.sz: 地图上的蓝线代表河流。
words.d: To represent is to speak or act for a person or group.

t: 比赛， 竞争， 对抗
方言， 土语， 地方话

words.s: The accountant helped us keep track of our spending.
words.d: An accountant is a person whose job is to keep financial accounts for a business.

t: 昏暗的；朦胧的；模糊不清的
words.s: I have a dim memory of my grandmother.
words.sz: 我对祖母的记忆很模糊。

t: 紧急情况， 突然事件
words.s: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
words.sz: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。
words.d: An emergency is a time when someone needs help right away.

words.s: The economy experienced a dip in the 1930s, leading many workers to lose their jobs.
words.d: A dip is a decline or a worsening in condition.

t: 才能， 能力； 系， 科； 全体教员
words.s: The boy’s mental faculties impressed all of his teachers.
words.d: A faculty is a mental or physical ability.

words.s: A narrow trail cut through the field and over the hills.
words.d: A trail is a path for travelling by foot through a wild area.

words.s: She was in trouble because she lost her passport.
words.sz: 她遇到了麻煩，因為她弄丟了她的護照。

words.s: Ron had to wait since he arrived prior to the scheduled meeting time.
words.d: When something happened prior to something else, it happened earlier.

t: 考虑周到的， 体贴的， 体谅的
words.s: You were considerate not to disturb us.
words.sz: 你考虑周到，没有打扰我们。
words.d: When someone is considerate, they pay attention to the needs of others.

t: 线索， 暗示， 提示
words.s: I have no clue.
words.sz: 我一无所知。
words.d: A clue is a fact or object that helps solve a mystery or crime.

words.s: The legal system in America is the world's finest.
words.sz: 美國的司法制度是世界上最好的。
words.d: If something is legal, it is related to the law or allowed by the law.

words.s: The accident took place on the highway.
words.sz: 事故發生在高速公路上。

t: 突然不见， 消失； 不复存在， 绝迹
words.s: All the passengers vanished from the train station.
words.d: To vanish is to go away suddenly.

words.s: He gave us the signal to begin.
words.sz: 他給了我們開始的信號。
words.d: A signal is a sound or action that tells someone to do something.

t: 分， 分配； 把…包起来， 捆扎
words.s: The address on this parcel is wrong.
words.sz: 這個包裹上的地址是錯的。
words.d: A parcel is a package of things to be carried or mailed somewhere.

t: 静的，静态的；静止的，停滞的

words.s: Reading a book can be compared to a journey.
words.sz: 阅读一本书可以比作一次旅行。
words.d: A journey is a long trip.

words.s: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
words.sz: 水星是我們的太陽系中最小的行星。
words.d: A planet is a large round thing in space.

words.s: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
words.sz: 經過長久的爭論，我終於說服了她去露營。
words.d: When something finally happens, it happens at the end of a series of events.

t: 使筋疲力尽；用尽；详尽论述
words.s: Car exhaust causes serious pollution in towns.
words.sz: 汽车尾气在城镇里造成了严重的污染。
words.d: To exhaust someone is to make that person tired.

words.s: The cat slowly crept down the tree.
words.d: To creep is to move quietly and slowly.

words.s: She put the strap of her purse over her shoulder and walked out the door.
words.d: A strap is a thin long piece of fabric used to fasten, carry, or hold something.

words.s: That isn't wine. It's grape juice.
words.sz: 這不是葡萄酒，是葡萄汁。

t: 确信； 坚定的信仰； 说服， 信服； 定罪， 判罪
学者； 奖学金获得者
words.s: He is something of a scholar.
words.sz: 他有几分像学者。
words.d: A scholar is a person who studies something and knows a lot about it.

t: 稻草； 麦秆吸管， 吸管
words.s: I drank the orange juice through a straw.
words.d: A straw is a thin tube that is used to suck liquid into the mouth.

t: 想象力； 梦幻； 视力， 视觉
words.s: My vision is getting worse these days.
words.sz: 这些天我的视力正在变差。
words.d: Vision is the ability to see.

t: 陪伴， 陪同， 伴随； 为…伴奏
words.s: She will accompany me on the piano.
words.sz: 她會彈鋼琴為我伴奏。
words.d: To accompany other people means to join them or go with them.

t: 接受； 承认； 容忍
words.d: Acceptance is when people agree that an idea, statement, explanation, etc., is right or true.

words.s: Relativity teaches that light travels at the same speed throughout the universe.
words.d: Relativity is a set of ideas about time and space developed by Albert Einstein.

words.s: Drinking milk every day is beneficial for your bones.
words.d: If something is beneficial, it is good for you.

t: 对付，处理；与…交涉；阻截，擒抱
阻截， 擒抱； 用具， 钓具； 辘轳， 滑车
words.s: Such social problems need to be tackled right away.
words.d: To tackle something means to deal with it in a determined and efficient way.

t: 认为， 估计； 指望， 盼望； 测算， 测量
困惑， 糊涂； 混淆； 骚乱
场合，时刻；重大活动；时机；起因
words.s: What's the happy occasion?
words.sz: 什么事这么开心？

words.s: I told Tom I'd be willing to loan him some money.
words.sz: 我告诉汤姆我愿意借给他一些钱。
words.d: A loan is something, usually money, that one person lends to another.

t: 实质上的， 事实上的， 实际上的
words.s: Because he’s popular, Joe is the virtual leader of the group.
words.d: A virtual thing is very close to being true or accurate.

t: 挤； 握手； 拮据， 紧缺
words.s: When Clara saw her cat, she squeezed it to her face.
words.d: To squeeze something means to press it together and hold it tightly.

t: 空白的；茫然的，无表情的
words.s: She got a blank piece of paper to draw on.
words.d: When something is blank, it does not have anything on it.

t: 地主， 房东； 店主
words.s: The landlord says he wants to raise the rent.
words.sz: 東家說要提高租金。
words.d: A landlord is a man who rents property to a person.

t: 会议， 一届会期； 集会
words.s: Every three months, the managers met in a session to discuss regional sales.
words.d: A session is a meeting at a regular time in order to discuss and solve an issue.

words.s: His behavior is worthy of respect.
words.sz: 他的行为值得尊重。

t: 期待， 期望， 预期； 前程， 成功的前景
标题， 题目； 称号， 头衔； 权利， 权益
words.s: What is the title of your new book?
words.sz: 你新書的書名是什麼？

words.s: Down in the valley a mist like a white feather rose gently into a white cloud, and obscured everything.
words.sz: 山谷中，薄霧如白色羽毛般緩緩升騰，化作一團白雲，遮蔽了一切。
words.d: Mist is water that can be seen in the air or on a surface.

words.s: The girls watched television for the duration of the evening.
words.d: The duration of an event is the time during which it happens.

words.s: In the 1800s, there were many cotton plantations in the southern US.
words.d: A plantation is a big farm that only grows certain kinds of crops.

t: 不顾， 不理， 忽视
words.s: It wouldn't be wise to ignore Tom completely.
words.sz: 完全忽视汤姆不会是明智的。
words.d: To ignore something is to act like you do not see or hear it.

words.s: I just remembered that I was supposed to buy a loaf of bread.
words.sz: 我才想起来我之前该买个面包。
words.d: A loaf of bread is bread shaped and baked in one piece.

t: 核子的， 核能的， 核武器的； 核心的
words.s: All of us would like to get rid of nuclear weapons.
words.sz: 我們所有的人都想除掉核子武器。
words.d: A nuclear thing relates to the division or joining of atoms.

t: 招待会， 欢迎会； 接受； 接待； 接收效果
外面的； 外表的； 向外的
[用于加强语气]非常的；该死的；流血的；嗜杀的

words.s: They referred to Chaucer as the father of English poetry.
words.sz: 他們視喬叟為英詩之父。

words.s: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.
words.sz: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。

words.s: There was some chewing gum stuck to the sole of Tom's shoe.
words.sz: 汤姆的鞋底粘了口香糖。
words.d: A sole person or thing is the only one.

words.s: The jury looked shocked.
words.sz: 陪審團看起來很震驚。
words.d: A jury is a group of people that listen to a trial and say if someone is guilty.

t: 神圣的， 圣洁的， 虔诚的
拼字， 拼法， 拼写法
words.s: You must be more careful about spelling and punctuation.
words.sz: 你得要更注意拼字和標點符號。

t: 放松， 松弛； 放宽， 缓和
words.s: Tom wanted to stay home and relax instead of hiking with his children.
words.sz: 汤姆想待在家休息而不是和他的孩子们出去远足。
words.d: To relax is to rest or do something enjoyable.

words.s: My brother has become a priest.
words.sz: 我的兄弟已经成为了牧师。
words.d: A priest is a person trained to perform religious duties.

t: 班长；监视器，检测器；显示器
words.s: The teacher monitors the students when they take tests.
words.d: To monitor people or things is to watch them closely.

t: 允许， 许可， 准许
words.s: The teacher granted me permission to go home early.
words.sz: 老師允許我提前回家。
words.d: Permission means the act of allowing some action.

t: 宏伟的； 重大的； 傲慢的； 派头大的； 绝佳的； 全部的
words.s: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.
words.sz: 一等奖是公主的香吻。
words.d: Something grand is big and liked by people.

t: 时刻表，日程安排表；清单，明细表
words.s: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
words.sz: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？
words.d: A schedule is a plan that tells you when to do things.

t: 驯服的，顺从的；沉闷的，乏味的
制服， 控制并利用； 驯化， 驯服
words.s: The tame bird rested in his hand.
words.d: A tame animal is not afraid to be near people.

t: 物质的， 实体的； 肉体的； 重要的， 实质性的
words.s: She is collecting material for a book.
words.sz: 她为一本书收集材料。
words.d: A material is what is used to make something.

t: 宇宙， 世界； 领域， 范围
words.s: The universe is limitless.
words.sz: 宇宙浩瀚無邊。

t: 解释， 说明； 口译
words.s: It is difficult to interpret while someone is speaking.
words.d: When you interpret something, you find its meaning, often by changing it into a different language.

t: 壮观的演出； 惊人之举
words.s: These fireworks are spectacular!
words.sz: 这些焰火真壮观！
words.d: If something is spectacular, it looks or sounds very impressive.

words.s: What did Tom inherit?
words.sz: 湯姆繼承了什麼？
words.d: To inherit is to receive something that is passed down from a relative.

t: 奇怪的， 古怪的； 特有的
words.s: That's peculiar.
words.sz: 奇怪。

t: 毛毯， 毯子， 羊毛毯
words.s: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
words.sz: 給我一個枕頭和毛毯好嗎？
words.d: A blanket is a piece of cloth that people use to keep warm or to sit upon.

t: 授予， 给予； 同意
words.s: The teacher granted us a break after studying hard all day.
words.d: To grant something is to allow someone to have it.

t: 注射， 注入； 充满
words.s: I need to give you an injection.
words.sz: 我得给你打一针。

words.s: I envy the friendship Tom and Mary have.
words.sz: 我羨慕Tom和Mary之間的友誼。
words.d: To envy someone is to wish that you had something that other person has.

words.s: We all went into the hut to sleep.
words.d: A hut is a house made of wood, grass, or mud that has only one or two rooms.

t: 不能征服的， 无敌的
将…打折扣； 不信； 漠视， 低估
words.s: For quantities of 20 or more, we can allow you a special discount of 10% on the prices quoted.
words.sz: 20个以上九折特惠。

t: 转变， 转化； 改变
words.s: The man converted his messy field into a garden of flowers.
words.d: To convert something means to change it into something else.

t: 建筑物； 构想， 观念
words.s: After reading his books I feel I can construct a house.
words.sz: 讀完他的書後，我覺得我可以構建一棟房子。
words.d: To construct something means to make or build it.

t: 尝试， 试图， 努力
words.s: He failed in his attempt to swim across the river.
words.sz: 他试图游过河，但是失败了。
words.d: An attempt is an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult.

t: 厚的，密的，浓的；不清楚的，口音重的
words.s: The ice was thick enough for me to walk on.
words.sz: 冰厚得足以让我在上面走路。
words.d: A thick thing is wide and solid.

t: 分， 分配； 除法； 分歧； 分裂
words.s: The children haven't studied division yet.
words.sz: 孩子們還沒上過除法。

words.s: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
words.sz: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。
words.d: An executive is the top manager of a business.

t: 航行， 航海， 航空； 导航， 领航
融化； 熔化； 消散
words.s: The snow will melt when the sun comes out.
words.sz: 太阳一出来，雪就会融化。

words.s: Hang your coat on the hook.
words.sz: 把你的外套掛在鉤子上。
words.d: A hook is a sharp curved piece of metal used for catching or holding things.

t: 不新鲜的； 陈腐的， 过时的
words.s: The cookies sat on the table so long that they became stale.
words.d: If food is stale, then it is not fresh but dry, hard, and not good to eat.

t: 天平； 平衡； 结存， 结欠
words.s: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
words.sz: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。
words.d: Balance is when two or more things are equal.

words.s: Tom lit his cigar.
words.sz: 湯姆點了雪茄。

t: 行动； 已做的事； 作用， 功能； 情节
words.s: Action speaks louder than words, but not nearly as often.
words.sz: 行胜于言，但并不是所有情况都是这样。

words.s: A stage has been set up in the stadium.
words.sz: 體育場內已搭建起舞台。

t: 然而， 但是， 尽管
words.s: My sister loves horror movies, whereas I prefer comedies.
words.d: You use whereas to show how two things are different.

t: 投， 掷； 架设， 搭， 营； 颠簸
球场；程度，强度；高度；音高；沥青
投掷；使猛然倒下；表达；把…定于特定程度；定调
words.s: This is a good place to pitch a tent.
words.sz: 这是搭帐篷的好地方。

words.s: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
words.sz: 善良是聾子能聽盲人能看的語言。

t: 收养关系的； 采用的

words.s: Mom chopped some vegetables to put into the stew.
words.d: To chop something means to cut it into pieces with a tool.

words.s: Keep away from the electrical equipment.
words.sz: 遠離電器設備。

t: 塑像， 雕像， 铸像
words.s: The statue of Hachiko, the faithful dog, stands in front of Shibuya Station.
words.sz: 忠犬八公的雕像伫立在涩谷站前。
words.d: A statue is a three-dimensional work of art, usually made of clay, marble, or metal.

t: 存在； 生物， 生命
words.s: Being a good conversationalist does not just mean being a good speaker of English.
words.sz: 作為一個良好的交談者，並不只意味著作一個英語說得好的說話者。

t: 敏感的， 灵敏的， 神经过敏的； 容易生气的， 易受伤害的
words.s: Cats' eyes are very sensitive to light.
words.sz: 猫的眼睛对光很敏感。
words.d: A sensitive person or thing is easily hurt.

t: 分类， 分级， 分类法； 类别， 级别
words.s: According to scientific classification, a duck-billed platypus is an egg-laying mammal.
words.d: Classification means putting things into categories or groups that have things in common.

t: 空的， 未被占用的； 空缺的； 茫然的， 空虚的
words.s: There were several rooms still vacant.
words.sz: 还有几间空房。

words.s: France is running a welfare state it can no longer afford.
words.sz: 法國是一個福利國家，但它卻不再能夠負擔得起了。
words.d: To afford something means to have enough money to pay for it.

t: 在地下，往地下；秘密地，不公开地
地下的；秘密的，不公开的
words.s: Subway trains travel underground.
words.d: An underground action happens below the surface of the Earth.

t: 天谴； 祸害， 祸根
words.s: The witch cursed the village.
words.d: To curse someone is to hope that bad things happen to that person.

words.s: You never get a second chance to make a first impression.
words.sz: 你永遠沒有第二次機會去打造第一印象。
words.d: An impression is the way of thinking about someone or something.

words.s: He is fond of watching baseball games on TV.
words.sz: 他喜歡看電視上的棒球比賽。

t: 间隔， 间距； 幕间休息
words.s: Tony rested for brief intervals while he worked in the yard.
words.d: An interval is the time between two things happening.

words.s: Jo and Ken evaluated the plan and agreed that it would work.
words.d: To evaluate something means to study it, so a decision can be made.

words.s: Something must be wrong with the machinery.
words.sz: 這個機器一定有什麼地方不對勁。

t: 地位， 身份； 情形， 状况
words.s: She had achieved the status of being the smartest girl in the class.
words.d: Status is the position of something or someone in relation to others.

t: 心烦的， 苦恼的； 不适的
使心烦意乱，使苦恼，使不适；搅乱；弄翻，倾覆
words.s: Don't get an upset stomach by eating too much.
words.sz: 不要因为吃得太多而扰乱胃的正常消化。

t: 推断结果， 结论； 推论， 推理， 推断

words.s: The road curves to the left and to the right.
words.d: To curve is to move in a line that bends and does not go straight.

t: 撇去， 掠过， 擦过； 浏览， 略读

words.s: Acid rain is not a natural phenomenon.
words.sz: 酸雨不是自然现象。
words.d: A phenomenon is something that can be seen as it is happening.

t: 通知， 告知， 报告
words.s: The teacher notified us about a change to our assignment.
words.d: To notify someone of something is to tell them about it.

words.s: He knows German and French, not to mention English.
words.sz: 不提英语，他还会说德语和法语。
words.d: To mention something is to talk about it.

words.s: A stream of people came out of the theater.
words.sz: 剧场里涌出一大群人。

t: 洗衣房， 洗衣店； 待洗的衣服， 洗好的衣服
words.s: I don't like to use liquid laundry detergent.
words.sz: 我不喜歡用洗衣液。
words.d: Laundry is clothes that have been or need to be washed.

words.s: The mail accumulated in their mailbox while they were on vacation.
words.d: To accumulate something is to collect a lot of it over time.

words.s: There were three uniformed police officers at the crime scene.
words.sz: 犯罪现场有三名穿制服的警察。
words.d: If someone commits a crime, he or she does something bad that can be punished by law.

t: 举起，提起，拉起，拖；扔；发出
举起； 起伏， 升降

words.s: She spends her leisure time making dolls.
words.sz: 她利用空闲时间做布娃娃。

words.s: A good mother will nourish her baby every day.
words.d: To nourish is to give someone or something the food needed to live.

words.s: We surrounded the suspect on all four sides.
words.d: To surround something is to close in on it from all sides.

words.s: Entering the house, I tripped over the mat.
words.sz: 进家门后，我被垫子绊倒了。

t: 香烟， 纸烟， 卷烟
words.s: He stopped for a quick cigarette.
words.sz: 他停下来抽根烟。
words.d: A cigarette is a thinly wrapped paper tube filled with tobacco that is smoked.

t: 火炬， 火把； 手电筒
words.s: He grabbed a piece of wood and stuck it in the fire in order to make a torch.
words.d: A torch is a stick with one end on fire that can be carried in order to give light.

t: 确实的， 明确的； 积极的， 肯定的
words.s: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.
words.sz: 试着用积极的态度去面对任何事情。
words.d: If something is positive, it is good.

words.s: I'm sure you'll love what we have on the menu tonight.
words.sz: 我肯定你会喜欢我们今晚的菜肴。

t: 前景， 前途， 可能性； 景象， 景色； 可能成为主顾的人； 有希望的候选人
words.s: He wakes up every morning with the prospect of having a good day.
words.d: A prospect is a possibility that something will happen.

words.s: The ship is not equipped with radar.
words.sz: 这艘船没有雷达装备。

t: 可比较的； 类似的； 比得上的
旋转， 转动； 轮流
words.s: An airplane’s propellers rotate quickly to help it fly.
words.d: To rotate something means to turn it around in a circle.

t: 例子， 实例， 事例
words.s: I have never experienced an instance of hate. Have you?
words.d: An instance is an example of something.

words.s: Tom is an opera fan.
words.sz: 湯姆是歌劇愛好者。

t: 大概， 可能， 据推测

words.s: Do you have a guilty conscience?
words.sz: 是你心里有鬼吧？
words.d: Your conscience is your inner sense of what is right and wrong.

t: 题目； 学科； 主语
words.s: What subject do you think he is interested in?
words.sz: 你觉得他会对什么主题感兴趣？
words.d: To subject is to cause or force someone or something to experience something harmful or unpleasant.

t: 几乎， 简直； 实际上
words.s: Tom would do practically anything to keep Mary happy.
words.sz: 為了哄瑪莉開心，湯姆幾乎會做任何事。

t: 认出， 识别； 承认； 赏识， 表彰， 报偿
words.s: She gave me a smile of recognition.
words.sz: 她給了我一個認可的微笑。
words.d: Recognition is the act of getting praise from other people.

words.s: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
words.sz: 我在那商店花低價買了臺錄像機。
