t: 刀刃， 刀片， 叶片
整理， 排列， 安排； 准备工作
收入， 收益； 税收， 岁入
words.s: The new products really increased the business’s monthly revenue.
words.d: Revenue is the income made by a company.

words.s: He had long strips of film that held images of his trip abroad.
words.d: A strip is a long, narrow piece of material or land.

t: 解决； 解决办法； 溶液
words.s: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
words.sz: 必须有外交解决的途径。
words.d: A solution is a way to solve a problem.

t: 连续不断的； 延伸的
对手， 敌手， 对抗者
words.s: On the field, our opponents were too good for us.
words.d: An opponent is a person or group trying to defeat another person or group.

words.s: When he stepped on the gas pedal, the motorcycle accelerated.
words.d: To accelerate means to increase in speed.

t: 向后的，倒的；落后的，进步慢的
words.s: He bent over backward to please his wife.
words.sz: 他竭尽全力地讨好他老婆。

t: 谷物， 谷粒； 颗粒； 少量， 微量
words.s: There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.
words.sz: 他说的话全不可信。
words.d: A grain is a food crop such as wheat, corn, rice, or oats.

t: 住处， 住宅； 居住； 居住资格
信贷，赊欠；赞扬，荣誉；学分；信任
相信； 把…记入贷方； 把…归于
words.s: It makes sense to pay off your credit card balance every month.
words.sz: 每个月还清信用卡负债很重要。
words.d: Credit is something good in your favour.

t: 不顾后果地； 不管怎样， 无论如何

words.s: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.
words.sz: 我们缺氧时就会打哈欠。
words.d: Oxygen is a gas that all living things need to breathe.

t: 加强的； 精深的， 透彻的； 精耕细作的
改变， 变更， 变动
words.s: I altered the color of my nails to match my hair.
words.d: To alter something means to change it.

t: 结合， 联合； 化合
联合企业； 联合收割机
words.s: Mina combined peanut butter and jelly to make a sandwich.
words.d: To combine is to join together to make a single thing or group.

words.s: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
words.sz: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。
words.d: An ideal thing is the best that it can possibly be.

t: 举止， 风度； 方位， 方向感； 影响
发生， 出现， 存在； 被想起， 被想到
words.s: Traffic accidents are likely to occur on rainy days.
words.sz: 下雨天容易發生交通事故。
words.d: To occur means to happen.

words.s: I can't find the broom.
words.sz: 我找不到掃把了。
words.d: A broom is a brush with a long handle used for cleaning floors.

t: 建立， 设立， 确立； 企业； 当权人物

words.s: I'm under so much pressure, I just want to cry.
words.sz: 我壓力好大，我真想哭。
words.d: Pressure is what you apply to make someone do something.

words.s: The breeze caused the leaves to fall off the tree.
words.d: A breeze is a soft wind.

t: 垃圾，废物；拙劣的文学作品；没用的人，社会渣滓，败类
words.s: They fine you in Singapore if you throw trash in the streets.
words.sz: 在新加坡的街道上扔垃圾会被罚款。
words.d: Trash is waste material or unwanted or worthless things.

words.s: You're a good painter, aren't you?
words.sz: 你是個很棒的畫家，不是嗎？

t: 角； 号角； 警报器
words.s: The boy honked his horn as he rode his bicycle past the house.
words.d: A horn is a device that makes a loud noise.

t: 推论， 推断； 猜想
words.s: By the position of the sun in the sky, she inferred that it was noon.
words.d: To infer something is to decide it is true based on other information one has.

t: 罗盘， 指南针； 圆规； 界限， 范围
words.s: Compass needles point to the north.
words.sz: 指南针的指针指向北边。

t: 出身背景， 经历； 背景资料； 背景， 底子
words.s: There is a castle in the background of the picture.
words.sz: 图片的背景是一座城堡。
words.d: A background is a person’s education, family, and experience.

t: 痛的；恼火的；急剧的，剧烈的
words.s: I have a very sore arm where you hit me.
words.sz: 你打在我手臂上的地方超级痛。
words.d: Sore means feeling or causing pain.

t: 处理， 解决； 使倾向于
words.s: He disposed of the can by throwing it into the recycle bin.
words.d: To dispose of something means to get rid of it.

words.s: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
words.sz: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。
words.d: A curtain is a cloth hung over a window or used to divide a room.

words.s: A day without laughter is a day wasted.
words.sz: 没有笑声的一天肯定是最为虚度的一天。
words.d: Laughter is the sound produced by laughing about something funny.

t: 宪法， 章程； 组成； 设立
words.s: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.
words.sz: 平等是由宪法保障的。
words.d: A constitution is a document of principles for a government.

words.s: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
words.sz: 將混合物攪拌均勻。
words.d: To blend is to mix two or more things together so that they become one thing.

t: 证书， 证件， 执照
words.s: I was given a certificate for completing the computer course.
words.d: A certificate is a document that says that something is true or happened.

t: 凌乱状态，混乱的局面；困境
弄糟， 弄脏， 搞乱
words.s: My brother's room is always a mess.
words.sz: 我弟弟的房间总是很乱。
words.d: A mess is a condition that is not clean or neat.

t: 酸的；馊的，酸味的；脾气坏的
变酸， 变馊； 变得乖戾
words.s: The grapefruit tastes very sour.
words.sz: 柚子很酸。
words.d: When something is sour, it has a sharp and unpleasant taste.

words.s: I wish I could figure out how to delete my Facebook account.
words.sz: 我希望我能知道如何刪除我的Facebook帳號。
words.d: To delete something means to remove or erase written material.

t: 胡说， 废话； 冒失的行动
words.s: That's nonsense. Nobody but a fool would believe it.
words.sz: 那是無稽之談。只有傻瓜才會相信。
words.d: Nonsense are words or ideas that are silly or foolish.

words.s: He had a red stain on the collar of his shirt.
words.d: A stain is a dirty mark that is difficult to clean.

t: 使改观， 改革； 变换， 把…转换成
words.s: The education system has been completely transformed.
words.d: To transform something is to change it in a very significant way.

words.s: Tom has natural leadership ability.
words.sz: 湯姆天生具有領導能力。

t: 真的， 真正的； 真诚的
words.s: This might not be a genuine diamond.
words.sz: 這可能不是真的鑽石。
words.d: When something is genuine, it is true or real.

words.s: The X-ray showed two broken fingers.
words.sz: X光片显示两根手指断了。

t: 身体的； 物理的； 物质的， 有形的
words.s: Biking is good for your physical health.
words.d: If something is physical, it is related to your body and not your mind.

t: 履行， 实现， 完成； 满足， 使满意
坏的， 令人厌恶的； 淘气的， 顽皮的
words.s: My boss is a very wicked man.
words.d: A wicked person is very bad or evil.

words.s: I used the Pythagorean theorem to solve the equation.
words.d: An equation is a math operation to determine the value of something.

words.s: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.
words.sz: 今天你们俩很让人印象深刻。我为你们感到骄傲。

t: 使恶化， 加重； 使化合， 使合成
words.s: Do you know what compound words are?
words.sz: 你知道什么是复合词吗？
words.d: A compound is an enclosed area such as a prison or factory.

words.s: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.
words.sz: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
words.d: The structure involves the shape and organization of the parts of a building or group.

t: 强烈， 剧烈； 强度
桩；利害关系；股份；赌金，赌注
words.s: I felt that my honor was at stake.
words.sz: 我覺得我的名譽受到了威脅。
words.d: A stake is a small, sharp piece of wood or metal that is put into the ground.

t: 非同寻常的， 特别的
words.s: Tom is an extraordinary man.
words.sz: 汤姆是个不寻常的人。
words.d: Extraordinary things are amazing.

t: 目击； 为…作证， 证明
words.s: The woman was the only witness of the horrible crime.
words.d: A witness is someone who sees or hears a crime or accident happen.

t: 吸引， 吸引力； 引力； 具有吸引力的事物
words.s: The coral reef is the region's prime attraction.
words.sz: 珊瑚礁是这个地区的主要景点。

t: 普通的； 习惯的， 常规的； 因循守旧的
words.s: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
words.sz: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。

t: 规章， 规则； 管理， 控制； 调节
智力测验； 谜， 难题， 令人费解的事； 困惑， 迷惑
words.s: Have you worked the puzzle out?
words.sz: 你解开谜团了吗？
words.d: A puzzle is something that is hard to understand.

t: 循环； 流传； 发行， 流通

words.s: My sister is a good cook. She bakes delicious cakes.
words.d: To bake means to cook food in an oven.

words.s: You're no longer a mere child.
words.sz: 你不再只是一个孩子了。
words.d: Mere is used to emphasize how small or unimportant something or someone is.

words.s: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
words.sz: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。
words.d: Evident means easy to see or understand.

t: 郊区， 郊外， 近郊
words.s: I grew up in the suburbs, only a few minutes outside of the city.
words.d: A suburb is a small part of a large city.

words.s: During our ski trip, we stayed at a lodge.
words.d: A lodge is a house in the mountains used by people who hunt or fish.

t: 威胁， 恐吓； 凶兆， 征兆
words.s: Due to the dark clouds, there was a threat of a bad storm.
words.d: A threat is something bad that might happen.

words.s: Every great writer seems to have been interested in English.
words.sz: 每一個偉大的作家似乎已經對英語感興趣。

t: 乳房； 胸脯， 胸膛
words.s: She was diagnosed with breast cancer.
words.d: A breast is one of the two soft parts on a woman’s chest.

t: 发明， 创造； 捏造
words.s: The washing machine is a wonderful invention.
words.sz: 洗衣機是一個很棒的發明。

t: 仁慈， 宽容； 恩惠； 幸运
words.s: The poor people were at the mercy of the cruel dictator.
words.sz: 可憐的人民任憑殘暴的獨裁者處置。
words.d: Mercy is a feeling or act of kindness.

words.s: He made mistakes on purpose to annoy me.
words.sz: 他为了惹恼我故意犯错。

t: 鬈发； 卷曲， 卷曲物

words.s: We should inform them about that.
words.sz: 我们应该把那件事情告知他们。
words.d: To inform someone is to tell them about something.

words.s: Some furniture is put together with glue.
words.sz: 一些家具是用膠水黏在一起。

t: 犯， 干； 使承诺； 把…托付给； 调拨…供使用， 拨出
words.s: Why do people commit suicide?
words.sz: 为什么人们会自杀?
words.d: To commit to something is to promise to do it.

words.s: I heard Tom scream.
words.sz: 我听到汤姆尖叫。
words.d: To scream means to make a loud noise with your mouth.

t: 悲痛， 悲哀， 悲伤； 伤心事， 不幸的事
words.s: No words can express her deep sorrow.
words.sz: 她的悲伤无法言喻。
words.d: Sorrow is a very sad feeling.

t: 发出撞击声；垮台，破产；冲，闯
words.s: His wife is in the hospital because she was injured in a car crash.
words.sz: 他的妻子在醫院裡因為她在一場車禍中受傷了。
words.d: To crash means to hit and break something.

t: 补丁；斑，与周围不同的部分；一小块地
性格， 特性； 性质； 人物， 角色； 符号； 字
words.s: Who's your favorite character in this book?
words.sz: 你最喜歡這本書中的哪個角色？
words.d: Your character is your personality.

t: 反映， 显示； 反射， 映现； 深思， 考虑， 反省
words.s: Her face was reflected in the smooth glass.
words.d: To reflect is when a surface sends back light, heat, sound or an image.

t: 贡献， 促成作用； 捐款， 捐献物； 稿件
猛击， 猛撞； 发出砰的一声， 砰砰地响
意义， 意思； 目的； 重要性
words.s: I can't remember the meaning of the word that I looked up yesterday.
words.sz: 我记不起昨天查的那个词的意思了。

words.s: I am quite ignorant of their plan.
words.sz: 他们的计划我一无所知。
words.d: If someone is ignorant about something, they have no knowledge about it.

words.s: It'll be hard to find a good vocalist who isn't already working with another band.
words.sz: 很難找到一位沒有在其他樂團工作的優秀主唱。
words.d: A band is a group of people who play music.

words.s: It takes 165 years for Neptune to orbit around the sun.
words.sz: 海王星繞行太陽一周要花一百六十五年。
words.d: To orbit something means to move around it in a continuous, curving path.

t: 包含， 包括， 构成
words.s: Our school’s football team is mostly comprised with seniors.
words.d: If something comprises something else, it consists of or is made up of it.

t: 中等的； 温和的， 稳健的； 有节制的
和缓， 减轻； 节制
words.s: Moderate exercise will refresh both mind and body.
words.sz: 适度的运动让身心焕然一新。
words.d: When something is moderate, it is not too big or too small in size or amount.

t: 居住的， 定居的； 住校的， 住院的

words.s: Mary carries pepper spray in her purse.
words.sz: 瑪麗的包裡有辣椒噴霧。

t: 区别， 辨别， 识别； 使显出特色， 使杰出
words.s: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
words.sz: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

t: 发明， 创造； 捏造
words.s: My grandfather has invented some interesting things.
words.d: To invent is to create something that never existed before.

words.s: I consider myself fairly fluent in French.
words.sz: 我认为自己的法语相当流利。
words.d: If someone is fluent in a language, then they are able to speak it very well.

t: 可观的， 大量的； 结实的， 坚固的； 实质的， 真实的
words.s: The bank said that he owed it a substantial amount of money.
words.d: If something is substantial, then it is of great importance, size, or value.

t: 将…处死； 实施， 执行
words.s: We must execute his orders.
words.sz: 我们必须执行他的命令。
words.d: To execute means to kill someone as a legal punishment.

t: 利益，恩惠；救济金，保险金，津贴
words.s: Being able to fly is a benefit to birds.
words.d: A benefit is a good thing.

words.s: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
words.sz: 好几间小屋被洪水孤立起来了。
words.d: A flood is an event in which water covers an area that is usually dry.

words.s: Carrots contain a lot of vitamin A.
words.sz: 胡蘿蔔中含有大量的維生素A。

t: 意图， 意向， 目的
words.s: Tom has no intention of asking Mary to the upcoming dance.
words.sz: Tom没有意图去邀请Mary去即将来临的舞会。
words.d: An intention is what a person plans to do.

t: 粗鲁的， 不礼貌的； 粗糙的， 粗陋的
words.s: He should apologize for being rude to the guests.
words.sz: 他应该为自己对客人的粗鲁无礼而道歉。

t: 症状； 征候， 征兆
words.s: Sneezing and a high fever are symptoms of the common cold.
words.d: A symptom of a bad condition or illness is a sign that it is happening.

words.s: A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.
words.sz: 巨大的柱子遮住了视线，让人看不到湖。

t: 因此， 从而， 由此
words.s: He didn’t score a goal, thereby ending his chance at setting a record.
words.d: If we say that thereby something happens, we mean it is a result of something else.

t: 唯一的， 独一无二的； 极不寻常的， 极好的
words.s: These flowers have a unique smell.
words.sz: 這些花有一種獨特的氣味。
words.d: A unique person or thing is not like others.

t: 葬礼， 丧礼， 丧葬
words.s: At lunchtime today, our usual restaurant was closed because of a funeral in the family.
words.sz: 今天午餐時間，我們常去的飯館關門了，因為他們家在辦喪事。
words.d: A funeral is a ceremony that takes place after a person dies.

t: 提高，使增长；推动，激励；替…做广告，宣扬
提高， 增长； 推动， 激励
words.s: Lowering prices boosts customers’ interest in shopping.
words.d: To boost something means to increase or improve it.

words.s: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
words.sz: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。
words.d: A sincere person is honest, especially about emotions or opinions.

words.s: I have three dogs. One is male and the other two are female.
words.sz: 我有三只狗，其中一只是公的，另外两只是母的。
words.d: Male refers to men or boys.

words.s: The Ministry of Trade is responsible for taxing imports and exports.
words.d: A ministry is a government department.

t: 宗教的； 笃信宗教的， 虔诚的
words.s: He is not religious.
words.sz: 他不信教。
words.d: Religious means related to or about religion.

words.s: He is usually friendly. Nevertheless, he wasn’t friendly this afternoon.
words.d: Nevertheless shows a difference to what is expected or known.

t: 突出的， 杰出的； 突起的， 凸出的
words.s: Queen Victoria was a prominent person in history.
words.d: When something is prominent, it is important and well known.

t: 掩蔽处，躲避处；住所；掩蔽，保护
掩蔽， 庇护； 躲避
words.s: Children depend on their parents for food, clothing and shelter.
words.sz: 孩子们的衣食住行靠的是他们的父母。
words.d: A shelter is a place to go that is safe from danger or bad weather.

words.s: A diamond is one of the most expensive jewels in the world.
words.d: A jewel is a beautiful stone that is worth a lot of money.

t: 协会， 团体； 联合， 交往
words.s: I applied for membership in the association.
words.sz: 我申請成為協會會員。

words.s: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
words.sz: 無須多言，基本人權應當被尊重。
words.d: If something is fundamental, it is a basic part of something.

t: 消灭， 消除， 排除； 淘汰
words.s: Wearing a seatbelt eliminates some of the dangers of driving a car.
words.d: To eliminate something that is unwanted means to completely remove it.

t: 全球的， 全世界的； 总的， 完整的
words.s: Global warming worries scientists.
words.sz: 全球變暖讓科學家擔心。
words.d: If something is global, it happens all around the world.

words.s: His golden ticket entitled him to sit in the front row at the concert.
words.d: To entitle someone means to give them the right to have or do something.

words.s: Line art emphasizes form and outline, over color, shading, and texture.
words.sz: 線條藝術強調形式和輪廓，而不是顏色、陰影和紋理。
words.d: An outline is the plan for a story or essay.

words.s: The piece of cloth I found was old and faded.
words.d: To fade is to become quieter or less bright.

words.s: You don't have to go to the party unless you want to.
words.sz: 除非你想去,否則你不必去這個派對。
words.d: Unless means if not or except when.

words.s: The life span of a butterfly is short.
words.sz: 蝴蝶的寿命短。

t: 超越； 过量， 过度
words.s: Excess of politeness is annoying.
words.sz: 禮貌過度是煩人的。
words.d: An excess is an amount of something that is more than needed or wanted.

words.s: She glanced behind her to see if he was looking at her.
words.d: To glance at something means to look at it quickly.

t: 视角， 观点； 远景， 景观； 透视画法， 透视图

words.s: I don't know anything about their relationship.
words.sz: 我對他們的關係一無所知。
words.d: The relationship between two or more people is the way in which they behave toward each other.

t: 等同， 平等， 相等
words.s: Equality is guaranteed by the Constitution.
words.sz: 平等是由宪法保障的。

t: 破坏， 毁灭， 消灭
words.s: The wildfires left the forest in a state of destruction.
words.d: To damage something is to cause its destruction.

t: 极其， 非常； 僵硬地
硬的，僵直的；不灵活的；拘谨的，生硬的；费劲的；强烈的
words.s: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
words.sz: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。

t: 词语； 表达； 表情
words.s: That expression is archaic.
words.sz: 那種表達方式已經過時了。

t: 入侵， 侵略， 侵袭
words.s: The enemy forces tried to invade our country from the sky.
words.d: To invade is to take over a place by force.

t: 童年， 幼年， 早期
words.s: When I heard that song, it reminded me of my childhood.
words.sz: 我一聽到那首歌，就想起來我小的時候。

words.s: Tina did a thorough job of cleaning the stains out of the carpet.
words.d: If something is thorough, it is complete or done carefully.

t: 感染力， 吸引力； 呼吁， 上诉
words.s: Between you and me, Tom's idea doesn't appeal to me very much.
words.sz: 汤姆的主意我不太感兴趣，这个我们之间说说就好。
words.d: To appeal to someone is to be interesting or attractive.

t: 民主， 民主制； 民主国家
words.s: Democracy is the worst form of government, except all the others that have been tried.
words.sz: 除了那些我们尝试过的政府形态，民主是最差的那种了。

t: 运输， 运送， 客运
words.s: I don’t have a car, so my normal transportation is the train.
words.d: Transportation is any type of vehicle that can carry people or things.

words.s: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
words.sz: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。
words.d: To dye something is to make it a certain color by using a special chemical.

words.s: Many people think that humans evolved from animals.
words.d: To evolve is to change over time.

words.s: The game drew extensive media coverage.
words.d: Extensive means large in size or amount.

t: 贺词； 祝贺， 恭喜
离弃，丢弃；遗弃，抛弃；放弃
words.s: I won't abandon you.
words.sz: 我不会放弃你的。
words.d: To abandon something is to leave it forever or for a long time.

words.s: Tom says that Mary definitely won't accept the job.
words.sz: 湯姆說瑪麗絕不會接受這工作。

words.s: Jim’s father likes to inspire his son by encouraging him to follow his dream.
words.d: To inspire is to encourage someone by making them feel confident and eager to do something.

t: 奇迹般的， 了不起的
家庭的； 家喻户晓的
words.s: She was busy with household work.
words.sz: 她忙於家務。
words.d: A household is all the people who live in one house.

words.s: If you want to be able to calculate the area of a circle, you must study geometry.
words.d: Geometry is the study of shapes and how to measure them.

words.s: The boy-to-girl ratio is one to three.
words.d: A ratio is a relationship between two things expressed in numbers or amounts.

words.s: She devotes two hours a day to playing the piano.
words.d: To devote time to something means to spend a lot of time doing it.

t: 代理人， 代理商； 政府代表； 动因， 原因； 剂
words.s: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
words.sz: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

t: 羊毛； 毛线， 绒线
words.s: Sheep provide us with wool.
words.sz: 绵羊提供我們羊毛。

t: 本能， 天性； 直觉

words.s: My approximate height is two meters.
words.d: Approximate means close to an exact amount, number, or time.

t: 投资， 投入； 授予
words.s: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
words.sz: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
words.d: To invest means to use money in a way that will bring a profit later.

t: 名誉， 名气， 名声
words.s: It's hard to maintain one's reputation.
words.sz: 維持一個人的聲譽是很難的。

t: 伸出； 投射； 预计
方案， 计划； 课题， 项目； 工程
words.s: The company invested a lot of money in this project.
words.sz: 該公司在這個企劃中投入了很多錢。
words.d: A project is a type of work that you do for school or a job.

t: 独立， 自主， 自立
words.s: India gained independence from Britain in 1947.
words.sz: 印度於1947年脫離英國獲得獨立。
words.d: Independence is the state of being free from the control of others.

t: 提供， 显示； 外观， 图像； 授予， 赠送； 报告， 介绍； 表演

words.s: The diameter of the tree was about 60 centimeters.
words.d: The diameter of a round thing is the length across its center.

words.s: My grandparents keep hay in their red barn.
words.d: A barn is a large farm building that houses crops, equipment, and animals.

t: 吠声， 叫声； 树皮
words.s: A dog will bark at strangers.
words.sz: 狗会对陌生人叫。
words.d: To bark is to make a short, loud noise, like a dog.

words.s: He made a loop with the rope and placed it over the post.
words.d: A loop is a line made into the shape of a circle.

t: 阻止， 控制； 抑制， 遏制
words.s: Mike restrained Allen from reaching the door.
words.d: To restrain someone or something means to use physical strength to stop them.

t: 贪吃的； 贪婪的； 渴望的
words.s: Tom certainly is greedy.
words.sz: 湯姆確實貪。

t: 笨拙的， 尴尬的； 难操纵的， 使用不便的； 不灵巧的
words.s: The girl made an awkward bow.
words.sz: 這個女孩做了一把很難使用的弓。
words.d: An awkward thing is embarrassing and uncomfortable.

t: 赤裸的；光秃的，无遮盖的；刚刚够的，勉强的
words.s: It is not easy to catch a hare with your bare hands.
words.sz: 空手赤拳抓野兔並不容易。
words.d: A bare thing is plain and not covered.

words.s: I think exams ruin education.
words.sz: 我认为考试破坏教育。
words.d: To ruin something means to harm or damage it greatly.

t: 起重机， 摄影升降机； 鹤
words.s: The crane, unlike the dog, has never dreamed of flying.
words.sz: 不像狗,這隻鶴從來沒有夢想過飛翔。

words.s: He grew a beard to look more mature.
words.sz: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。
words.d: A beard is hair that grows on a man’s chin and cheeks.

words.s: Tom told me he thought Mary would be impatient.
words.sz: 湯姆告訴我，他以為瑪莉會有耐心。
words.d: To be impatient means to get angry or anxious when something takes too much time.

words.s: I spilled the coffee on the table.
words.d: To spill is to accidentally make something fall out of its container.

words.s: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
words.sz: 南極因為有大陸，所以氣溫低於北極。

t: 搜集， 聚集， 积聚； 收集， 收取； 收藏品， 收集的东西
words.s: I would like to have a look at your collection of stamps.
words.sz: 我想看看您的邮票收藏。

words.s: The gardener turned out to be the murderer.
words.sz: 园丁后来发现就是凶手。

t: 攻取， 征服， 克服
words.s: After the conquest, the people of the small city had no freedom.
words.d: A conquest is an event by which one country takes over another country.

t: 发现； 调查的结果； 裁决
words.s: The rescuers searched the surroundings in hopes of finding the child.
words.sz: 援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。

t: 密集的， 浓厚的； 密度大的
words.s: I easily became lost in the dense forest.
words.d: If something is dense, it has a lot of things close together.

words.s: This laboratory is equipped with the latest computers.
words.sz: 这个实验室配备了最新的计算机。
words.d: A laboratory is a room where a scientist works.

t: 进行检查； 进行视察
words.s: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
words.sz: 先生，我們可以檢查一下您的行李嗎？
words.d: To inspect is to look at something carefully.

t: 参加运动； 参加竞选
有系统的， 有计划的
致命的， 生死攸关的； 极其重要的； 生命的， 有生命力的
words.s: The heart is a vital organ.
words.d: Something vital is necessary for life.

t: 冲突， 抵触， 争论； 战斗， 战争
words.s: He doesn't seem to be aware of the conflict between my father and me.
words.sz: 他似乎不知道我父亲和我之间的纠葛。
words.d: A conflict is a fight between different people or groups.

words.s: I got a farewell present from everyone.
words.sz: 每個人都送了我一份歡送禮物。
words.d: A farewell is an instance of saying goodbye or a way to say it.

t: 允许， 准许； 同意给； 承认； 允许…进入
words.s: For quantities of 20 or more, we can allow you a special discount of 10% on the prices quoted.
words.sz: 20个以上九折特惠。
words.d: To allow something to happen means to let it happen.

t: 用具， 器具， 器械； 家电
words.s: Many homes have appliances like ovens, toasters, and refrigerators.
words.d: An appliance is a piece of equipment used for jobs in the home.

t: 众多，大量；团，块，堆；群众；质量
words.s: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
words.sz: 大量生產降低許多商品的價格。

t: 领主， 君主， 贵族
察觉， 发觉； 侦查出
words.s: The boy ran to the kitchen when he detected the smell of cookies.
words.d: To detect means to notice or find something.

t: 业余爱好的， 业余的； 外行的
words.s: I was still an amateur at that time.
words.sz: 我那時還是個外行。
words.d: An amateur is a person who does something for fun and isn’t paid for it.

words.s: Is it poisonous?
words.sz: 它有毒嗎？

t: 谴责， 指责； 判…刑， 宣告…有罪
words.s: The judge condemned the criminal to five years in prison.
words.d: To condemn someone means to give them a specific punishment.

t: 兽， 野兽， 牲畜； 凶残的人， 令人厌憎的人
words.s: Tanzania is home to many famous beasts, such as lions, leopards, and hyenas.
words.d: A beast is a large and dangerous animal.

words.s: We need assistance.
words.sz: 我們需要幫助。

t: 商业， 贸易； 社交
words.s: English is useful in commerce.
words.sz: 英語在商業中很有用。
words.d: Commerce is the activity of buying and selling things.

t: 承认， 供认； 准许…进入
words.s: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
words.sz: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

words.s: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
words.sz: 攀登富士山後，我得到了一首詩的靈感。
words.d: A poem is a short kind of writing.

t: 兴趣；利益，利害关系；利息
words.s: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
words.sz: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。

words.s: There has been a gulf between James and Tony since their parents died.
words.d: A gulf is a gap between people who do not understand each other.

words.s: He was an excellent scientist, and what is more, was a great poet.
words.sz: 他是一位優秀的科學家，更是一位偉大的詩人。
words.d: A poet is a person who writes poems.

t: 定义， 释义， 定界； 清晰， 鲜明

words.s: I've got to shave before leaving.
words.sz: 離開前我必須刮鬍子。
words.d: To shave means to cut the hairs on one’s face with a sharp tool.

t: 有机体的， 有机物的
words.s: Tom and Mary own a small organic farm.
words.sz: 汤姆和玛丽拥有一个小型的有机农场。
words.d: If food is organic, it is grown without adding chemicals to it.

words.s: He wore a mask so that no one could recognize him.
words.sz: 他戴著面具以至於沒有人認出他。

t: 概括的， 概要的； 实时的， 即决的
words.s: Cindy concluded the meeting with a summary of the project.
words.d: A summary is a short statement that contains the main information about something.

t: 适用； 申请， 请求； 涂， 敷， 施
应用，实施；使用；涂敷；把…施于
words.s: What Tom said doesn't apply in this situation.
words.sz: 汤姆所言不符时局。
words.d: To apply something means to put it on.

words.s: Cars built a hundred years ago are inferior to ones built today.
words.d: An inferior thing is not as good as something else.

words.s: I hear that the number of the unemployed has been increasing recently.
words.sz: 听说最近失业者人数正在增加

t: 忽视； 宽恕； 俯瞰
words.s: These kinds of mistakes are easy to overlook.
words.sz: 这种错误很容易被人忽视。
words.d: To overlook something is to not notice it or to not realize that it is important.

words.s: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.
words.sz: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。

t: 不能相信的， 不可信的； 难以置信的， 不可思议的； 惊人的
words.s: I have an incredible story to tell you about my vacation.
words.d: An incredible thing is so amazing that it is hard to believe.

t: 引人注目的， 激动人心的； 突然的

words.s: Minnesota's state bird is the mosquito.
words.sz: 明尼苏达州的官方鸟就是蚊子。

words.s: When I came home, my sister was playing the guitar.
words.sz: 当我回到家的时候，我妹妹正在弹吉他。

t: 布局， 安排， 设计
words.s: I've changed my website's layout.
words.sz: 我改了一下我网站的版面设计。

t: 人工的， 人为的； 矫揉造作的； 模拟的
words.s: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
words.d: If something is artificial, it was not made naturally but mimics something natural.

words.s: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
words.sz: 有的科學家認為溫室效應是虛構的。

t: 除去， 消除； 移动， 搬迁
公式， 方程式； 原则， 方案； 配方
评论，意见，注释；闲话，议论
words.s: His comment was concise and to the point.
words.sz: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。

t: 反叛，起义；反抗，违抗；厌恶，生反感

words.s: He felt disgust toward his date because she had such terrible eating habits.
words.d: Disgust is a feeling of distaste and anger caused by something rude or unpleasant.

t: 堵住， 止住， 停住
words.s: The rose had a long thin stem.
words.d: The stem of a plant is the stick that grows leaves or flowers.

words.s: Lucy likes to think she started this fashion trend.
words.d: A trend is a general tendency in the way a situation is changing or developing.

t: 完成； 成就， 成绩
words.s: The moon landing was a monumental achievement.
words.sz: 登月是一項里程碑式的成就。

t: 技工， 机修工； 力学， 机械学； 过程， 方法， 技术性细节
words.s: The mechanic assembled the engine.
words.sz: 這名技師組裝了這台引擎。
words.d: A mechanic is someone who fixes vehicles or machines.

t: 值得向往的， 令人满意的
words.s: It is the things that we do not possess which seem to us most desirable.
words.sz: 得不到的东西就最想得到。

t: 阳台； 楼厅， 楼座
words.s: The family is eating breakfast on the balcony.
words.sz: 一家人在陽臺上吃早飯。

t: 由…组成； 在于； 一致
words.s: Today’s choices for lunch consisted of pizza, hamburgers, and hot dogs.
words.d: To consist of certain is to be made of parts or things them.

t: 准备， 预备； 制剂
words.s: We failed due to a lack of preparation.
words.sz: 我們因缺乏準備而失敗了。

words.s: The weather forecast is not reliable at all.
words.sz: 天气预报一点也不可靠。

t: 有关， 涉及； 符合； 相处
words.s: A company’s plan usually relates to how much profit it can make.
words.d: To relate to something means to have a connection with it.

t: 批评家， 爱挑剔的人
words.s: The wine critic tasted the wine so he could give his opinion.
words.d: A critic is someone who gives opinions about movies, books, plays, etc.

words.s: After asking for my key at the front desk, I took the elevator to my floor.
words.sz: 我到櫃檯拿了鑰匙，然後就乘電梯去了我房間的樓層。

words.s: In Esperanto there are only 16 grammar rules.
words.sz: 世界語只有16個語法規則。

words.s: Studying hard will enable the girl to get a good job.
words.d: To enable is to make it possible for something to happen.

t: 初步做法， 起始行为
words.s: The runners must do well in the preliminary races to qualify for the final race.
words.d: Preliminary describes something that happens before a more important event.

t: 依靠的， 依赖的； 取决于…的
words.s: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
words.sz: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

t: 障碍， 障碍物， 妨碍
words.s: Climbing over the giant rock was the biggest obstacle for the hikers.
words.d: An obstacle is an object or a problem that stops you from doing something.

t: 职业； 声明， 表白
words.s: Teaching English is his profession.
words.sz: 教英语是他的职业。
words.d: A profession is a person’s job.

words.s: The batteries in my calculator are dead.
words.sz: 我計算機的電池沒電了。

words.s: Tom was the last one to get in the van.
words.sz: 汤姆是最后一个上面包车的。
words.d: A van is a vehicle that is used for carrying things. It is smaller than a truck.

words.s: He's a professor of biology at Harvard.
words.sz: 他是哈佛大学的生物学教授。
words.d: Biology is the study of living things.

words.s: The early bird catches the worm.
words.sz: 早起的鸟儿有虫吃。
words.d: A worm is a small animal with a long, thin body.

words.s: I compressed my clothes to fit into a single suitcase.
words.d: To compress something means to press or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.

t: 出现； 由…引起； 起身， 起床
words.s: Difficulties arose with his computer because it was old.
words.d: To arise is to happen.

t: 合作的， 协作的， 协力完成的
组成， 形成； 设立； 任命

words.s: Their cattle are all fat.
words.sz: 他們的牛都很肥。

t: 想象， 想象力， 空想； 想象出
words.s: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
words.sz: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

t: 反抗， 抵制； 抵抗力， 抵抗性； 阻力； 电阻

words.s: I found the key underneath the mat.
words.sz: 我在擦鞋墊下面發現了這把鑰匙。
words.d: Underneath means below or under.

t: 托儿所， 保育室； 苗圃
words.s: What's your favorite nursery rhyme?
words.sz: 你最喜歡的兒童歌曲是哪首？
words.d: A nursery is a room where babies and children sleep, play, or are cared for.

t: 伙伴，同事；配偶，配对物；大副
使确信， 使信服， 说服
words.s: She was asked to convince him to get his son or someone else to paint the house.
words.sz: 她被要求去说服他以让他或者他的儿子或者是别的人来粉刷屋子。
words.d: To convince someone means to make that person sure of something.

words.s: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.
words.sz: 公主向皇帝请求饶恕。
words.d: An emperor is the leader of a group of countries.

words.s: Sandy walked slowly across the beach, trying to prolong her lunch break.
words.d: To prolong means to make something last for a longer time.

t: 理论， 原理； 学说； 意见， 看法
words.s: In theory, there is no difference between theory and practice. But, in practice, there is.
words.sz: 理论上说，理论和实践没有区别。但实践上说，是有的。
words.d: A theory is an idea about how something works.

t: 忧虑， 痛苦， 悲伤； 不幸
words.s: We were in great distress when our home was destroyed during the last hurricane.
words.d: Distress is a feeling of sadness and anxiousness.

words.s: Groups of birds will flock to the river in the spring.
words.d: To flock means to gather in one place.

t: 内的； 国内的； 内心的
words.s: We removed the outer case to reveal the computer’s internal wires.
words.d: When something is internal, it exists or happens inside a person, object, or place.

t: 延长部分， 伸展； 电话分机， 分机号码
words.s: This extension cord is too short.
words.sz: 這條延長線太短了。
words.d: An extension is a part added to something to give it more time or space.

t: 署名， 签字， 签名
words.s: I attached my signature to the document.
words.sz: 我簽署了文件。
words.d: A signature is your name, when you write it in your own way.

t: 险峻的， 陡峭的； 过高的； 急剧的
words.s: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
words.sz: 這條小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。
words.d: A steep surface or place has a slope or angle that rises or falls sharply.

words.s: My grandmother has a green thumb.
words.sz: 我祖母是個園藝巧手。

t: 文学的； 文人的， 书卷气的
words.s: He worked hard to create a successful literary career.
words.d: A literary person or thing is involved with literature in some way.

t: 建筑师， 设计师； 缔造者
words.s: A famous architect built this house.
words.sz: 一个有名的建筑师造了这个房子。
words.d: An architect is a person who designs buildings.

words.s: The scar on his forehead is conspicuous.
words.sz: 他額頭上的疤痕很醒目。

words.s: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
words.sz: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
words.d: Classical music is more formal and serious than popular music.

words.s: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
words.sz: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。
words.d: A privilege is a special right given only to a certain person or group of people.

words.s: The rumor was without foundation.
words.sz: 謠言是毫無根據的。
words.d: A foundation is a group that provides money for research.

words.s: When I ran out of juice, I had to substitute water to drink in the morning.
words.d: To substitute something or someone means to have them take the place of another.

t: 猛击； 冲床； 穿孔机； 力量， 效力
当然； 天然地； 天生地
words.s: She naturally accepted the invitation.
words.sz: 當然，她接受了邀請。

t: 灵活性， 机动性， 柔韧性
words.s: Tom lacks flexibility.
words.sz: 汤姆缺乏灵活性。

words.s: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
words.sz: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。

t: 而且， 再者， 此外
words.s: Marianne likes to walk to work to save money; moreover, it is good exercise.
words.d: Moreover is used to introduce information that adds to or supports what has previously been said.

t: 身份； 个性， 特性； 同一性， 一致性
words.s: We know the identity of Tom's killer.
words.sz: 我們知道湯姆的殺手是誰。

t: 撒， 散播； 散开， 驱散
words.s: I accidentally scattered all of my pills.
words.d: To scatter something is to make it go in many places.

t: 安装； 装置， 设施； 就任， 就职

words.s: He devoted the last years of his life to writing his autobiography.
words.sz: 他晚年致力於寫自傳。

words.s: Sometimes federal laws are different from state laws.
words.d: If something is federal, it relates to the government of a country.

t: 违反， 违背； 亵渎； 侵犯； 妨碍
words.s: I was given a ticket because the policeman said I violated a traffic law.
words.d: To violate a law, rule, or agreement means to break it.

t: 证实， 查证， 证明
words.s: I can verify that that's the truth myself.
words.sz: 我自己能够证实那是真的。
words.d: To verify means to find out if something is true.

t: 掌舵， 驾驶； 操纵
words.s: He steered the go-cart around the track.
words.d: To steer something is to control where it goes.

t: 事件， 大事， 事变
words.s: On the whole, the event was successful.
words.sz: 整體而言，這個事件是成功的。
words.d: An event is something that happens, especially something important.

t: 研究会， 学会； 专门学校
words.s: There are many courses taught at the academy that I go to.
words.d: An academy is a special type of school.

t: 经历， 经受， 忍受； 接受
words.s: The cancer patient undergoes treatments twice a week.
words.d: To undergo an action means to have it happen to you.

t: 报答， 酬谢， 奖励
words.s: He is entitled to receive the reward.
words.sz: 他有权得到奖励。
words.d: A reward is something given in exchange for good behavior or work.

words.s: The price does not include the box.
words.sz: 這個價格不包含這個箱子。
words.d: To include something means to have it as part of a group.

t: 同情， 怜悯； 体谅； 赞同
在…旁边， 沿着…的边； 和…在一起
words.s: We work alongside each other in the office.
words.d: If something is alongside another thing, then it is next to it.

t: 吞， 咽； 轻信， 轻易接受； 承受， 使不流露； 咽下口水
经办， 代理； 代理处； 专门行政部门
words.s: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
words.sz: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。
words.d: An agency is a business or service set up to act for others.

t: 礼券， 优惠券， 配给券； 联票； 票证

words.s: The railroad is parallel to the road.
words.sz: 铁路与公路平行。

words.s: The nucleus is made up of many tiny particles.
words.d: The nucleus is the central part of an atom or cell.

t: 迷人的， 有极大吸引力的
摘要， 梗概； 抽象派艺术作品
words.s: Some abstract art is difficult to understand.
words.sz: 一些抽象藝術是很難理解的。
words.d: An abstract thing is an idea or thought, not a physical thing.

words.s: I got a bee sting.
words.sz: 我被蜜蜂蛰了一下。
words.d: To sting is to cause pain by pushing a sharp part into the skin.

t: 急速， 急忙； 草率
words.s: Haste makes waste.
words.sz: 欲速則不達。
words.d: Haste is speed in movement or action.

words.s: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
words.sz: 讓我們繼續進行議程上的項目。
words.d: An agenda is a plan or goal that guides someone’s behavior.

t: 出现， 来到； 外观
words.s: Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.
words.sz: 从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。

t: 液体的； 清澈的； 流畅的
words.s: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
words.sz: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。
words.d: A liquid is a substance that is neither solid nor gas.

t: 文化， 文明； 教养； 培养； 培养菌
words.s: The students are talking about language and culture.
words.sz: 学生们在探讨语言和文化。
words.d: Culture is the music, art, and writings of a certain place or group of people.

words.s: The men are wearing short sleeve shirts.
words.sz: 男人們穿著短袖上衣。
words.d: Sleeves are the part of a shirt in which arms go.

t: 献身， 奉献； 忠实； 热爱； 虔诚
匿名的； 无名的； 无特色的
words.s: You want to remain anonymous.
words.sz: 你想保持匿名身份。
words.d: If someone is anonymous, no one knows who he or she is.

t: 搅拌， 搅动； 激动， 骚乱
words.s: I don't want to stir up old memories.
words.sz: 我不愿意勾起久远的回忆。
words.d: To stir something means to mix it using something small, like a spoon.

words.s: My father is a skilled fisherman.
words.sz: 我爸爸是个钓鱼高手。

t: 持续， 贯穿； 包括； 横跨， 跨越
words.s: The life span of a butterfly is short.
words.sz: 蝴蝶的寿命短。
words.d: To span is to spread across an amount of time or space.

words.s: Tom didn't mean to insult anybody.
words.sz: 湯姆沒想侮辱誰。
words.d: To insult someone is to say things that will hurt the person’s feelings.

t: 存在， 实在， 生存
words.s: Do you believe in the existence of ghosts?
words.sz: 你相信有幽灵吗？

t: 工艺， 手艺； 船， 航空器
words.s: Tom drinks craft beer.
words.sz: 湯姆喝精釀啤酒。
words.d: To craft something is to make it using skill.

t: 民意测验；政治选举，大选
对…进行民意测验； 获得
words.s: The poll showed that many people support the plan to stop gang violence.
words.d: A poll is a survey in which people give their opinions about important things.

t: 杆； 极， 磁极， 电极
words.s: The flag was hanging from the flag pole.
words.d: A pole is a long thin stick made of wood or metal that supports things.

t: 浮动， 漂浮； 飘动
words.s: Oil will float on water.
words.sz: 油漂浮在水上。
words.d: To float is to move on top of water without sinking.

t: 优美的， 优雅的； 得体的
words.s: She is graceful.
words.sz: 她举止优雅。

t: 更可取的， 更好的， 更合意的
提到， 论及； 参考； 引文； 参考书目； 证明书， 证明人
words.s: My supervisor made a reference to the data I’d collected.
words.d: A reference is the act of referring to something or someone.

words.s: Eat a live frog every morning, and nothing worse will happen to you the rest of the day.
words.sz: 每天早上吃一隻活青蛙,那麼你一天中其他的時間就不會發生什麼更糟糕的事了。

words.s: In spite of the heavy rain, he visited his friend in the hospital.
words.sz: 尽管雨下得很大，但他还是去医院看望他的朋友了。
words.d: Spite is the desire to be mean.

t: 会议室， 会所； 房间； 腔， 室
words.s: The meeting was held in the faculty chamber.
words.d: A chamber is a closed space or room used for a special purpose.

t: 安排， 准备， 整理
words.s: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
words.sz: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。
words.d: To arrange things is to put them in the right place.

t: 粗的， 粗糙的； 粗劣的； 粗俗的
words.s: The coarse sweater made my skin itch.
words.d: If something is coarse, that means it has a rough texture.

words.s: My nephew is allergic to eggs.
words.sz: 我侄子對雞蛋過敏。

t: 公众的注意， 名声； 宣传， 宣扬
words.s: She received a lot of publicity after her performance in the film.
words.d: Publicity is public attention given to someone or something by the media.

t: 离开， 起程， 出发
words.s: How often do the buses depart?
words.sz: 公共汽车多久发车一次？
words.d: To depart is to leave some place so you can go to another place.

words.s: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
words.sz: 在我看來，她有一種誇張的傾向。
words.d: To exaggerate is to say that something is bigger or better than it really is.

words.s: I didn't mean to imply otherwise.
words.sz: 我沒想要暗示其他事。
words.d: To imply something is to suggest it without saying it.

t: 捕获， 俘获； 夺得
words.s: They would capture as many people as possible.
words.sz: 他們會盡可能地抓更多的人。
words.d: To capture something is to catch and hold it.

t: 承诺， 许诺， 保证； 信奉， 献身； 承担的义务

words.s: The gardener used her spade to make a hole for the new plant.
words.d: A spade is a tool used for digging.

words.s: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
words.sz: 生产日期在盖子上。
words.d: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory.

t: 连续， 接续， 一连串； 次序， 顺序
words.s: The dominos fell in a sequence of one after another.
words.d: A sequence is a number of events or things that come one after another.

t: 碰撞； 冲突， 抵触
words.s: The collision between the two cars created a loud noise.
words.d: A collision is the act of two things hitting into each another.

t: 资格， 资格证明， 合格证书； 限制， 限定
供应； 准备； 条款， 规定； 给养， 口粮
words.s: That department is responsible for the provision of emergency supplies.
words.d: The provision of something is the act of giving it to people in need or want.

words.s: We successfully recruited someone to be the new manager.
words.d: To recruit people means to select them to join or work for an organization.

t: 戳， 刺； 要点， 要旨； 推力
words.s: The boxer thrust his fist into the punching bag.
words.d: To thrust means to push or move something quickly with a lot of force.

words.s: Even with all his wealth and fame, he's unhappy.
words.sz: 尽管有金钱和名誉，他还是不幸福。
words.d: Fame is a reputation one has gained among the public.

t: 代替， 取代； 更换， 调换； 替代的人

words.s: He scraped the mud off his boots.
words.sz: 他刮下靴子上的泥巴。
words.d: Mud is soft, wet dirt.

words.s: When I was a child, I used to swim in that pond.
words.sz: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我在这个泳池里游过泳。
words.d: A pond is a freshwater body that is smaller than a lake.

t: 到达， 到来； 到达者， 到达物
words.s: Ladies and gentlemen, due to an accident at the airport, our arrival will be delayed.
words.sz: 女士們，先生們，由於機場的意外情況，我們的著陸將被推遲。

words.s: Dr. Yukawa played an important part in the scientific study.
words.sz: 汤川博士在科学研究上起了很重要的作用。

words.s: Except for the bad weather and the frequent earthquakes, this is almost a perfect place to live.
words.sz: 這裡除了惡劣的天氣和頻繁的地震之外，幾乎就是一個完美的居住地。
words.d: If something is frequent, then it happens or is done often.

t: 相等的， 一致的， 依…而定的
words.s: According to the weather forecast, the rainy season will set in next week.
words.sz: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。

words.s: The table is covered with powder.
words.sz: 桌上布满了粉末。
words.d: Powder is a dry substance in the form of very small grains.

t: 会员身份， 会籍； 全体会员， 会员数
words.s: I applied for membership in the association.
words.sz: 我申請成為協會會員。

t: 错误， 谬误， 差错
words.s: "There's an apostrophe missing. It's and its are different." "I know. It was a typing error."
words.sz: “你漏写了一个撇号。it's和its是有分别的。”“我知道。是我打错了。”

t: 平台， 站台， 讲台； 纲领， 宣言
words.s: The band uses their music as a platform to express their political beliefs.
words.d: A platform is something that allows someone to tell a large number of people about an idea, product, etc.

t: 网状物； 广播网， 电视网； 网络
words.s: Lesley is part of a volunteer network that plants trees in the city.
words.d: A network is a group of people or organizations that are in some way connected to each other.

t: 妒忌的， 猜疑的； 精心守护的
words.s: You must not be jealous of others' success.
words.sz: 不要嫉妒其他人的成功。
words.d: A jealous person might take something from you.

words.s: A bicycle will rust if you leave it in the rain.
words.sz: 如果你把自行車留在雨中，它會生鏽的。
words.d: Rust is a red and brown coating on iron objects caused by water and air.

t: 跟踪； 追溯； 描摹
words.s: He disappeared without a trace.
words.sz: 他没有留下痕迹就消失了。
words.d: To trace something means to follow over it with the eyes or a finger.

words.s: She carried that habit to her grave.
words.sz: 她到死都改不了那個習慣。
words.d: A grave is the place where a dead person is buried.

t: 优点， 优势， 好处
words.s: She took full advantage of her stay in London to improve her English.
words.sz: 她充分利用她住在伦敦的优势，提高英语。

words.s: I worked three years as Tom's assistant.
words.sz: 我给汤姆当了三年助手。

words.s: A fire broke out at the inn where they were staying.
words.sz: 火警發生在他們住的旅館。
words.d: An inn is a place where travelers can rest and eat.

t: 作为替代； 却， 反而
words.s: Tom wanted to stay home and relax instead of hiking with his children.
words.sz: 汤姆想待在家休息而不是和他的孩子们出去远足。
words.d: Instead means in place of.

words.s: There has been a lot of controversy over the judge’s decision.
words.d: A controversy is a dispute about something that affects many people.

t: 命令， 指挥， 控制
words.s: She has a good command of English though she was brought up in Japan.
words.sz: 雖然她在日本被撫養長大，但是她精通英語。
words.d: A command is an order given to a person or animal to do something.

words.s: An eight-year-old car is almost worthless.
words.sz: 一輛車齡八年的車子幾乎是毫無價值的。

t: 演出； 执行， 完成； 工作情况， 表现； 工作性能
words.s: What time is the next performance?
words.sz: 下一場表演在幾點鐘？
words.d: Performance is how well someone or something functions, works, etc.

words.s: I'm trying to save room for dessert.
words.sz: 我尽量留着胃吃甜点。

t: 大使， 使节， 派驻国际组织的代表
words.s: The ambassador was recalled from Warsaw.
words.sz: 大使被从华沙召回。
words.d: An ambassador is a government worker who works in another country.

t: 预料， 预期， 期望； 先于…行动； 提前使用
words.s: I anticipate that there will be trouble.
words.sz: 我預料會有麻煩。
words.d: To anticipate something is to think that it will happen.

t: 圣堂， 神殿， 庙宇
words.s: Do you know which deity this temple is dedicated to?
words.sz: 您知道这座庙宇供奉的是哪个神吗？

t: 增长， 增长量； 生长， 生长物
words.s: The third quarter GNP growth was 1% over the preceding quarter.
words.sz: 第三季國民生產總值較上一季成長了1％。

words.s: The landscape is unfamiliar to me.
words.sz: 风景对我来说很陌生。
words.d: A landscape is how an area of land looks.

words.s: We saw a woman weave a blanket on our vacation to South America.
words.d: To weave means to make cloth using horizontal and vertical threads.

words.s: I put a carrot in my salad.
words.d: A carrot is an orange vegetable.

words.s: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
words.sz: 句子通常有主詞和動詞。

words.s: It's been hot this month, but today's an exception.
words.sz: 这个月一直都很热，但今天是个例外。
words.d: An exception is someone or something not conforming to a rule.

words.s: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
words.sz: 她隱約地有一種的內疚感。
words.d: If something is vague, it is not clear and gives very few details.

words.s: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
words.sz: 正式工比临时工要好。
words.d: If something is temporary, it exists for a short time.

words.s: What's the round-trip fare?
words.sz: 往返票多少钱？
words.d: A fare is an amount of money paid to use a bus, train, or taxi.

t: 拼死的， 不顾一切的； 绝望的； 极需要的
words.s: I'm in a desperate situation.
words.sz: 我處在絕境。
words.d: A desperate person will try anything to do or change something.

t: 指导的， 带头的； 最主要的； 饰演主角的
words.s: Car accidents are the leading cause of death for teenagers in the United States.
words.sz: 交通事故是美国青少年死亡的主要原因。
words.d: When something is leading, it is the most advanced or best.

t: 令人不愉快的， 难过的； 非常的， 极大的
words.s: I don't recommend eating in that restaurant. The food is awful.
words.sz: 我不推荐在那家餐馆吃饭。食物糟糕透了。
words.d: An awful thing is very bad.

words.s: Accuracy is important in arithmetic.
words.sz: 准确性在计算中很重要。

t: 手边的， 便于使用的
words.s: She's handy with a needle.
words.sz: 她擅长针线活。
words.d: If something is handy, it is useful.

t: 鼓励；推进，催促；竭力主张，强烈要求
words.s: Advertisements urge us to buy luxuries.
words.sz: 廣告慫恿我們買奢侈品。
words.d: To urge someone is to try very hard to get them to do something.

t: 正式决定， 决议； 决心， 决意； 解决， 解答； 分辨率， 清晰度
words.s: My New Year's resolution is to learn how to play the ocarina.
words.sz: 我新年的願望是學會吹奧卡利納塤。
words.d: A resolution is a personal decision.

words.s: We arrived in the city from the airport via the train.
words.d: Via introduces a route or means of travel.

t: 环境， 背景， 布景； 调节， 设定的位置
得， 给…打分； 画线于， 做记号于； 赢得
words.s: He got a better score than us.
words.sz: 他得到了比我们还高的分数。

t: 引文， 引语； 报价， 牌价； 引号
words.s: His writing was full of quotes from Shakespeare.
words.d: A quote is what someone has said, including saying how much a piece of work will cost.

words.s: Tom will graduate from high school the year after next.
words.sz: 湯姆將在後年高中畢業。
words.d: To graduate from a school means to complete and pass all courses of study there.

words.s: The farmers couldn’t grow any food in the dry soil, so there was a famine.
words.d: A famine is a long time with little or no food.

t: 缺席的， 不在场的； 缺乏的， 不存在的； 心不在焉的
words.s: Nobody noticed that she was absent until the end of the meeting.
words.sz: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。
words.d: If someone or something is absent, they are missing or not in the place they are expected to be.

t: 破布， 碎布； 破旧衣服
words.s: Please use a rag to clean the dust off the table.
words.d: A rag is a small towel.

words.s: The visual displays were very attractive.
words.d: Visual relates to seeing.

t: 体谅的， 宽容的， 通情达理的
理解，理解力；谅解；协议；相互理解，融洽
words.s: Tom and Mary came to an understanding.
words.sz: 汤姆和玛丽达成了协议。

words.s: New York's Empire State Building is now running entirely on wind power.
words.sz: 紐約帝國大廈現在完全依靠風力發電。
words.d: An empire is a large group of countries ruled by an emperor or empress.

t: 教育， 培养， 训练
惭愧的， 羞耻的， 害臊的
words.s: I'm very ashamed of myself about what I've done.
words.sz: 我對自己的作為很內疚。
words.d: Ashamed means feeling upset and embarrassed because of a bad action.

t: 指示， 命令； 通知； 教授， 训练
words.s: My teacher instructs us in several subjects.
words.d: To instruct is to teach.

words.s: A cornered rat will bite a cat.
words.sz: 窮鼠囓狸。

words.s: "What do you think of the election for mayor?" "I don't know."
words.sz: “你对市长选举怎么看？”“我不知道。”
words.d: The mayor is the person in charge of a city.

t: 相当， 尚可， 还； 公平地
words.s: Tom seems to be a fairly successful businessman.
words.sz: 湯姆看來是箇很成功的商人。

t: 笔迹， 手迹； 书法
words.s: Do you know whose handwriting this is?
words.sz: 你知道这是谁的字吗？

words.s: The merchant was selling used cars.
words.d: A merchant is a person who sells things.

t: 自然状态的， 未加工过的； 生的； 未经分析的， 原始的； 生疏无知的， 未经训练的； 露肉而刺痛的
words.s: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
words.sz: 日本從國外進口各種原料。
words.d: A raw material is natural and has not been processed.

t: 经济； 节约， 节省
words.s: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
words.sz: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。
words.d: An economy is the money and businesses of a country or region.

t: 社区， 社会， 公社； 团体， 界； 群落
words.s: Do you take part in any community activities?
words.sz: 你参加社团活动吗？
words.d: A community is a group of people who share the same area or interests.

t: 译本； 说法； 改写本
words.s: This dictionary isn't the most recent version.
words.sz: 這本字典不是最新版的。
words.d: A version is an account of something that differs slightly from the original.

words.s: In a few minutes we'll be landing at New Tokyo International Airport.
words.sz: 我们将于几分钟内降落在新东京国际机场。

words.s: During the summer, the courtyard is a nice place to have lunch.
words.d: A courtyard is an outdoor area that is surrounded by the walls of a building.

words.s: His nationality is German, but he speaks French, Spanish, and Korean.
words.d: Nationality is an identity based on the nation from which you come.

t: 选择， 挑选； 被挑选出来的人， 精选品； 可供选择的东西

words.s: I am going to a lecture about Ancient Rome at the Historical Institute.
words.d: An institute is an organization that is interested in research or teaching.

words.s: How many people were aboard that ship?
words.sz: 那艘船上有多少人？
words.d: Someone aboard a ship or plane is in or on it.

t: 忍受， 容忍； 持久， 持续
words.s: Can she endure a long trip?
words.sz: 她能忍受長途旅行嗎？
words.d: To endure means to experience and survive something difficult.

words.s: He described the incident in detail.
words.sz: 他詳細地描述了事故狀況。
words.d: A detail is a small piece of information.

t: 立刻， 不久； 不耐烦地； 简短地
words.s: Shortly after the accident, the police came.
words.sz: 事故發生後不久，警察來了。
words.d: An action that happens shortly happens very soon.

words.s: My hobby is taking pictures of wild flowers.
words.sz: 我的业余爱好是拍野花的照片。
words.d: A hobby is a fun and creative activity people do in their free time.

words.s: I had to change clothes because what I was wearing wasn't appropriate for the situation.
words.sz: 我必须要换衣服，因为我现在穿的衣服不适合这个环境。
words.d: When a thing is appropriate, it is right or normal.

words.s: She had to accept her fate.
words.sz: 她该接受她的命运。
words.d: Fate is a power that causes things to happen.

t: 咽喉， 喉咙； 嗓音
words.s: I've had a scratchy throat since this morning. I wonder if I've caught a cold.
words.sz: 早上起来，嗓子变得很沙哑，我想是不是感冒了。

t: 效用， 有用， 实用； 公用事业
words.s: If you don’t pay the utilities, you may have your electricity turned off.
words.d: A utility is a business that supplies services such as water or electricity.

t: 立即， 马上； 直接地， 紧接地
words.s: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
words.sz: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

words.s: Can you drive a manual transmission?
words.sz: 你會開手排車嗎?

t: 衡量， 测量； 尺寸， 大小
乐观的， 乐观主义的
words.s: I'm not as optimistic as you are.
words.sz: 我不像你那么乐观。

t: 词汇表， 词汇， 语汇
words.s: You need a large vocabulary to read that book.
words.sz: 你讀那本書需要大量詞彙。

t: 退休， 退役； 退下， 退出， 撤退； 就寝
words.s: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.
words.sz: 我希望在六十歲時退休。
words.d: To retire is to leave a job, usually because of old age.

t: 方面； 朝向， 方向； 样子， 外表
words.s: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
words.sz: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。
words.d: An aspect is one part or feature of something.

t: 粒子， 微粒； 小品词， 语助词
words.s: The bottles of wine were covered in a layer of dust particles.
words.d: A particle is a very small piece of something.

t: 侵略的， 好斗的； 敢做敢为的； 有进取心的
words.s: He is an aggressive person.
words.sz: 他是个咄咄逼人的的人。
words.d: If someone is aggressive, then they constantly want to fight or argue.

t: 行为， 举止， 表现
words.s: His dress is that of a gentleman, but his speech and behavior are those of a clown.
words.sz: 他衣着像个绅士，言行举止却像个小丑。
words.d: Your behavior is the way you act.

words.s: In her opinion, he is the best musician she has ever seen.
words.sz: 她認為他是她所見過最好的音樂家。

words.s: I checked my homework twice to minimize errors I might have made.
words.d: To minimize means to reduce something to the lowest possible level.

t: 下来， 下降； 下倾
words.s: I descended the stairs to get out of the building.
words.d: To descend is to go downward.

t: 圣徒； 圣人， 道德高尚的人； [用于人名或地名等前]圣
密集， 稠密； 密度
words.s: Japan has a high population density.
words.sz: 日本的人口密度很高。

t: 逻辑的， 合乎常理的
words.s: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
words.sz: 最合逻輯的放鞋處是門口附近。

t: 迫使； 施恩于， 帮…的忙； 使感激
words.s: If I wanted to have playtime, I was obliged to clean my room once a week.
words.d: To oblige someone means to require them to do something.

t: 砰地关上；猛力拉，砰地放下；猛烈抨击
words.s: She slammed the book shut after she finished reading it.
words.d: To slam is to close something hard.

t: 成为…的特征， 以…为特征； 描绘的特性， 描述

words.s: He can swing a golf club very powerfully.
words.d: To swing something means to move it back and forth or from side to side.

words.s: It would be ridiculous to spend all their money.
words.sz: 花光他們所有的錢會很荒謬。
words.d: A ridiculous thing is silly or strange.

words.s: She had her handbag stolen.
words.sz: 她的手提包被偷了。

t: 入侵， 侵略， 侵犯
words.s: In Korea, walls were built around cities to protect them from invasions.
words.d: An invasion is an attack by a group from another country.

t: 旋转；晕眩；纺，织；绞干，甩干
words.s: The boy kept spinning until he fell down.
words.d: To spin is to turn around in circles.

t: 严重的； 严厉的， 严格的； 严峻的， 艰难的； 朴素的， 不加装饰的
words.s: Japan is confronted with severe economic problems.
words.sz: 日本正面臨著嚴重的經濟問題。
words.d: Severe means very bad or serious.

t: 出现， 涌现， 冒出
words.s: A groundhog emerged from a snow covered hole.
words.d: To emerge from something means to come out of it.

words.s: The kids were playing in the shallow water.
words.d: A shallow thing is not deep.

t: 出租； 租得， 租有
words.s: I signed the lease today.
words.sz: 我今天签了租约。
words.d: To lease means to rent property, usually an apartment or land.

t: 剥削； 利用； 开拓
words.s: The company exploits their workers and makes them work 12 hours a day.
words.d: To exploit something is to use it for greedy reasons rather than good reasons.

words.s: Out of anger, Helen slapped Eunice on the face.
words.d: To slap someone means to hit them with the palm of the hand.

words.s: He emerged from the pool and spit water from his mouth.
words.d: To spit means to force liquid from one’s mouth.

t: 侦察员，侦察机，侦察舰；童子军

words.s: Tom never forgets to give his wife flowers on their wedding anniversary.
words.sz: 湯姆從沒忘記在婚禮周年紀念日送給他妻子花。
words.d: An anniversary is a day that celebrates something from the past.

t: 登记， 注册； 指示， 自动记下； 流露； 表示， 表达； 把挂号
words.s: Could you please sign the register?
words.sz: 請您在登記冊上簽名好嗎？
words.d: A register is an official list or record of people or things.

t: 焦躁不安的； 静不下来的， 运动不止的
words.s: I've been feeling a little restless.
words.sz: 我有點不安。

t: 劝诱的； 有说服力的

words.s: The fleet of ships spent a few days at the dock.
words.d: A fleet is a group of ships.

t: 通讯； 交际， 交流； 连接， 相通； 传达， 传播； 传染
words.s: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.
words.sz: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。
words.d: When we communicate with others, we talk or write to them.

t: 根据， 证据； 证人
words.s: The police assembled a lot of evidence against him.
words.sz: 警察收集了很多对他不利的证据。
words.d: Evidence is a fact or thing that you use to prove something.

t: 给…装鞍； 使承担任务

words.s: I want to live in a small house in a rural area.
words.d: If a place is rural, it is in the countryside instead of the city.

t: 官员， 行政人员， 高级人员
words.s: Tom isn't an elected official.
words.sz: 湯姆不是選出來的官員。
words.d: An official thing is approved by someone in authority.

t: 历史的， 有关历史的

words.s: Fortunately, no passengers were injured.
words.sz: 万幸，没乘客受伤。

words.s: Acid rain is not a natural phenomenon.
words.sz: 酸雨不是自然现象。
words.d: An acid is a chemical that can burn or dissolve other substances.

t: 传播， 发射； 传送， 传递； 传染
words.s: Can you drive a manual transmission?
words.sz: 你會開手排車嗎?

words.s: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
words.sz: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。
words.d: Shortage comes from short and means not having enough.

t: 区别， 辨别； 识别力； 差别对待， 歧视
words.s: He fought against racial discrimination.
words.sz: 他反对种族歧视。

words.s: I have three dogs. One is male and the other two are female.
words.sz: 我有三只狗，其中一只是公的，另外两只是母的。
words.d: Female refers to women or girls.

t: 扩音器， 话筒， 麦克风
words.s: For some reason the microphone didn't work earlier.
words.sz: 剛才我的麥克風沒起作用，不知道為什麼。

t: 快的； 反应快的； 敏捷的
words.s: Life is short and time is swift.
words.sz: 人生苦短，岁月如梭。
words.d: A swift person or animal is fast.

t: 交出， 放弃； 投降
words.s: If Tom doesn't surrender, shoot him.
words.sz: 如果湯姆不投降，就開槍
words.d: To surrender something is to give it up.

words.s: I feel like I'm going to faint.
words.sz: 我覺得我快昏倒了。
words.d: To faint means to go unconscious and fall down.

t: 部长， 大臣； 公使， 外交使节； 牧师
words.s: He made his way to the minister.
words.sz: 他設法當上了部長。
words.d: A minister is an important person in government with many duties.

t: 使摆好姿势；造成，引起；提出，陈述
words.s: When you pose a question, you expect an answer.
words.sz: 當你提出一個問題，你期望得到答案。
words.d: To pose is to stay in one place without moving.

t: 补救办法，纠正办法；药品；治疗法
补救， 纠正； 医治， 治疗
words.s: A good remedy for a headache is an aspirin and a glass of water.
words.d: A remedy is a cure for a disease, argument, or problem.

t: 监禁， 拘留； 塞满； 卡住； 干扰
words.s: He has spent ten years in jail for murder.
words.sz: 他因為謀殺案在牢裡待了十年。
words.d: A jail is a place to keep bad people.

words.s: We will only consent on that condition.
words.sz: 我们只会在那样的条件下同意。

t: 坚持， 坚决认为； 坚持要求
words.s: They insist that he should go.
words.sz: 他们坚持让他走。
words.d: To insist means to be firm in telling people what to do.

t: 无助的； 无能的； 无法抗拒的

words.s: Respect for law is fundamental to our society.
words.sz: 尊重法律是我們社會的基礎。

t: 卷， 册， 书卷； 容积， 体积； 音量， 响度
words.s: Turn the volume up so that the students at the back can hear.
words.sz: 声音大声一点，以便让坐在后边的学生能听到。
words.d: The volume is the total amount of something.

t: 退却， 撤退； 退避， 退缩
words.s: I was uncertain whether to advance or to retreat.
words.sz: 我不确定该前进还是后退。
words.d: To retreat means to run away because of losing a fight.

words.s: My joints ache when it gets cold.
words.sz: 當天氣變冷的時候，我的關節疼痛。
words.d: To ache is to hurt, or cause pain.

words.s: True friendship is based on mutual trust.
words.sz: 真正的友谊建立在彼此信任的基础上。
words.d: A mutual thing is felt in the same way by two or more people.

words.s: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.
words.sz: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。
words.d: A shell is a hard covering that protects the body of some sea creatures.

words.s: Before they began the project, the teacher gave them some guidelines.
words.d: A guideline is a rule about how to do something.

t: 松的； 不精确的， 不严密的； 散漫的
words.s: The bolt was loose, so I tightened it with the wrench.
words.d: A loose thing is not held in place tightly.

words.s: He is fat. Therefore, he should go on a diet.
words.d: Therefore means for this reason.

t: 交换； 交流； 兑换
words.s: The company went public and became listed on the stock exchange in 1990.
words.sz: 该公司于1990年挂牌上市。
words.d: To exchange is to give one thing in return for another.

t: 犹豫， 踌躇； 含糊； 不情愿
words.s: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.
words.sz: 记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。
words.d: To hesitate is to wait for a short time before doing something.

words.s: He carried a rifle on his shoulder.
words.sz: 他把步槍背在他的肩上。

t: 私人的；秘密的；私下的；私营的
words.s: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
words.sz: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
words.d: If something is private, it is only used by one person or group.

words.s: How many pieces of baggage do you have?
words.sz: 请问您有多少件行李？

t: 同伴， 共事者； 伴侣
words.s: I always walk to school with my companion Frank.
words.d: A companion is a person that someone spends a lot of time with.

t: 垮， 衰竭； 损坏， 故障； 倒塌
words.s: Her car had a breakdown, and she wasn’t sure how to fix it.
words.d: A breakdown is a failure to work correctly.

words.s: My son needed some paste for a school project.
words.d: A paste is a thick and smooth substance.

t: 追上， 超过； 突然降临于， 意外地碰上

words.s: Jeans are now in fashion among girls.
words.sz: 现在女生穿牛仔裤很流行。

t: 整夜， 通宵； 一夜间， 突然
一整夜的； 一夜间的， 突然的
words.s: The campers stayed in the tent overnight.
words.d: An overnight action happens during the night.

t: 表现， 举止； 运转， 作出反应
words.s: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
words.sz: 其他人的期望會影響我們的行為。
words.d: To behave is to act in a particular way, especially to be good.

t: 伸展，延续；伸长，拉长；倾注全力；紧张
一段时间， 一段路程， 连绵的一片； 伸展， 延伸
words.s: She stretched her body before exercising.
words.d: To stretch is to make your arms or legs reach out.

t: 解开， 打开； 取消， 撤销
words.s: I can't undo it.
words.sz: 我不能取消它。

words.s: Did you accomplish your goals?
words.sz: 你達成你的目標了嗎？
words.d: To accomplish something means to finish it.

words.s: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
words.sz: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。

words.s: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
words.sz: 將混合物攪拌均勻。
words.d: A mixture is something that is made by mixing other things together.

t: 引擎， 发动机； 机车
words.s: Keep the engine running. I'll be right back.
words.sz: 讓引擎持續運轉，我去去就來。

t: 需负责任的， 承担责任的； 有责任感的， 负责可靠的； 责任重大的， 重要的
words.s: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
words.sz: 船长要为乘客安全负责。
words.d: A responsible person is in charge of someone or something.

t: 范围； 余地， 机会
words.s: Modern history has a wide scope.
words.d: The scope of something is how many people or things it relates to.

t: 民主的， 民主政体的
奖牌， 奖章， 勋章

words.s: The moon is the earth's only satellite.
words.sz: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。
words.d: A satellite is a machine sent into space to get information.

t: 枪弹， 子弹， 弹丸
words.s: Tom was wearing a bulletproof vest, so the bullet didn't kill him.
words.sz: 湯姆穿著一件防彈衣，所以子彈沒把他殺死。
words.d: A bullet is a small metal object that is shot out of a gun.

t: 录音机， 录像机； 记录装置， 记录仪
words.s: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
words.sz: 我在那商店花低價買了臺錄像機。

words.s: I used the file to identify his name.
words.d: To identify something is to find out what it is.

t: 拥抱； 包括； 包围
words.s: Tom tried to embrace Mary.
words.sz: 湯姆嘗試擁抱瑪麗。
words.d: To embrace is to hug.

words.s: Pour melted butter over the popcorn.
words.sz: 將融化了的奶油倒入爆米花中。
words.d: To pour a liquid means to make it come out of a container.

words.s: Tom picked up the jar and read the label.
words.sz: 汤姆拿起罐子读标签。
words.d: A label is a tag that tells about something.

t: 改进， 改善； 改进处
words.s: Your essay still needs some improvement.
words.sz: 你的论文还需要改进。

words.s: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.
words.sz: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。

words.s: These scissors are suitable for left and right-handed people.
words.sz: 這把剪刀左右撇子都適用。

t: 意义， 含义； 重要性， 重大
words.s: I don't understand its significance.
words.sz: 我没有领会这个意义。
words.d: The significance of something is the quality that makes it important.

t: 更改， 修改； 修饰
words.s: I modified my outfit by adding a belt to it.
words.d: To modify something is to change it a little bit.

t: 地平线； 眼界， 见识
words.s: The sun went below the horizon.
words.sz: 太陽落到地平線下了。
words.d: The horizon is where the sky looks like it meets the ground.

t: 环境， 外界； 围绕
words.s: Keeping our environment clean is important to our health.
words.d: The environment is the place where people work or live.

words.s: According to newspaper reports, there was an airplane accident last evening.
words.sz: 根據報載，有一架飛機昨天晚上發生了意外。

words.s: Her mother pledged that she would find her daughter’s lost kitten.
words.d: To pledge means to make a promise to do something.

t: 前进的； 渐进的； 进行式的
水库， 蓄水池； 储藏， 汇集
故意的， 蓄意的； 慎重的， 深思熟虑的
words.s: Bernie made a deliberate attempt to injure Andy.
words.d: A deliberate action is one done on purpose, not by accident.

words.s: I could swear there's something inside this box.
words.sz: 我能发誓这箱子里有东西。
words.d: To swear means to promise to do something.

t: 大气， 空气； 气氛， 环境
words.s: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
words.sz: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。
words.d: The atmosphere is the air around the Earth where weather conditions form.

t: 装饰， 装潢， 修饰
words.s: Many people decorate their homes for Christmas.
words.sz: 許多人都會在聖誕節期間裝飾自己的家。
words.d: When you decorate a room, you make it more attractive by adding beautiful things to it.

words.s: Researchers at the biotechnology company use bacteria to make medicine.
words.d: Biotechnology is the use of living parts, such as cells, in industry and technology.

t: 生涯， 职业， 经历
words.s: He was in the hospitality business for most of his career.
words.d: A career is a job that you do for a large part of your life.

t: 占领， 占据； 职业； 从事的活动， 消遣
words.s: What is your occupation?
words.sz: 你做什么工作？
words.d: An occupation is a person’s job.

t: 趋向， 趋势， 倾向
words.s: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
words.sz: 在我看來，她有一種誇張的傾向。

t: 释放， 排放； 解除， 解脱； 放开， 松开； 发布； 发行
words.s: Don't release that prisoner.
words.sz: 別放了那箇犯人。
words.d: To release something is to stop holding it.

t: 宪章，共同纲领；特许状，许可证；包租
words.s: The company charter explained that all employees had to pay a tax.
words.d: A charter is a document that describes the rights of an organization or group.

words.s: Look at my new cell phone. It’s very slim.
words.d: A slim person or thing is thin, not thick.

words.s: Accuracy is important in arithmetic.
words.sz: 准确性在计算中很重要。
words.d: Arithmetic is math.

t: 有错误的， 有缺点的
使摆脱， 解除…的负担， 从…中清除
words.s: Once you have formed a bad habit, you can't get rid of it easily.
words.sz: 坏习惯一旦被养成，便不能简单地改正。
words.d: To rid is to make a place free from something or someone.

t: 变化， 变动； 变异； 变奏
品行； 道德规范； 寓意
words.s: At the end of the story, the mother explained the moral to her children.
words.d: A moral is a message at the end of a story that teaches you something.

t: 缺点， 缺陷， 欠缺
words.s: All these bottles have a defect and must be sent back to the warehouse.
words.d: A defect is a part of something that is wrong or missing.

t: 增强， 加强， 增援
words.s: Peter reinforced his opinion with information from a book.
words.d: To reinforce something is to make it stronger.

t: 爆炸； 激增； 发怒
words.s: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.
words.sz: 一点火花让火药爆炸。
words.d: To explode is to suddenly move apart in many smaller pieces.

t: 偶然的； 非正式的； 临时的， 不定期的； 漠不关心的， 冷淡的
words.s: You can wear casual clothes, like jeans, to the party.
words.d: A casual thing is relaxed or simple.

t: 下降， 减少； 衰退， 衰落； 谢绝， 拒绝
words.s: I must decline.
words.sz: 我必须拒绝。
words.d: To decline an offer or invitation means to say no to it.

t: 财产， 所有物； 房产； 物业； 性质， 性能
words.s: He passed his property on to his son.
words.sz: 他把他的财产传给了他儿子。

words.s: He has no chance of succeeding.
words.sz: 他沒有成功的機會。

words.s: His brave deed earned him respect.
words.sz: 他的英勇行為使他贏得了尊重。
words.d: A brave person is not afraid to face pain or danger.

words.s: He asked me questions similar to those asked by many others.
words.sz: 他和许多其他人一样问了我同样的问题。
words.d: Things which are similar are almost the same.

t: 观点， 看法， 见解
无论如何， 不管怎么说； 随随便便地， 杂乱无章地

words.s: The poster didn’t specify where the concert was taking place.
words.d: To specify is to describe something clearly.

t: 吹口哨， 鸣笛声； 呼啸而过
words.s: Do you know how to whistle?
words.sz: 你会吹口哨吗？

t: 拿， 触； 操作， 处理
words.s: I don't know how to handle children.
words.sz: 我不知道如何對待孩子。
words.d: A handle is the part of an object people hold while using it.

t: 向前； 向外， 往外
困难的， 难对付的； 坚强的， 能吃苦耐劳的； 健壮的； 坚硬的， 严格的； 老的， 硬的； 粗暴的， 充满暴力的
words.s: Tom certainly has a tough job.
words.sz: 汤姆确实有个麻烦的工作。
words.d: A tough thing is difficult.

t: 人行横道， 交叉口； 横渡
words.s: Please be careful when crossing the street.
words.sz: 过马路时请小心。

t: 剧本， 广播稿； 书写用的字母； 笔迹， 手迹
words.s: He read the script of the play three times.
words.d: A script is the words of a film or play.

t: 系统； 制度， 体制； 方法， 做法； 身体
words.s: I'm glad that they fixed the heating system, but now it's too hot.
words.sz: 我很高興他們修復了暖氣系統，但現在太熱了。
words.d: A system is a group of related parts that move or work together.

t: 组成， 构成； 创作， 为…谱曲； 使平静， 使镇静
words.s: Tony composed his report using many sources of information.
words.d: To compose something is to make it from smaller parts.

t: 认出， 发现； 玷污
words.s: The lake is deepest at this spot.
words.sz: 这里是湖最深的地方。

words.s: Which do you enjoy more, ice skating or roller skating?
words.sz: 你更喜歡滑冰還是輪滑？

t: 部分的； 不公平的； 偏爱的， 偏袒的
words.s: It was only a partial success.
words.sz: 那只是部分的成功。

t: 帮助； 救护； 助手； 辅助手段
腔调， 语气； 音调； 风格， 气度； 色调， 明暗
words.s: He doesn't realise that he's tone deaf.
words.sz: 他不知道他自己五音不全。

t: 确信的， 肯定的； 自信的
words.s: I'm fairly confident that I can do that.
words.sz: 我相当有自信我能做到这一点。
words.d: Confident people believe that they can do something without failing.

words.s: Even by the afternoon, the day had retained the morning’s freshness.
words.d: To retain something is to keep it.
