words.d: To utilize something is to use it for a specific purpose.

t: 黏性的， 胶黏的； 湿热的
words.s: Place the sticky part of the tape against the paper, so it will cling to the wall.
words.d: If something is sticky, then it is covered with a substance that things stick to.

words.s: Justice will prevail in the end.
words.sz: 正义终将胜利。
words.d: To prevail means to be accepted or very common.

words.s: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
words.sz: Mary试图把围裙围在腰上，然后把烤鸡从炉子里拿出来。

words.s: The zebra’s flesh is covered by black and white skin.
words.d: Flesh is the muscle and fat on your body.

t: 丛林， 密林， 莽丛； 乱七八糟的一堆
words.s: He wrote a book about a jungle adventure.
words.sz: 他写了一本关于丛林冒险的书。
words.d: A jungle is a type of forest in a warm, rainy tropical area, where trees and plants grow very close together.

words.s: I only ate a small portion of the pizza.
words.d: A portion of something is a part of it.

t: 安排， 安放； 调停； 支付， 核算； 安家； 飞落， 停留； 安定
words.s: We settled the argument by looking up the answer on the web.
words.d: When you settle something, you reach an agreement.

words.s: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
words.sz: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。
words.d: A pattern is a way in which something is done or organized.

words.s: The desert can be a very harsh environment.
words.d: When something is harsh, it is very unpleasant.

t: 车辆， 机动车； 传播媒介， 工具， 手段

words.s: I accidentally scraped the paint of the side of the car.
words.d: To scrape something is to rub it very hard with something sharp.

t: 使困惑， 把…弄糊涂； 混淆， 把…混同； 混乱， 搞乱
words.s: Don't confuse desire with love.
words.sz: 不要把欲望和爱情混为一谈。
words.d: To confuse someone means to make them feel like they are unsure.

t: 垫子， 坐垫， 靠垫

words.s: I'll scold him.
words.sz: 我會責備他。
words.d: To scold means to criticize someone angrily for doing something wrong.

t: 光荣的； 壮丽的； 令人愉快的
使文明， 使开化， 教育

words.s: The physician prescribed his patient some medicine.
words.sz: 医生给他的病人开了一些药。
words.d: A physician is a doctor.

t: 建筑学； 建筑式样， 建筑风格
words.s: You like to talk about architecture, don't you?
words.sz: 你喜欢讨论建筑，不是吗？
words.d: Architecture is the design and form of a building.

t: 压力；强调；重要性；应力；重音
强调， 着重； 重读
words.s: Karaoke is good for reducing stress.
words.sz: 卡拉OK對減輕壓力有益。
words.d: Stress is a strong feeling of worry caused by problems in life, work, etc.

words.s: Get a grip on yourself.
words.sz: 冷静下来！
words.d: To grip something is to hold it very tightly.

t: 探险， 探索； 仔细查阅， 探究
words.s: He wants to explore the world and see new things.
words.d: To explore is to look for new places.

t: 陈列， 展览， 显示
words.s: Sociopaths rarely display remorse or feelings of guilt for their crimes.
words.sz: 反社会者极少为他们的罪行显露懊悔或有罪恶的感觉。
words.d: To display something is to show it, especially by putting it in a certain place.

words.s: Austria is one of the largest producers of electricity in Europe.
words.sz: 澳大利亚在欧洲是最大的电能生产国之一。

t: 气候； 风土， 地带； 风气， 气氛
words.s: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
words.sz: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。
words.d: A climate is the usual weather in a place.

t: 售票员， 列车长； 指挥； 导体
面包皮， 硬外皮； 外壳， 地壳
words.s: The little boy never ate the crust of his pizza.
words.d: Crust is the tough outer part of a loaf of bread.

t: 混乱， 杂乱， 骚乱
words.s: Tom thinks that Mary may have an eating disorder.
words.sz: 汤姆认为玛丽可能有进食障碍。

t: 批评； 评论； 非难
words.s: He criticized his wife for spending too much money.
words.d: To criticize is to say bad things about someone or something.

t: 组织， 团体， 机构
words.s: The organization furnished the refugees with food.
words.sz: 那个团体为难民们提供食品供给。

t: 狂吹； 汹涌； 激烈进行； 发怒， 发火
狂怒，盛怒；风靡一时的事物，时尚
words.s: The chef was filled with rage when his helpers ruined the meal.
words.d: Rage is a very angry feeling.

t: 宽阔， 广阔； 宽度
words.s: What's the width of this road?
words.sz: 這條路的寬度是多少？
words.d: Width is the distance from one side of something to the other side.

words.s: Things like milk and cheese are dairy foods.
words.d: Dairy shows that something is made from milk.

t: 板，牌子；木板，纸板；委员会，董事会；伙食
words.s: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
words.sz: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。
words.d: A board is a flat piece of wood.

words.s: Although the government refuses to admit it, its economic policy is in ruins.
words.sz: 尽管政府拒绝承认，它的经济政策还是失败了。

t: 装， 填， 塞； 让…吃饱
words.s: Can't you move your stuff to the other room?
words.sz: 你不能把你的东西搬去另一个房间吗？
words.d: Stuff is a word used to refer to things without mentioning the things by name.

t: 逮捕，拘留；停止，阻止；吸引
逮捕， 拘留， 扣留
words.s: Why don't the police arrest Tom?
words.sz: 为什么警察不逮捕Tom？
words.d: To arrest someone means to catch that person for doing something bad.

t: 差别， 不同， 区分
成熟的；成年人的；深思熟虑的；到期的，应支付的
words.s: He grew a beard to look more mature.
words.sz: 他留了胡子，为了让自己看起来更成熟。
words.d: To mature means to grow up to become an adult.

words.s: Mary was wearing a navy blue skirt.
words.sz: 玛丽穿着深蓝色的裙子。
words.d: A navy is the part of a country’s military that fights at sea.

words.s: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.
words.sz: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。

t: 部分， 章节； 部门， 科； 截面， 剖面
words.s: There are seven men and four women in my section.
words.sz: 在我的部门里有七男四女。

t: 影响，作用；影响力，势力；产生影响力的人
words.s: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.
words.sz: 她开始对生态学感兴趣，是受到他的影响。
words.d: To influence someone or something is to have an effect on them.

t: 鞭笞；猛地移动；搅打成糊状
礼仪， 礼节； 草案， 议定书
words.s: The introduction of the guests followed the normal protocol.
words.d: Protocol is a system of rules and customs that guides how things are done.

words.s: A wounded whale washed up on the beach.
words.sz: 一条受伤的鲸鱼在海滩边搁浅了。
words.d: A whale is a very large mammal that lives in the ocean.

t: 对…挑衅， 激怒； 激起， 引起
words.s: The older boy provoked Paul by calling him mean names.
words.d: To provoke someone means to annoy them on purpose to cause violence.

t: 威胁， 恐吓； 预示快要来临， 是…的征兆； 构成威胁； 可能发生
words.s: Did Tom ever threaten you?
words.sz: 湯姆威脅過你嗎？

t: 天才， 才能； 人才
words.s: I can't help admiring his talent.
words.sz: 我不禁欣賞他的才華。
words.d: A talent is a natural ability to do something well.

t: 洽谈， 协商； 顺利通过， 成功越过； 协商， 谈判
扭伤， 拉伤； 尽力； 拉紧
拉紧；过劳；极度紧张；张力；扭伤，拉伤；旋律；品种，家系；气质，个性特点
words.s: Tom has been under a great deal of strain lately.
words.sz: 汤姆最近压力特别大。
words.d: To strain is to try very hard.

t: 打猎； 搜寻； 驱逐
words.s: He likes to hunt.
words.sz: 他喜欢打猎。

words.s: You should practice playing the violin every day.
words.sz: 你應該每天練習拉小提琴。

words.s: Did you get the package that I sent you?
words.sz: 你收到我寄給你的包裹了嗎？

t: 可见的， 看得见的， 有形的
words.s: Tom rolled up his trouser legs, making his bright red socks visible.
words.sz: 湯姆捲起褲管，露出鮮紅的襪子。

t: 危机， 存亡之际； 关键阶段
words.s: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
words.sz: 在危險的時候你必須跟你的老師聯繫。
words.d: A crisis is a difficult time when things are going to either get worse or better.

t: 栏杆，横杆；铁轨，轨道；铁路
words.s: I prefer traveling by rail because it’s more convenient than driving through traffic.
words.d: A rail is a system of tracks on which trains travel.

t: 幸存； 幸存者， 残存物
words.s: I gave up all hope of survival.
words.sz: 我放棄了所有生存的希望。

t: 微生物， 细菌； 幼芽
words.s: Germs are on everything that you touch.
words.d: A germ is a very small living thing that can make people sick.

words.s: Politicians never tell us their inner thoughts.
words.sz: 政治家从来不告诉我们他们的别有用心。

t: 市场； 股市； 行情， 销路
words.s: Tom thought that he had a chance to make a lot of money on the stock market.
words.sz: 汤姆觉得他有机会在股市赚一大笔钱。
words.d: A market is a place where people buy and sell products or food.

t: 热心的； 激烈的； 敏锐的， 敏捷的
words.s: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.
words.sz: 狗的嗅觉灵敏。
words.d: If someone is keen, they are intelligent.

words.s: I caught a glimpse of Mt. Fuji from the window of the train.
words.sz: 我從火車車窗瞥見了富士山。
words.d: To glimpse something is to see it for a short time.

words.s: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.
words.sz: 她僱了一個私人偵探看守她的丈夫。

t: 搬， 转移； 调动， 转学； 转让， 过户； 乘车， 转乘
words.s: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
words.sz: 我们会用银行转帐付款。
words.d: To transfer something means to move it from one place to another.

t: 脚步， 脚步声， 足迹

words.s: Tom is a Vietnam veteran.
words.sz: 汤姆是一个越军退役军人。
words.d: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience doing something.

t: 冷漠的， 不积极的； 一般的， 平平的
words.s: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
words.sz: 很多日本人對政治冷淡。
words.d: When someone is indifferent toward something, they have a lack of interest in it.

t: 在…的外面； 向…的外面； 除…以外
words.s: Outside the school, she saw people with no homes living in cardboard boxes.
words.sz: 她在校外見到沒家的人住紙板箱。

t: 神经； 勇敢， 胆量
words.s: She had the nerve to speak out.
words.sz: 她竟敢說出來。

words.s: Everyone knows of his affection for that dog.
words.sz: 人人都知道他對那狗的感情。
words.d: Affection is a feeling of liking someone or something.

words.s: If the lion is the king of beasts, the eagle is the king of birds.
words.sz: 狮子是兽类之王的话，鹰就是鸟类之王。

words.s: Do you remember the time you and I went to the zoo together when you and I were in elementary school?
words.sz: 你还记得我们还在小学时你和我一起去动物园那次吗？
words.d: An elementary thing is the first or most simple thing.

t: 题目， 论题， 话题
words.s: I chose this topic because I think that it's interesting.
words.sz: 我選這個主題是因為我覺得它很有意思。

t: 庄严的， 隆重的； 严肃的
words.s: The professor preferred a solemn relationship between him and his students.
words.d: If something is solemn, then it is serious and honest.

t: 感知， 感觉， 察觉； 认识到， 意识到； 理解
words.s: He was talking loudly, so he did not perceive that the music had stopped.
words.d: To perceive something means to be aware of it.

words.s: What did I omit?
words.sz: 我省略了什麼？
words.d: When you omit something, you leave it out or do not do it.

words.s: I didn't mean to embarrass you.
words.sz: 我沒想要讓你難堪。
words.d: To embarrass people is to make them feel ashamed or foolish.

t: 选择， 选择权， 选择自由； 选择的事物或人， 选课
words.s: What other option is there?
words.sz: 還有其他選擇嗎？
words.d: An option is a choice between two or more things.

words.s: The child held the erroneous belief that time machines were real.
words.d: When something is erroneous, it is incorrect or only partly correct.

t: 袭击； 突入查抄， 突入搜捕； 劫掠
words.s: The soldiers are looking for the people who continue to raid the jungle villages.
words.d: To raid is to attack a place in a short time in order to cause damage.

t: 政治， 政治学； 政纲， 政见
words.s: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
words.sz: 很多日本人對政治冷淡。

t: 严重的； 急性的； 灵敏的， 敏锐的； 精明的
words.s: When she fell out of the tree, the girl felt an acute pain in her arm.
words.d: When a bad thing is acute, it is very severe and intense.

t: 限制， 限度； 局限
发起； 资助， 赞助； 支持

words.s: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
words.sz: 一點點的運氣有時會導致意想不到的成功。

t: 至关重要的， 决定性的
words.s: This is a crucial point.
words.sz: 这是一个关键点。
words.d: If something is crucial, it is extremely important to another thing.

t: 捐献， 捐款； 投稿
words.s: We decided to contribute money to the new hospital.
words.d: To contribute to something means to do something to make it successful.

t: 信任； 信心； 信仰， 信条； 忠诚
words.s: I have absolute faith in you.
words.sz: 我百分之百相信你。
words.d: Faith is trust or belief without proof.

t: 插入， 嵌入； 登载
words.s: He inserted an extra sentence into the story.
words.d: To insert something means to put it in something else.

t: 话语； 谈论， 评论
words.s: The teacher remarked on how quickly the students were learning.
words.d: To remark is to say something.

t: 禁止， 不许， 阻止
words.s: After Robert used his crayons on the wall, his mother wanted to forbid him from using them at all!
words.d: To forbid means to order someone not to do something.

words.s: Do you know the difference between a microscope and a telescope?
words.sz: 你知道显微镜和望远镜的差别吗？
words.d: A microscope is a device that makes small objects look bigger.

words.s: Large houses are not necessarily comfortable to live in.
words.sz: 大房子不一定适合住。

t: 最精彩的部分； 最重要的事件
words.s: I read my vocabulary list and highlighted the most difficult words.
words.d: To highlight something means to mark it with a color so that it is easy to see.

t: 候选人； 投考者， 申请求职者
words.s: He was the strongest candidate for the position.
words.sz: 他是那个职位最有希望的候选人。
words.d: A candidate is a person who is competing to win something such as a job.

words.s: The company suffered a loss of one billion yen last year.
words.sz: 那家公司去年亏损了10亿日元。
words.d: A billion is a very large number: 1,000,000,000.

t: 平行的；类似的；并列的，并联的
可相比拟的事物；相似处；平行线，平行面；纬线
与…平行； 与…相似， 与…相当， 比得上
words.s: The opposite sides of a parallelogram are parallel.
words.sz: 平行四边形的对边平行。
words.d: If two things are parallel, they are the same distance away from each other (along their entire length).

t: 拒绝； 拒纳， 退回
words.s: I’m afraid the teacher will reject my new idea.
words.d: To reject is to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

words.s: The doctor tried every possible means to save his patient.
words.sz: 为抢救病人医生已尽力了。
words.d: If people are patient, they don’t become angry or upset easily.

words.s: Pay the cashier on the way out.
words.sz: 在出口處的收银台付款。

t: 完全的，十足的；陡峭的，垂直的；极薄的，透明的
words.s: It is a sheer waste of time.
words.sz: 這完全是浪費時間。
words.d: If you describe something as sheer, it is complete and total.

t: 奇迹， 令人惊奇的人
words.s: I can hope for a miracle, can't I?
words.sz: 我能等奇跡發生，是不是？
words.d: A miracle is an unexpected blessing which seems almost impossible, like a gift from heaven.

words.s: I made a small profit from selling my old clothes.
words.d: A profit is the extra money you make when you sell something.

words.s: Tom makes his own original Christmas cards every year.
words.sz: 湯姆每年都會製作自己獨創的聖誕節賀卡。
words.d: If something is original, it is the first one of that thing.

t: 风趣； 妙语； 智力， 才智， 智能
一把， 少数， 一小撮
words.s: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.
words.sz: 汤姆弯下腰，捧起了一把沙子。

t: 任务， 指定的作业； 分配， 指派
words.s: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
words.sz: 我用了比我预期更长的时间来完成作业。
words.d: An assignment is task that is given to you to do.

words.s: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
words.sz: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。
words.d: To yawn means to open one’s mouth wide and breathe in air.

words.s: I should have tried out this electric shaver before buying it.
words.sz: 我本该在买下这个电动剃须刀之前试一下的。
words.d: If something is electric, it uses electricity.

t: 晚期的，不治的；末端的，终点的，极限的
终点； 终端； 接线端
words.s: Since his condition was not terminal, he felt a great sense of relief.
words.d: If something is terminal, then it causes or results in death.

words.s: UK is the abbreviation for the United Kingdom.
words.sz: UK是英国的缩写。

t: 不同， 相异； 发生分歧
words.s: I'm afraid that I differ with you on this point.
words.sz: 恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。
words.d: To differ is to not be the same as another person or thing.

t: 各种各样的， 不同的
words.s: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
words.sz: 日本從國外進口各種原料。
words.d: If something is various, there are many types of it.

words.s: In the latter minutes of the game, the visitors scored the winning goal.
words.d: Latter describes something last in a series or the second choice of two things.

t: 抑郁， 沮丧； 不景气， 萧条； 洼地， 凹陷
words.s: After Tom lost his job, he started to gamble to cope with his depression.
words.sz: 湯姆失業後，為了排遣鬱悶的心情而開始了賭博。
words.d: Depression is a medical condition that makes a person very unhappy for long periods of time.

t: 减少， 缩小； 下降， 降低
words.s: He advocated the reduction of taxes.
words.sz: 他提倡減稅。

t: 广度； 范围； 程度
words.s: I agree with what you say to some extent.
words.sz: 在某种程度上，我认同你所说的。
words.d: The extent of something is how large, important, or serious it is.

words.s: The ages of the two children put together was equivalent to that of their father.
words.sz: 两个孩子的年龄加起来和他们的父亲相当。
words.d: An equivalent is an amount or value that is the same as another amount or value.

words.s: His shirt was stained with sauce.
words.sz: 他的衬衫被酱汁弄脏了。

words.s: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.
words.sz: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
words.d: To ban something is to not let people do it.

words.s: Slavic languages fascinate me.
words.sz: 斯拉夫语让我着迷。
words.d: To fascinate someone is to make that person very interested.

t: 遭受， 忍受， 容许； 受痛苦， 受损
words.s: I can't bear to see animals suffer.
words.sz: 我无法忍受看着动物受苦。
words.d: To suffer is to feel pain.

t: 外交的， 从事外交的； 策略的， 有手腕的
words.s: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
words.sz: 必须有外交解决的途径。

t: 蝙蝠； 球棒， 球拍
四邻； 附近； 接近

words.s: I am writing a draft of the speech.
words.sz: 我在寫演講的草稿。
words.d: A draft is a piece of written work that is not in its final form.

t: 企图，努力；喊价，出价，投标
喊价， 投标， 出； 祝， 表示； 命令
words.s: How much did you bid?
words.sz: 你出價多少？
words.d: A bid to do something is an attempt to do it.

words.s: The tight deadline will prompt the employee to work very hard.
words.d: To prompt is to cause someone to do something.

words.s: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
words.sz: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。
words.d: To astonish someone means to greatly surprise them.

t: 广泛的， 综合的； 理解的
words.s: The teacher gave us a comprehensive review for the exam.
words.d: If something is comprehensive, it has all the details about something else.

words.s: This tunnel is twice as long as that one.
words.sz: 這條隧道是那條的兩倍長。
words.d: A tunnel is an underground passage for cars, trains, etc. to go through.

t: 收回， 撤回； 撤退
words.s: After losing the battle, the enemy withdrew back to its own country.
words.d: To withdraw means to leave a place, usually during war.

t: 指派， 分配， 布置； 指定
words.s: I was assigned the job of making sure everyone had plenty to drink.
words.d: When you assign work, you give that work to particular people.

t: 复杂的； 精心制作的
words.s: She made elaborate preparations for the party.
words.sz: 她精心籌備了這個派對。
words.d: When something is elaborate, it contains a lot of details.

words.s: Down in the valley a mist like a white feather rose gently into a white cloud, and obscured everything.
words.sz: 山谷中，薄霧如白色羽毛般緩緩升騰，化作一團白雲，遮蔽了一切。
words.d: Feathers are the things covering a bird’s bodies.

t: 走廊， 回廊， 通路
words.s: He took the corridor on the left to go to his office.
words.d: A corridor is a narrow passage that leads into other areas.

words.s: She celebrated her three decades of work with the company.
words.d: A decade is a period of ten years.

words.s: Even expert drivers can make mistakes.
words.sz: 再怎麼經驗老到的司機都會出錯。
words.d: An expert is someone who is very good at doing something.

t: 精选的， 挑选出来的； 优等的， 第一流的
words.s: They had to select textbooks for each class.
words.d: When you select something, you carefully choose it.

t: 履行， 实现， 完成； 满足， 使满意
words.s: The professor did not fulfill his promise not to miss a single class.
words.d: To fulfill something means to achieve or finish it.

t: 聚集； 挤满； 挤； 推
words.s: I heard someone in the crowd outside the station call my name.
words.sz: 我聽到車站外的人群中有人在叫我的名字。
words.d: A crowd is a large group of people who are together in one place.

t: 代表大会； [C-]国会， 议会
words.s: Congress makes laws for people to follow.
words.d: Congress is a group of leaders in a government.

t: 先进的； 高级的； 年迈的； 后阶段的
机械的， 机械制造的； 机械学的， 力学的； 呆板的
推荐， 推荐信； 建议； 优点， 可取之处
words.s: Tom got the job on the strength of your recommendation.
words.sz: 多亏了你的推荐，汤姆得到了那份工作。

t: 幸福； 福利， 福利救济
words.s: France is running a welfare state it can no longer afford.
words.sz: 法國是一個福利國家，但它卻不再能夠負擔得起了。
words.d: Welfare is the health and happiness of a person or group.

words.s: The Roman Empire flourished in Europe two thousand years ago.
words.d: To flourish means to do very well and be in an excellent condition.

words.s: The boss hired more workers to increase the factory’s output of products.
words.d: Output is the amount of something that a person or thing produces.

words.s: After three days with little sleep, she was feeling a lot of fatigue.
words.d: Fatigue is a feeling of extreme tiredness.

t: 显著的， 突出的； 惹人注目的， 容貌出众的
容器； 船； 飞船； 管
words.s: We toured the area aboard a luxury vessel.
words.d: A vessel is a large ship or boat.

words.s: The bill passed by a small majority of 10 votes.
words.sz: 法案以10票微弱多数通过。
words.d: A majority of something is more than half of the people or things in that group.

t: 拖，拉；迫使，硬拉；拖着脚步走
累赘； 一吸， 一抽
words.s: The dog was dragging his owner down the street.
words.d: To drag something means to pull it across the ground.

words.s: There's a crown here.
words.sz: 这里有个皇冠。
words.d: A crown is the hat worn by a king or queen.

words.s: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.
words.sz: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。

t: 打听， 询问； 调查
words.s: Dad called to inquire about the price of tickets for the show.
words.d: To inquire about something is to ask about it.

words.s: When I go to the gymnasium, I use the treadmill for twenty minutes.
words.d: A gymnasium is a building with equipment that you can use to get exercise.

t: 发行， 分发， 发出
words.s: How do you feel about the issue?
words.sz: 你對這個問題有甚麼感受？
words.d: An issue is an important topic.

words.s: He endeavored to make his wife happy, but in vain.
words.sz: 他試著想讓他妻子開心，但是沒有成功。
words.d: If people are vain, they are only concerned with how they look.

words.s: Owing to its landmass, the Antarctic has an air temperature lower than that of the Arctic.
words.sz: 南極因為有大陸，所以氣溫低於北極。
words.d: To lower something is to make it go down.

t: 索引； 指数， 指标
words.s: If you look in the index, you’ll find the right page number.
words.d: An index is a list of words at the end of a book that gives information.

t: 油煎， 油炸， 油炒
words.s: Tom doesn't even know how to fry an egg.
words.sz: 汤姆甚至连怎么煎鸡蛋都不知道。

t: 青年， 年轻人， 孩子
奇特的； 临时的； 奇数的； 单只的； 剩余的， 挂零的
words.s: One is the smallest odd number.
words.sz: 一是最小的奇數。
words.d: Something odd is unusual.

words.s: That man died of lung cancer a week ago.
words.sz: 那个男人在一周前死于肺癌。
words.d: A lung is a part of the body that fills with air when breathing.

t: 保存； 保护； 守恒
分心的事； 心烦意乱； 精神错乱； 娱乐， 消遣
增补， 补充； 增刊， 副刊
words.s: He supplements his diet with fresh fruits.
words.d: To supplement something is to add something else to it in a good way.

t: 形成对比， 对比之下显出区别
对比， 对照； 反差
words.s: The contrast between my parents is very noticeable.
words.d: A contrast is a sharp difference between two things.

words.s: This paragraph is vague.
words.sz: 這一個段落是模糊不清的。

t: 意见； 审判； 判断
words.s: We can rely on his judgement.
words.sz: 我們可以信賴他的判斷。

t: 比例； 部分， 份儿； 均衡， 相称
words.s: Only a small proportion of the people in this town actually work here.
words.d: A proportion is an amount that shows the link between the parts and the whole.

t: 水晶， 结晶体， 晶粒
发生， 出现； 发生的事件

words.s: Interest rates and inflation were high.
words.sz: 利率和通货膨胀很高。

words.s: I can't look at this painting without thinking of my mom.
words.sz: 我無法看著這幅畫而不想起我母親。

words.s: Usually I cycle or get the bus to work.
words.sz: 我通常骑自行车或乘公交车去上班。
words.d: A cycle is a series of events that go in a circle from the end back to the beginning again.

t: 丢掉， 销毁； 处理； 排列， 布置
words.s: My car is at your disposal.
words.sz: 你可以随便用我的车。

t: 解决； 协议； 居留地
委派…为代表； 授 ， 把…委托给
文学， 文学作品； 文献， 图书资料
words.s: He studies contemporary literature.
words.sz: 他学习现代文学。
words.d: Literature is books, plays, and poetry.

words.s: The balloons were inflated into a variety of colorful spheres.
words.d: A sphere is a three-dimensional round shape, like a ball.

t: 询问， 打听； 调查
使有偏见； 对…不利， 损害
words.s: I don't have a prejudice against foreign workers.
words.sz: 我对外籍员工没有偏见。
words.d: A prejudice is an unfair opinion about people based on the group they belong to.

t: 溶解； 解散； 消失， 减弱； 结束
words.s: I dissolved the pill in a glass of water.
words.d: To dissolve something is to mix it into a liquid until it disappears.

words.s: Allow some time for food to be digested before going swimming.
words.d: To digest means to swallow food and pass it through the body.

t: 角， 角度； 观点， 立场
words.s: An angle of 90 degrees is called a right angle.
words.sz: 90度的角叫直角。
words.d: An angle is the direction from which something is looked at.

words.s: My parents were immigrants. They came from Poland.
words.d: An immigrant is a person who moves to a different country.

words.s: Marriage is a tradition all over the world.
words.d: A tradition is something people have been doing for a long time.

t: 能力， 本领； 才能， 才智
words.s: I'm not satisfied with my English ability.
words.sz: 我不滿意我的英語能力。
words.d: Ability is the quality of a person being able to do something well.

words.s: If there's anything urgent, you can get in touch with me.
words.sz: 紧急情况下，您可以联系我。
words.d: An urgent thing is important and needs to be done now.

t: 信任， 相信； 信念
words.s: It's my belief that knowledge is power.
words.sz: 我相信，知识就是力量。
words.d: A belief is a strong feeling that something is correct or true.

t: 收集， 归拢； 把…塞入
建议， 意见； 细微的迹象； 暗示
words.s: Her suggestion seems to have been turned down.
words.sz: 她的建议好像被拒绝了。

t: 有系统的， 有计划的
柜橱； 碗碟橱， 食橱
words.s: She folded up the towels and put them away in the cupboard.
words.sz: 她把毛巾折叠好再放入柜子里。
words.d: A cupboard is a piece of furniture that is used to store food or household items.

t: 一般地， 通常地； 普遍地
words.s: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
words.sz: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。
words.d: We use generally in place of “in most cases” or “to most people.”

words.s: Would you like bacon or sausage?
words.sz: 你要培根还是要香肠?

words.s: If Joe is not going to school so he can go swimming, I want to do likewise.
words.d: If someone does something likewise, they do the same thing as someone else.

t: 细长的， 苗条的； 微薄的， 不足的
令人烦恼的， 麻烦的
命令， 指示； 用法说明； 教学， 教导

words.s: After I got married, my Japanese got better and I could understand more.
words.sz: 在我结婚之后，我的日语水平提高了，能理解更多日语了。

t: 办理， 处理； 交易， 业务； 会报， 学报
words.s: Because the clerk was new at the job, the simple transaction took a long time.
words.d: A transaction is an act of buying or selling something.

t: 意识到的， 自觉的； 神志清醒的； 有意的， 存心的
words.s: To make matters worse, he isn't even conscious of annoying his neighbors.
words.sz: 让事情更糟糕的是，他没有注意到他打扰到了邻居。
words.d: If someone is conscious of something, then they are aware of it.

t: 软毛， 毛皮， 裘皮； 毛皮衣服
words.s: Fur coats are on sale.
words.sz: 毛皮大衣在打折。

words.s: She gave out a sigh of relief.
words.sz: 她鬆了一口氣。
words.d: To sigh is to breathe out loudly to show tiredness, boredom, or sadness.

t: 经常的，不断的，连续发生的；永恒的；忠实的，忠诚的
words.s: Tom found Mary's constant criticism of him hard to cope with.
words.sz: 汤姆认为和经常批评他的玛丽很难相处。
words.d: When an event or action is constant, it happens a lot or all of the time.

t: 长裤， 便裤； 内裤
words.s: I want to buy a pair of pants.
words.sz: 我想買條褲子。

t: 给…错误印象， 使误解； 把…带错路； 使误入歧途
words.s: I didn't want to mislead anyone.
words.sz: 我不想誤導任何人。

t: 分裂，分离；被撕裂，裂开；分担，分享
words.s: Let's split the reward fifty-fifty.
words.sz: 讓我們平分這個報酬吧。

words.s: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
words.sz: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

t: 出版， 发行； 公布， 发表
words.s: Publication of the article was timed to coincide with the professor's birthday.
words.sz: 文章的发表被预定在教授生日那天。
words.d: A publication is something printed, like a newspaper or book.

words.s: I haven't yet collected sufficient materials to write a book.
words.sz: 我還沒有收集到足夠的材料來寫一本書。
words.d: Sufficient shows that something is enough, in quality or quantity.

t: 声称，主张；对…提出要求，索取；以…为其成果；需要，值得
要求， 认领， 索赔； 声称； 断言
words.s: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.
words.sz: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。
words.d: To claim means to say that something is true.

words.s: Can you tell me where the nearest antique shop is?
words.sz: 你能告诉我最近的古玩店在哪里吗？
words.d: If something is antique, it is very old and rare, and therefore valuable.

words.s: Farmers sow seeds in the spring.
words.sz: 农民在春天播种。
words.d: To sow seeds means to plant them in the ground.

words.s: There was widespread panic after the earthquake.
words.sz: 地震後人們普遍覺得恐慌。
words.d: Something that is widespread is spread widely across the world.

words.s: The petroleum at that factory is used to make gasoline.
words.d: Petroleum is a liquid natural resource from which many fuels are made.

t: 通讯， 交流， 交际； 通信工具， 交通联系
words.s: English is a means of communication.
words.sz: 英語是一種溝通的手段。

t: 直接地； 正好地， 截然； 立即
words.s: I got the information from him directly.
words.sz: 我直接從他那裡得到訊息。

t: 忍受， 容忍， 忍耐力； 公差
words.s: Boxers have a high tolerance for pain.
words.d: Tolerance is the ability to accept something unfavorable or to allow the freedom of choice for others.

words.s: Daryl kneeled down on one knee and asked Nina to marry him.
words.d: To kneel is to put one or both knees on the ground.

t: 搬运工人； 看门人， 大楼管理员

words.s: Fasten your seat belt, please.
words.sz: 請繫好安全帶。
words.d: To fasten something is to close it or attach it to something.

t: 争夺， 与…竞争； 对…提出质疑， 辩驳
words.s: My father participated in a cooking contest and came in first.
words.sz: 我爸爸参加了料理竞赛并得了第一名。
words.d: A contest is a game or a race.

words.s: This is the room where the author killed himself.
words.sz: 这就是那个作家自杀的房间。
words.d: An author is a person who wrote a certain piece of writing.

t: 灰尘， 土； 污物， 污垢
words.s: The children were playing in the dirt.
words.sz: 孩子们在尘土里游戏。

words.s: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
words.sz: 有的科學家認為溫室效應是虛構的。
words.d: A greenhouse is a small glass building that is used to grow plants.

t: 保护， 维持； 保存； 腌制
words.s: Salt helps to preserve food from decay.
words.sz: 鹽可以幫助保存食物避免腐爛。
words.d: To preserve is to protect something from harm.

words.s: The sum of two plus three plus four is nine.
words.sz: 二加三加四的和是九。

t: 建立， 设立； 确立； 证实
words.s: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
words.sz: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。
words.d: To establish something means to create it.

t: 扩大， 扩充， 扩张， 膨胀

words.s: I thought his opinion was relevant.
words.sz: 我認為他的意見很中肯。
words.d: When something is relevant, it is important to a certain person or situation.

t: 入口处； 登记； 进入； 参赛者名单； 条目

words.s: I think you'll have very little difficulty in getting a driver's license.
words.sz: 我想您要拿到驾照根本不难。
words.d: A license is an official document that gives one permission to do something.

t: 综合的， 合成的； 虚假的
words.s: Clothing made out of synthetic fabrics is very effective at keeping people warm.
words.d: If something is synthetic, then it is made to be like something natural.

words.s: He took the long route to the headquarters because it was a nice day.
words.d: A headquarters is a building where the bosses of a company work.

words.s: A balloon will expand as you blow air into it.
words.d: To expand is to become bigger in size.

words.s: We used a telescope to gaze at the stars for over an hour.
words.d: To gaze at something means to look at it for a long time.

t: 短文， 散文， 小品文
words.s: I'm looking for a native speaker who could help me correct this essay.
words.sz: 我正在尋找可以幫我修改這篇論文的母語人士。
words.d: An essay is a short piece of writing on a certain subject.

t: 俯瞰； 检查； 测量
调查， 勘察； 测量， 勘测； 全面审视， 概括论述
words.s: I filled out a survey about my shopping experience at the department store.
words.d: A survey is a set of questions that are asked to a large number of people in order to find out about opinions.

t: 集中， 挤在一起； 形成一束
words.s: The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.
words.sz: 该名青年将少女从流氓团伙中救了出来。
words.d: A bunch is a group of the same things.

words.s: The thermometer outside the window indicated that it was a hot day today.
words.d: A thermometer is a device that measures temperature.

words.s: The situation seemed very tense and dangerous.
words.sz: 形势似乎非常紧张严峻。
words.d: When you are tense, you are not comfortable and feel unhappy.

words.s: They postponed the meeting until Elena arrived.
words.d: To postpone something is to make it happen later than planned.

words.s: The bride seems to be very pretty.
words.sz: 新娘好像非常漂亮。

t: 有利的， 赞成的； 顺利的

words.s: To the man who only has a hammer in the toolkit, every problem looks like a nail.
words.sz: 对工具箱里只有一把榔头的人来说，所有的问题都像钉子。

words.s: I never should've let Tom eat so much candy.
words.sz: 我不論甚麼時候都不該讓湯姆吃那麼多糖。

t: 心理的， 精神的， 思想上的； 精神病的； 智力的
words.s: I made a mental picture of the room.
words.d: If something is mental, it has to do with your mind.

t: 像样的， 过得去的， 体面的； 宽厚的， 大方的； 正派的； 合乎礼仪的， 得体的
words.s: Tom is a decent sort of guy.
words.sz: 湯姆是箇誠實的孩子。
words.d: A decent person or thing is OK or good enough.

words.s: He announced that he would come at once and investigate the matter.
words.sz: 他宣布他將立刻來調查此事。
words.d: To investigate means to search for something or learn about it.

words.s: He fought against racial discrimination.
words.sz: 他反对种族歧视。
words.d: If something is racial, then it is related to a race or races.

words.s: Switch on the light. I can't see anything.
words.sz: 把灯打开。我什么都看不见了。
words.d: To switch means to change something to something else.

words.s: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
words.sz: 已經花費了很多的時間和精力。
words.d: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

t: 辅助的， 附属的； 后备的
愈合， 痊愈， 恢复健康
使愈合，治愈，使康复；调停，消除
words.s: This ointment will help heal your wounds.
words.d: To heal is to become healthy or well again.

t: 储备； 保留； 拘谨， 矜持； 替补队员， 后备部队； 自然保护区
words.s: I'd like to reserve a room in a hotel.
words.sz: 我想要订房。
words.d: To reserve something means to keep it for a certain person or time.

t: 由于某种原因， 不知怎么的； 以某种方式
words.s: We have to have fun somehow.
words.sz: 我们总得找点乐子。

t: 跳水； 潜水； 俯冲
words.s: I like sky-diving from an airplane.
words.d: When you dive into water, you go down head first into the water.

t: 砖， 砖块， 砖状物
words.s: There were several bricks scattered on the ground.
words.d: A brick is a block of hard clay that is used for building things, such as walls.

t: 同情； 一致， 支持， 赞同
words.s: Everybody showed sympathy toward the prisoner.
words.sz: 每个人都对囚犯表示同情。
words.d: Sympathy is a feeling of sadness for another person who feels bad.

words.s: After the building was torn down, all that was left was a heap of bricks.
words.d: A heap of things is a large pile of them.

t: 消费者， 用户， 消耗者

words.s: I'm going to help you rescue Tom.
words.sz: 我要幫你營救湯姆。
words.d: To rescue someone means to remove them from danger.

t: 高度地， 极， 非常赞许地
words.s: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
words.sz: 我知道不太可能有人願意幫助我。

t: 向…介绍基本情况，做…的提要
words.s: The lawyers took a brief break.
words.d: A brief action lasts a short time.

words.s: Paul spilled coffee all over his keyboard.
words.d: A keyboard has buttons marked with letters and numbers that are pressed to put information into a computer.

t: 主动性； 首创精神； 主动的行动， 倡议； 主动权
重新获得， 挽回； 恢复

words.sz: 你知道怎么恢复已删除的文件吗？

words.s: When people meet, first impressions determine more than 50 percent of whatever happens next.
words.sz: 在人际交往中，第一印象决定着将要发生的事情内容的百分之五十以上。

t: 大自然； 本性； 性质
words.s: She expressed her feelings for nature in a poem.
words.sz: 她通過一首詩表達了她對大自然的感受。
words.d: Nature is everything in the physical world that is not made by people.

t: 社会的； 交际的， 社交的
words.s: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
words.sz: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。
words.d: If something is social, it is about many people in a community.

words.s: I've been taking this medication for many years.
words.sz: 这种药我吃了好多年了。
words.d: Medication is medicine or drugs given to people who are sick.

words.s: The carpenter used the drill to make several holes in the wood.
words.d: A drill is a tool with a point that spins in order to make a hole.

words.s: He is not as intelligent as his older brother.
words.sz: 他不像他的兄长那样聪明。
words.d: If someone is intelligent, they are very smart.

t: 店员， 办事员， 职员
words.s: Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.
words.sz: 汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。
words.d: A clerk is a type of worker. Clerks in a store help customers.

t: 大厅；休息室；院外活动集团
words.s: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.
words.sz: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。

t: 承认， 承认…的权威； 告知收到， 确认； 对…表示感谢， 报偿
words.s: The teacher acknowledged that the young student was hungry.
words.d: To acknowledge something is to accept that it is true or that it exists.

t: 装备， 配备； 使有准备
words.s: Steve was equipped with the tools needed to do the job.
words.d: To equip someone is to give them the things needed to do something.

t: 放射物， 辐射能； 辐射

words.sz: 平流層的臭氧會吸收紫外線。

words.s: Check Tom's pulse again.
words.sz: 再检查一下汤姆的脉搏。

words.s: Our honeymoon resort was a luxury we really enjoyed.
words.d: A luxury is an expensive thing that is nice but not needed.

t: 精神的， 心灵的； 宗教的
值得花时间的， 值得做的
words.s: On his visit to Canada, he realized studying English was worthwhile.
words.d: If something is worthwhile, it is important or useful.

t: 霉，霉菌；模型，铸模；性格，气质
用模子做， 浇铸； 使形成， 把…铸造成

words.s: My elbow still hurts.
words.sz: 我的手肘還在痛。
words.d: The elbow is the middle part of an arm, where it bends.

words.s: Mary put some roasted pecans into her salad.
words.sz: 瑪莉在沙拉裡放了一些烤山核桃。

t: 对全局有重要意义的， 关键的； 战略的

words.s: Social customs vary from country to country.
words.sz: 国家不同，习俗各异。
words.d: To vary means to be different from another thing in size or amount.

t: 乐意地， 欣然地； 容易地； 很快地， 立即
上面的， 地位较高的
words.s: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.
words.sz: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。
words.d: An upper position is a higher position.

words.s: The rocket was launched into space.
words.sz: 火箭發射進入太空。

words.s: From his head down to his shoes, his clothes looked splendid.
words.d: If something or someone is splendid, then they are very good.

words.s: He wanted to represent the citizens of his county.
words.d: A county is the largest division of a state in a country.

t: 回答者； 响应者； 被告
一个事件； 插曲， 片段； 连续剧的一集
words.s: We watched the final exciting episode of the TV series.
words.d: An episode is something that happens as part of a series of events.

words.s: I love the convenience of having a swimming pool in my back yard.
words.d: If something is done for your convenience, it allows you to do something easily or without any trouble.

t: 决心， 决定； 确定
words.s: She works with single-minded determination.
words.sz: 她一心一意地工作。
words.d: Determination is what you have when you try to do something even when it is difficult.

t: 训练； 惩罚， 处罚

words.d: Discipline is training that helps people follow the rules.

words.s: He is acting on his own behalf.
words.sz: 他为自己的利益行事。
words.d: If something is done on one’s behalf, it is done for that person by another.

words.s: Evidently, it's going to rain tomorrow.
words.sz: 明天肯定会下雨。

words.s: My objective this week is to finish my homework by 7:30 every night.
words.d: An objective is a goal or plan that someone has.

t: 伤害， 损害， 使遭受损伤
words.s: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
words.sz: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。
words.d: To injure someone means to damage a part of their body.

words.s: You exert a lot of energy when you lift weights.
words.d: To exert means to use strength or ability to do something.

words.s: Canada is divided into several different provinces.
words.d: A province is an area that is controlled by a country.

t: 丑事， 丑闻； 流言蜚语； 反感， 愤慨
words.s: That scandal cost him his reputation.
words.sz: 丑闻让他付出了失去声誉的代价。

t: 令人恐惧的， 可怕的； 骇人听闻的； 极讨厌的， 使人不愉快的； 糟透的
words.s: I just wish we could leave this horrible place.
words.sz: 我只是希望我们能离开这个可怕的地方。
words.d: A horrible thing is very bad.

t: 估计； 评价， 看法
words.s: How much time do you estimate it'll take you to do that?
words.sz: 你估计做那件事需要花费你多少时间呢？
words.d: To estimate something means to make a guess about it.

words.s: I heard water dripping from the faucet.
words.d: To drip is to fall a little bit at a time.

t: 损害， 伤害； 受伤处
words.s: Not all of the passengers escaped injury.
words.sz: 並非所有的乘客都免於受傷。

words.s: My painting will be exhibited at the fair.
words.d: To exhibit is to show something so that people can go look at it.

t: 铭刻， 打烙印于； 加污名于， 谴责
words.s: It's brand new.
words.sz: 这是全新的。

words.sz: 酒的消费每年都在上升。

t: 使窒息； 塞满， 塞住

words.d: If you choke on something, it stops you from breathing.

t: 提议， 建议； 求婚
words.s: I can't think of any other way of getting him to accept our proposal.
words.sz: 我看不出有其他方法能让他接受我们的提议。

t: 不可避免的， 必然的
words.s: Their meeting was inevitable.
words.sz: 他們的相遇是必然的。
words.d: When something is inevitable, it is certain to happen or cannot be avoided.

t: 否定， 否认； 拒绝…的要求
words.s: We can't deny the fact that he's honest.
words.sz: 我们无法否认，他确实是很诚实的人。

t: 痛苦的； 悲惨的； 令人难受的
words.s: He was miserable after his dog died.
words.d: A miserable person is very unhappy.

words.s: Subtract three from eight and you get five.
words.sz: 八减去三就能得到五。
words.d: To subtract means to take something away.

t: 津贴， 补贴； 零用钱
便于携带的， 手提式的
古代的， 古老的； 年老的， 看上去很老的
words.s: Rome has a lot of ancient buildings.
words.sz: 罗马有很多古建筑。
words.d: If something is ancient, it is very old.

t: 光荣， 荣誉的事； 美丽
words.s: They enjoyed the glory of the beautiful sunset.
words.d: Glory is the importance, magnificence, or specialness of something.

t: 次要的， 第二的； 中等的； 辅助的， 从属的
使命， 任务； 使团
words.s: Who picked you for this mission?
words.sz: 谁选你来做这个任务？
words.d: A mission is an important job that is sometimes far away.

words.s: The attorney appeared in front of the judge for me.
words.d: An attorney is one who gives others advice about the law.

t: 漫游， 闲逛， 漫步； 偏离正道； 走神， 恍惚
words.s: The boys like to wander in the woods and look at birds.
words.d: To wander is to walk without going to a certain place.

t: 收养； 采用， 采取； 正式通过， 批准
words.s: If you can't have children, you could always adopt.
words.sz: 如果你不能有孩子，你总能领养。

words.s: I want to be a police officer because I oppose crime.
words.d: To oppose something means to dislike it or act against it.

t: 单数的； 非凡的， 奇特的； 独一无二的
器械， 装置， 设备； 手段， 策略

words.sz: 你应该给他看看这装置。
words.d: A device is an object or a machine.

words.sz: 总体上说，日本人很保守。

words.s: I often use SSH to access my computers remotely.
words.sz: 我经常使用SSH来远程连接到我的电脑。
words.d: Access is the right to enter or use something.

t: 会议， 讨论会； 讨论， 商谈
words.s: Please attend the meeting in the second floor conference room at 2:30 p.m.
words.sz: 请在两点半参加在二楼会议室的会议。

words.s: Watching TV is a passive activity.
words.sz: 看電視是一種被動的活動。

words.d: If something is primitive, then it is simple, basic, and not very developed.

words.s: I will move into the dormitory at the beginning of the school year.
words.d: A dormitory is a school building where students live.

t: 战胜， 克服； 压倒， 使受不了

words.sz: 如何克服日元升高是个大问题。
words.d: To overcome a problem is to successfully fix it.

words.s: The members of the team agreed to cooperate in order to get the project done.
words.d: To cooperate is to work with someone to achieve something that you both want.

t: 小屋； 船舱， 机舱

words.sz: 伯拉罕·林肯，美国第16任总统，生于肯塔基州的一个简陋的小屋里。

words.s: He anonymously donated a large sum of money to the Red Cross.
words.sz: 他匿名向红十字捐了大笔钱。
words.d: A sum is a specific amount of money.

t: 当前的， 通用的； 流行的， 流传的
words.s: An electric current can generate magnetism.
words.sz: 電流可以產生磁性。
words.d: A current is a steady and constant flow of air or water in a river or ocean.

t: 脚后跟， 踵； 后跟
多样化； 种类； 变种
words.s: We talked about a variety of topics.
words.sz: 我們談了各種話題。
words.d: A variety of something is a group of many different kinds of it.

t: 打扰， 扰乱； 弄乱； 使不安
words.s: I'll try not to disturb you while you're studying.
words.sz: 我会尽量不打扰你复习。
words.d: To disturb someone means to upset that person.

t: 铜； 铜币， 铜制器

words.d: Copper is a red-brown metal often used in electric wire and pipes.

words.s: Even though the lesson was difficult, he persisted until he understood.
words.d: To persist means to keep doing something even when it is hard.

words.s: It was Todd’s job to keep civilians from entering the army facility.
words.d: A civilian is someone who is not in the military.

words.s: The arrow pierced the target in the very center.
words.d: To pierce something means to make a hole in it using a sharp object.

words.s: I feel like I'm a teenager again.
words.sz: 我感覺又變成了少年。

t: 成距离，相间隔；分开，除去
words.s: Apart from on rainy days, I always ride my bike to work.
words.sz: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。
words.d: When people or things are apart, they are not next to each other.

t: 日历， 历书， 历法
words.s: She hung the calendar on the wall.
words.sz: 她把日曆掛在牆上了。
words.d: A calendar is a chart that shows the days, weeks, and months of a year.

t: 冒犯的，无礼的；进攻的，攻击性的

words.sz: 发言人的评论极有攻击性。

t: 卡通画， 幽默画； 动画片， 卡通片
words.s: Sometimes, people draw cartoons for the newspaper.
words.d: A cartoon is a funny drawing.

t: 推测， 推断； 投机， 做投机买卖
words.s: My sister looked at the sky and speculated that it would rain tomorrow.
words.d: To speculate means to guess about something.

words.s: Prepare to launch torpedoes.
words.sz: 準備發射魚雷。
words.d: To launch something means to make it go into motion.

words.d: If something is amid something else, then it is in the middle of it.

t: 所钟爱的， 所爱戴的

words.d: When something is beloved, it is very special and you like it very much.

words.s: Tom is single and has a three-year-old daughter.
words.sz: Tom單身，他有個三歲的女兒。
words.d: If something is single, then there is only one.

t: 证实， 肯定； 确认； 批准
words.s: I can neither confirm nor deny that.
words.sz: 我既不能確認也不能否定。
words.d: To confirm is to make sure something is correct.

t: 黏结； 巩固， 使团结

words.s: In London, the police are always worried about finding a bomb on the train or subway.
words.sz: 在倫敦，警察總是擔心在列車或地鐵上發現炸彈。

words.s: Nancy acquainted herself with the new computer.
words.d: To acquaint is to get to know something or someone.

t: 任命， 委任； 约定， 指定
words.s: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.
words.sz: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。
words.d: To appoint someone to a job means to give the job to them.

words.s: He attached the elastic bungee to his legs before he jumped of the platform.
words.d: Elastic is a rubber that stretches when it is pulled.

t: 援助， 帮助， 协助
words.s: I'll be able to assist you.
words.sz: 我能協助你。
words.d: To assist someone is to help them.

t: 巨大的， 大量的； 浩瀚的
words.s: The Sahara is a vast desert.
words.sz: 撒哈拉沙漠广袤无垠。
words.d: If something is vast, it is very large.

t: 干涉， 调停， 干预； 插入， 介入； 干扰， 打扰
words.s: We must intervene.
words.sz: 我们必须介入。
words.d: To intervene means to help stop a problem between two people or groups.

words.s: She was excited to finish high school and enroll as an undergraduate in the fall.
words.d: An undergraduate is a student at a college who is studying for a bachelor’s degree.

t: 象征； 符号， 标志
words.s: I don't know what this symbol stands for.
words.sz: 我不知道這個符號代表什麼意思。
words.d: A symbol is a thing that stands for something else.

t: 商业的， 商务的； 商品化的， 商业性的

words.s: Mike and Joanna are joint owners of a coffee shop.
words.d: When something is joint, it is done by or involves two or more people or groups.

t: 通情达理的， 讲道理的； 合理的； 公道的； 尚好的， 过得去的

words.sz: Tom用合理的價格買了相機。

t: 现成可使用的， 通用的； 可取的； 联系的； 可得到的
words.s: Sir, that CD is available only by special order.
words.sz: 先生，那盘CD需要预定才有。
words.d: If something is available, it means you can get it.

t: 限制， 使局限； 使不外出， 禁闭
words.s: The elephant is confined to a cage in the zoo.
words.d: To confine something is to keep it in one place.

t: 拥护， 提倡， 主张
拥护者， 提倡者； 辩护者， 律师
words.s: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.
words.sz: 我在给魔鬼当辩护士。
words.d: To advocate a plan or idea is to support or suggest it in public.

t: 屡次； 次数， 频率
words.s: The frequency of rainstorms is very high, especially during the spring.
words.d: The frequency of something is the number of times that it happens.

words.s: The stripes were horizontal.
words.sz: 條紋是水平的。
words.d: When something is horizontal, it is fat and level with the ground.

words.s: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
words.sz: 先生，我們可以檢查一下您的行李嗎？

t: 舔，舔吃；打败，克服；轻拍，吞卷
words.s: He licked his ice cream before it melted.
words.d: When you lick something, you pass your tongue over it.

t: 导弹， 飞弹， 投射物
有活力的；动力的；不断变化的

words.d: When people are dynamic, they are lively and have creative ideas.

words.s: The explanation is by no means satisfactory.
words.sz: 這個解釋不是很令人滿意。
words.d: A satisfactory thing is good enough.

words.s: The Japanese military forces seemed too strong to stop.
words.sz: 日本军队看来强大得不可阻挡。
words.d: The military is the armed forces of a country.

words.s: She was reluctant to say that she saw the robbery.
words.d: Reluctant means not wanting to do something.

t: 发生， 引起； 生殖
words.s: An electric current can generate magnetism.
words.sz: 電流可以產生磁性。
words.d: To generate something means to cause it to develop or begin.

t: 不平常的， 少有的； 独特的， 与众不同的
words.s: We were faced with an unusual situation because of the accident.
words.sz: 那场事故让我们陷入了不寻常的局势。

t: 部门， 部分； 防御地段， 防区； 扇形
words.s: We learned about just a few of the factories within the manufacturing sector.
words.d: A sector is a part of a country’s economy in a specific type of industry.

t: 激情， 热情； 酷爱

words.sz: 詩人對他愛的女人表達了他火熱的激情。

words.s: Your proposal is a bit extreme.
words.sz: 你的建議有點極端。

words.s: Saving now will ensure we have enough money for our retirement.
words.d: When you ensure something, you make sure it happens.

words.s: Each skating team had to coordinate their movements for the show.
words.d: To coordinate things is to make different parts work together.

t: 生物， 有机体； 机体， 有机组织
words.s: We studied the organism under the microscope.
words.d: An organism is a living thing, especially a very small one.

words.s: Tom is a natural athlete.
words.sz: 汤姆天生就是个运动员。
words.d: An athlete is a person who plays sports.

words.s: It was difficult to stop the flu epidemic.
words.d: An epidemic is an outbreak of a disease that spreads quickly.

t: 猜想， 假定， 让； [常用于被动语态]期望， 认为应该

words.sz: 假如你有1000美元，你会用它做什么呢？
words.d: To suppose is to guess.

words.s: Meerkats can’t walk like humans, but they can stand upright.
words.d: If something is upright, it is standing up straight.

t: 值得注意的， 引人注目的； 异常的， 非凡的
words.s: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.
words.sz: 这几年，科学取得了显著的进步。

t: 制动； 刹住， 用闸使放慢速度
管， 电子管， 显像管
words.s: Please buy a tube of toothpaste.
words.sz: 請買條牙膏吧。
words.d: A tube is a pipe through which water or air passes.

words.s: The country sent all of its naval forces to protect them.
words.d: When something is naval, it relates to a country’s navy or military ships.

t: 失败， 失败的人； 失灵， 故障； 不履行
words.s: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
words.sz: 把你的失败归咎于你的父母是不对的。
words.d: A failure happens when something is not done right.

t: 打制， 锻造； 伪造
words.s: Stacy and Heather forged their friendship when they were teenagers.
words.d: To forge is to make or produce, especially with difficulty.

words.s: A green carpet will not go with this blue curtain.
words.sz: 绿色的毯子和这条蓝色的帘子不配。
words.d: A carpet is a thick, heavy, woven fabric used to cover the floor.

t: 解答； 解释； 解决
words.s: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
words.sz: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。
words.d: To solve something is to find an answer to it.

t: 暗示，示意；细微的迹象；建议
words.s: Would you give me a hint?
words.sz: 你可以给我一个提示吗？
words.d: A hint is information that suggests something will happen or is true.

t: 说明； 论证； 表露
words.s: Can you demonstrate it?
words.sz: 您可以示範一下嗎?
words.d: To demonstrate something is to show how it is done.

t: 地区， 地带， 区域； 范围， 幅度
words.s: A string of disasters struck the region.
words.sz: 一連串的災難襲擊這個地區。
words.d: A region is a large area of land usually based on some common feature.

t: 支持， 支撑物， 支持者
words.s: I don't expect that they will support my view.
words.sz: 我不期望，他们能够支持我的观点。
words.d: To support something is to like it and help it be successful.

t: 欺骗， 蒙蔽， 行骗
words.s: It's wrong to deceive people, but worse to deceive yourself.
words.sz: 欺騙別人是錯的,但更糟的欺騙自己。
words.d: To deceive is to make someone believe something that is not true.

words.s: When we started out, our band could only find small clubs in small cities that would hire us.
words.sz: 我們的樂隊剛起步時，只有小城市里的小俱樂部僱我們。
words.d: To hire someone is to pay that person money to work for you.

words.s: I can't believe that you were the smartest kid in your class.
words.sz: 我不敢相信你是你们班里面最聪明的孩子。
words.d: To kid is to say something that is not true as a joke.

t: 目的地， 终点， 目标
words.s: They made straight for their destination.
words.sz: 他們直奔目的地。
words.d: A destination is the place where someone or something is going.

t: 学习； 学问， 知识
words.s: I know that you are learning French at school.
words.sz: 我知道你在學校學法語。

t: 纪念碑， 纪念馆； 历史遗迹
words.s: A large monument was built to honor the brave soldiers.
words.d: A monument is a structure that is built to remind people of a person or event.

t: 使潮湿； 使沮丧； 抑制
words.s: The weather was not only cold, it was also damp.
words.sz: 天气又冷又湿。

t: 鲜艳的； 生动的， 栩栩如生的
words.s: The figures in the painting were vivid.
words.d: When something is vivid, it is bright and colorful.

t: 蜜， 蜂蜜； 甜， 甜蜜； [常用于称呼] 宝贝儿
words.s: How much honey do you want me to put in your tea?
words.sz: 你想讓我在你的茶裡放多少蜂蜜？

t: 缺口； 间隔； 差距； 缺陷
words.s: There is a small gap between the blocks of wood.
words.d: A gap is a space between two things.

words.s: "There's an apostrophe missing. It's and its are different." "I know. It was a typing error."
words.sz: “你漏写了一个撇号。it's和its是有分别的。”“我知道。是我打错了。”

words.s: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
words.sz: 我想特别强调这一点。

t: 善， 美德； 优点， 长处
words.s: My best virtue is forgiveness.
words.d: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

t: 正常的， 平常的； 正规的， 规范的
words.s: Today's even busier than normal.
words.sz: 今天比平时还忙。
words.d: A normal thing is usual and not strange.

t: 逐渐的， 渐进的； 坡度平缓的
words.s: Children learn to read at a gradual pace. They do not learn right away.
words.d: Something gradual happens slowly.

t: 出现； 合乎情理； 计算； 认为， 猜想
数字；人物；算术；体形，体态；轮廓；画像，塑像；图，图形
words.s: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
words.sz: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。

words.s: The factory melted the ore and used it to make iron products.
words.d: Ore is the raw form of rock or material from which a valuable metal is taken.

words.s: Would you mind if I shut the window? I have a slight cold.
words.sz: 你不介意我关窗吧？我有点着凉了。
words.d: If something is slight, then it is small or minor.

t: 先的， 前的； 以前的
words.s: I would like to retract my previous statement.
words.sz: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。
words.d: If something is previous, then it happened earlier in time or order.

t: 传送， 传递； 传染； 播送， 发射
words.s: The radio tower transmits a signal to all the radios in a 20-kilometer radius.
words.d: To transmit something means to pass it from one person or place to another.

words.s: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
words.sz: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
words.d: The consumption of food or drink is the act of eating or drinking it.

t: 争论，争辩，辩论；主张；说服
words.s: Tom and Mary argue with each other all the time.
words.sz: 汤姆和玛丽无时无刻不在辩论。

t: 工艺学； 工艺， 技术
words.s: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.
words.sz: 现代科学技术让我们的生活更加舒适。
words.d: Technology is new things made by using science.

t: 该死，见鬼〔表示很生气或失望〕
该死的〔表示对某人或某事物生气〕
上级的，较高的；优越的；有优越感的，高傲的
words.s: This carpet is superior to that one in quality.
words.sz: 這地毯在質量上比那箇好得多。
words.d: A superior person or thing is better than another.

t: 位置， 场所； 外景拍摄地
words.s: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
words.sz: 那個地點的書店無法賺足夠的錢生存下去。

words.s: The company's going to go bankrupt really soon.
words.sz: 公司很快就要倒闭了。
words.d: If someone is bankrupt, then they are unable to pay their debts.

t: 严守时刻的， 准时的
words.s: Compared with her sister, she isn't very punctual.
words.sz: 與她的妹妹相比，她不是很準時。
words.d: When someone is punctual, they do something or arrive at the right time.

t: 为…做广告， 宣传； 公告； 登广告
words.s: We advertise our products on TV.
words.sz: 我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。
words.d: To advertise is to describe or draw attention to a product or event by using a public medium.

t: 妥协； 危及； 放弃
words.s: We tried to come to a compromise with them.
words.sz: 我們試著和他們妥協。
words.d: To compromise is to agree to something that is not exactly what you want.

t: 解雇； 洗劫， 劫掠
words.s: It's time to hit the sack.
words.sz: 睡觉时间到了。

words.s: I'm having some problems compiling this software.
words.sz: 我编译这个程序有些困难。

words.s: How was the seminar?
words.sz: 研討會怎麼樣？

words.s: The money that John has is comparative to that of most other adults.
words.d: If something is comparative, it is being judged based on something else.

words.s: I participated in a photography competition.
words.sz: 我參加了一個攝影比賽。

words.s: If someone irritates you, it is best not to react immediately.
words.sz: 如果有人激怒你，你最好不要立刻做出反应。
words.d: To react is to respond by acting in a certain way.

words.s: I like dragon fruit.
words.sz: 我喜欢火龙果。

t: 犹豫的； 吞吞吐吐的
words.s: Although he knew the answer, he was hesitant to say it because he might be wrong.
words.d: If someone is hesitant, then they are not sure or are slow to act or speak.

t: 在…的那边，远于；迟于；越出
words.s: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
words.sz: 你看過富士山嗎?它美得無法形容。
words.d: Beyond is used to say that one thing is more than another.

t: 回授， 反馈， 反应
words.s: I asked my boss for feedback on my work.
words.d: Feedback is comments to a person about how they are doing something.

words.s: Smoking cigarettes poses many health hazards.
words.d: A hazard is something that could be dangerous to a person’s health or safety.

words.s: The end does not always justify the means.
words.sz: 為了正當目的並非總是可以不擇手段.
words.d: To justify something means to show or prove that it is necessary.

words.s: Many people attended the voluntary boat safety class.
words.d: When something is voluntary, it is done by choice but is not required.

t: 联系， 关系； 连接， 衔接； 连贯性； 熟人， 关系
words.s: The telephone operator asked the caller to hold on until a connection was made.
words.sz: 电话运营商提示来电人等候接通。

words.s: They used his fingerprint for proof that he committed the crime.
words.d: Proof is a fact that shows something is real.

t: 木材， 原木； 大木料， 栋木
words.s: Trees in this area are grown specifically to be used for timber.
words.d: Timber is wood that is used for building houses and making furniture.

t: 吼叫，怒号，咆哮；轰鸣；大声喊出，大声表示
呐喊声， 咆哮声， 吼叫声； 轰鸣
出席， 到场； 存在； 仪表， 仪态
words.s: I told you not to talk about the matter in her presence.
words.sz: 我跟你说过她在的时候不要说这件事。
words.d: Presence is when someone or something is present in a particular place.

t: 阶段； 方面； 相， 相位
words.s: Cancer can be cured easily if it is found in its first phase.
words.sz: 癌症如果在第一阶段被发现的话是很容易治愈的。
words.d: A phase is a stage in a process or the gradual development of something.

words.s: The surrounding area was very quiet.
words.sz: 周圍的地區非常安靜。

t: 效率； 功效， 效能
经常费用， 管理费用
words.s: I saw a helicopter flying overhead.
words.sz: 我看见一架直升飞机在头顶飞。
words.d: If something is overhead, it is located above you.

t: 缩小； 订合同； 感染， 染上
words.s: The contract is in the bag, so let's go out and celebrate.
words.sz: 合同已经到手了，那就出去庆祝一下吧。
words.d: A contract is a written agreement between two people.

t: 推断出， 推论出； 结束， 终了； 缔结， 议定
words.s: I saw crumbs on my dog’s face, so I concluded that he ate my cookie.
words.d: To conclude is to arrive at a logical end by looking at evidence.

t: 理解， 理解力， 领悟； 理解力测验

words.s: I'm not a beggar.
words.sz: 我不是乞丐。

words.s: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。
words.d: Leather is a material made from animal skin that is used to make clothing.

t: 梳理； 在…搜寻； 彻底搜查
words.s: Comb your hair before you go out.
words.sz: 在你出門之前，把你的頭髮梳一梳。

words.s: Since Peter was so innovative, he was chosen to lead the science team.
words.d: If something or someone is innovative, they can think in creative ways.

t: 洞察力； 洞悉； 深刻见解
words.s: The physics textbook gave the student a new insight about gravity.
words.d: Insight is a deep and accurate understanding of something.

t: 织物， 纺织品； 结构
words.s: The dress is made of a thin fabric.
words.sz: 這件衣服是由薄織物製成的。
words.d: Fabric is cloth used to make clothes, furniture, etc.

words.s: The girl was always following her mother.
words.sz: 那女孩不管到哪兒都跟著母親。

words.s: Can you explain the exact meaning of this word?
words.sz: 你能否說出這個詞的精確意思?
words.d: Exact means correct in every detail.

t: 强迫；用力推动，用力打开
军队， 兵力； 暴力， 武力； 力， 力气； 影响力， 效力
words.s: I will never force you to marry him.
words.sz: 我永遠不會逼你跟他結婚。
words.d: Force is a person’s strength or power.

words.s: Water freezes at 0 degrees Centigrade.
words.sz: 水在攝氏0度時結成冰。
words.d: If a temperature is given in centigrade, it is the same as the temperature in Celsius.

t: 性的， 两性的； 性别的
同情的； 和谐的； 赞同的， 支持的； 合意的

words.s: Trade ships only carried valuable freight like silk and spices.
words.d: Freight is a set of items carried on a train, boat, or airplane.

t: 变动； 漫游， 四处搜索； 使排列成行
一系列；范围；射程，距离；脉；射击场
words.s: We discussed a wide range of topics.
words.sz: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。
words.d: A range is a number or a set of similar things.

t: 分发， 分配； 分布

words.s: Red’s nickname was derived from the color of her hair.
words.d: To derive means to come, or originate, from a thing or place.

t: 容量； 能力， 才能； 能量； 身份， 地位
words.s: The room has a seating capacity of 200.
words.sz: 这个房间能容纳200人。
words.d: The capacity of something is the amount of things that can be put in it.

words.s: After Tom lost his job, he started to gamble to cope with his depression.
words.sz: 湯姆失業後，為了排遣鬱悶的心情而開始了賭博。
words.d: To cope with a difficult or stressful situation means to deal with it.

words.s: I'd like to make an overseas call.
words.sz: 我想打個國際電話。
words.d: Overseas shows an action happens in another country, across an ocean.

words.s: He was able to impress the girls with his new dance.
words.d: To impress someone means to make that person proud or amazed.

t: 供认， 坦白； 承认
words.s: I confess that I'm tired.
words.sz: 我承认我很累。
words.d: To confess is to admit a bad or embarrassing truth.

words.s: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
words.sz: 這場爆炸有可能是瓦斯外洩引起的。

words.s: You look like you've just seen a ghost.
words.sz: 你看起來就像見鬼了一樣。

t: 特征，特色；面貌；特写，专题节目；故事片
words.s: It isn't a bug. It's an undocumented feature.
words.sz: 这不是一个漏洞，而是一个没有写进文档的特性。
words.d: A feature is an important part of something.

words.s: Don't lean against the wall.
words.sz: 別倚著牆。
words.d: To lean is to bend in a particular direction.

t: 平直地； 直截了当地
平的；固定的；漏气的；平淡的；沉闷的；浅的
words.s: My bicycle has a flat tire.
words.sz: 我的腳踏車輪胎沒氣了。
words.d: Flat describes something that is level and smooth with no curved parts.

t: 回忆； 召回， 叫回； 收回， 撤销
words.s: I can't recall the last time we met.
words.sz: 我想不起來我們上次見面的情况了。
words.d: To recall something is to remember it.

words.s: He had to leap over the gap to reach the other side of the hill.
words.d: To leap means to jump a long distance.

words.s: This watch is waterproof.
words.sz: 這手錶是防水的。

words.s: A barber is a man who shaves and cuts men's hair.
words.sz: 理髮師是為男人刮鬍子和剪頭髮的人。
words.d: A barber is a person whose job is to cut men’s hair.

t: 精确的， 准确的； 严谨的
words.s: The precise time of their arrival is not known.
words.sz: 他們到達的確切時間還不明。
words.d: If someone is precise, then they are exact and careful about their work.

t: 明智的； 合情理的； 有知觉的
words.s: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
words.sz: 你聽從她的忠告是明智的。
words.d: A sensible person or thing is good and smart.

t: 反对， 异议； 反对的理由
words.s: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.
words.sz: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。

t: 争论， 争执； 对…表示异议
words.s: Karen and Brian often have disputes about silly things.
words.d: A dispute is an argument or disagreement that people have.

words.s: Time is the most precious thing in the world.
words.sz: 时间是世界上最宝贵的东西。
words.d: A precious thing is valuable and important.

t: 注意， 观察； 言论， 评论； 观察资料
颤抖； 摇晃， 摇动
words.s: I felt my hands tremble.
words.sz: 我感覺到我的手在震動
words.d: To tremble is to shake as a result of excitement or cold weather.

words.s: I suspect that they water down the beer in that pub.
words.sz: 我怀疑那家酒馆的啤酒兑水了。
words.d: To suspect something is to believe that it might be true.

t: 道歉， 谢罪， 认错
words.s: We apologize for the delay and regret any inconvenience it may have caused.
words.sz: 我们对这次的延迟表示抱歉，并对可能造成的不便表示遗憾。

words.s: The number of inhabitants in the countryside is increasing.
words.d: An inhabitant is a person who lives in a certain place.

t: 小部分； 片断； 分数
words.s: Only a fraction of the cake was gone.
words.d: A fraction is a small part of something.

words.s: The sunlight shines through the trees.
words.d: Sunlight is the natural light that comes from the sun.

words.s: This site is amazing!
words.sz: 這網站真好！
words.d: A site is a place.

t: 情感， 感情； 激动
words.s: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
words.sz: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。
words.d: An emotion is how you feel.

t: 大的， 大而重的； 大块的； 大量的， 大规模的
words.s: This is the most massive structure I've ever seen.
words.sz: 这是我所见过的最大型的构造了。
words.d: A massive thing is very big.

words.s: The rain will cease in the afternoon.
words.d: To cease is to stop doing something or to stop something happening.

t: 对估价； 评价， 评论
words.s: She can assess investments very accurately.
words.sz: 她能很准确地评估投资。
words.d: To assess something means to judge the structure, purpose, or quality of it.

t: 资产， 财产； 有价值的特性或技能， 优点
words.s: The coach realized the boy’s speed was an asset to the team.
words.d: An asset is a skill or quality that is useful or valuable.

t: 欠； 应把…归功于； 感激， 感恩
words.s: I owe it you that I am still alive.
words.sz: 多亏了你，我还活着。

t: 缺乏的， 不足的； 稀少的， 罕见的
words.s: When gasoline was scarce, we rode our bike to school instead of driving.
words.d: If something is scarce, then there is a very small amount of it.

words.s: What's the minimum wage in your country?
words.sz: 你的国家的最低工资是多少？
words.d: The minimum is the smallest amount.

words.s: He is a mathematical genius.
words.sz: 他是一個數學天才。

t: 道歉， 认错， 谢罪
words.s: Tom didn't accept Mary's apology.
words.sz: 汤姆不接受玛丽的道歉。
words.d: An apology is what people say to show that they are sorry.

words.s: The magician used magic to pull a rabbit out of his hat.
words.d: Magic is the power to do impossible things.

t: 争论， 辩论； 理由； 说理， 论证
words.s: After a long argument, I finally persuaded her to go camping.
words.sz: 經過長久的爭論，我終於說服了她去露營。

t: 揭露， 泄露； 展现， 显示
words.s: I will reveal where I hid the candy bar.
words.d: To reveal is to show something.

words.s: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
words.sz: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。
words.d: Data is a collection of information and facts.

words.s: His conclusion was only theoretical and not meant to be publicized.
words.d: If something is theoretical, it is based on theory rather than experience.

t: 足够的； 可以胜任的
words.s: This meal is adequate for three.
words.sz: 这饭足够三个人吃。
words.d: Something adequate is good enough.

words.s: The lost boy was so scared that he could barely utter a single word.
words.d: To utter a word or a sound means to say it.

words.s: Tom felt his phone vibrate.
words.sz: 汤姆感觉手机震荡了。
words.d: To vibrate is to shake very hard.

words.s: She can play the drum.
words.sz: 她會打鼓。

words.s: Have you ever seen sausage being made?
words.sz: 你见过灌肠的做法吗？

words.s: I feel hopeful about the future.
words.sz: 我對未來感到有希望。

t: 极大的， 非常的； 精彩的， 了不起的
words.s: The pressure was tremendous.
words.sz: 壓力很巨大。
words.d: A tremendous thing is very large or very good.

t: 冷凝， 凝结； 浓缩， 压缩， 简缩
words.s: The cool air made tiny drops of water condense on the tops of the grass.
words.d: To condense a gas means to make it a liquid.

t: 栅栏； 检票口； 屏障； 障碍， 隔阂
words.s: The Great Wall was a barrier between China and its enemies.
words.d: A barrier is something that blocks a path or way.

t: 现实的； 实际可行的； 现实主义的； 逼真的
words.s: Let's be realistic.
words.sz: 現實點吧。
words.d: When something is realistic, it is shown as it is in real life.

t: 正义， 公正； 司法
words.s: Justice will prevail in the end.
words.sz: 正义终将胜利。
words.d: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

t: 创造； 引起， 产生
words.s: She created an igloo from blocks of snow.
words.d: To create means to make something new.

words.s: His son's criminal activities caused him great pain.
words.sz: 他儿子的犯罪行为给他带来了很大的痛苦。

words.s: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?
words.sz: 我要去购物。你要跟着来吗？

words.s: Tom wrote down something in his notebook.
words.sz: 湯姆在他的筆記本上寫了東西。

words.s: "What's going on in the cave? I'm curious." "I have no idea."
words.sz: “洞里发生了什么？我很好奇。”“我一点也不知道。”
words.d: A curious person or animals wants to know about something.

words.s: He chose to take the most indirect route to the coast.
words.d: If something is indirect, then it is not the easiest or straightest way.

words.s: Each individual is responsible for themselves.
words.d: An individual is a single member of a group.

t: 资源； 财力； 应付办法， 谋略
words.s: The poor man didn’t have the resources to feed himself.
words.d: Resources are a person’s or country’s money and materials that they can use.

words.s: An ugly man knocked on my door.
words.sz: 一个丑男人敲了我的门。
words.d: Something ugly is not good to look at.

words.s: The teenager considered her noisy little brothers to be quite a nuisance.
words.d: A nuisance is a person or thing that is annoying or causes a lot of problems.

t: 对…征税； 使负担重， 使费尽力气
words.s: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.
words.sz: 他想要减少进口品的税。

words.s: A couple of flights were delayed on account of the earthquake.
words.sz: 一些航班由於地震被延誤了。
words.d: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of a part of the Earth’s surface that often causes a lot of damage.

t: 刺激， 激动， 兴奋； 令人兴奋的事， 刺激的因素
噩梦； 可怕的事物， 无法摆脱的恐惧
words.s: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
words.sz: 我覺得我好像從惡夢中驚醒。
words.d: A nightmare is a bad or scary dream.

t: 细绳， 粗线， 索； 灯芯绒裤
words.s: This extension cord is too short.
words.sz: 這條延長線太短了。

t: 结尾， 结局； 死亡
words.s: I don't want to spoil the ending for you.
words.sz: 我不想把結局提前透露給你。

t: 果实的心； 核心， 要点
words.s: Earth has a solid inner core.
words.d: A core is the main or central part of something.

words.s: You should run for city council.
words.sz: 你应该去竞选城市委员会。
words.d: A council is a group of people who run a city or town.

t: 实施， 执行； 强制， 强迫， 迫使
words.s: Police enforce traffic laws to keep everyone safe.
words.d: To enforce means to make a person follow a rule.

t: 大使馆； 大使馆全体成员
words.s: He is a diplomat at the American Embassy.
words.sz: 他是美国大使馆的外交官。

t: 离开， 起程， 出发； 背离， 违背
words.s: With the weather getting worse, the departure was put off.
words.sz: 由于天气变差，出发延迟了。
words.d: A departure is the act of leaving a place.

words.s: His record is a new world record in the 100-meter dash.
words.sz: 他刷新了百米短跑的世界紀錄。
words.d: To dash means to run or move quickly.

words.s: Looking down, we saw a concrete jungle.
words.sz: 我們往下看，是一片水泥叢林。
words.d: Concrete is a substance made from stones.

t: 处罚， 惩罚； 罚金
words.s: The death penalty had been done away with in many states in the USA.
words.sz: 死刑在美国的很多州都被废除了。

words.s: Sociology teaches that people’s problems are a result of their society.
words.d: Sociology is the study of human society, its organizations, and problems.

t: 环节， 联系， 纽带
words.s: The two lines in the poem share a common link.
words.d: A link is a connection to something else.

t: 逃走， 逃掉， 逃离； 避开， 逃避
words.s: When a predator approaches a deer, the deer will flee.
words.d: To flee is to leave somewhere very quickly in order to escape from danger.

t: 与其他不同的； 清楚的， 明显的
words.d: A distinct thing is different or stands out.

t: 大小，规模；等级，级别；天平，磅秤；比例；刻度，标度；鳞
words.s: I was surprised by the scale of the buildings in the downtown area.
words.d: The scale of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

t: 恢复， 痊愈； 追回， 寻回， 收复
words.s: There is no hope of his recovery.
words.sz: 他沒有希望痊癒了。

t: 用篱笆围； 避免直接回答
words.s: The cat got through the hedge.
words.sz: 貓從樹籬穿過去。

t: 调整， 调节； 为调音
words.s: She played a tune on the piano.
words.sz: 她在鋼琴上彈了一首曲子。

t: 哭泣， 流泪； 渗出
words.s: My mother did nothing but weep.
words.sz: 我的母亲只是默默地哭泣。

words.s: It's hard to believe that Tom wasn't aware that Mary was in love with him.
words.sz: 真难相信汤姆不知道玛丽爱他。
words.d: If someone is aware, they know that something or a situation exists.

t: 戏剧， 剧本； 戏剧性事件
words.s: They made the novel into a drama.
words.sz: 他們把這本小說變成戲劇。

t: 安全， 保障； 抵押品； 证券
words.s: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
words.sz: 德国在1880年代采取了一种社会保障制度。

t: 〔因一腿受伤而〕跛行，一瘸一拐地走
words.s: After the injury, the player limped off of the field.
words.d: To limp means to walk with difficulty because someone’s leg or foot is hurt.

t: 授予， 给予； 判给， 裁定
words.s: He got an award for having the best grades in class.
words.d: An award is a prize for doing something well.

t: 组织， 把…编组； 使有条理
words.s: I keep meaning to organize my desk.
words.sz: 我一直想整理書桌。
words.d: To organize is to plan or get ready for an event.

t: 结婚， 婚姻； 婚礼
words.s: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
words.sz: 婚前張開眼，婚後半閉眼。

words.s: A plastic dish will melt on the stove.
words.sz: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。
words.d: A stove is a device used to cook food.

words.s: It's much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.
words.sz: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。
words.d: An alarm is something that warns people of danger.

words.s: Tom said he thought that he'd be able to help Mary weed the garden today.
words.sz: 汤姆说他以为他今天能够帮玛丽的花园除草

t: 肢， 臂， 腿； 树枝
words.s: The monkey sat on the tree limb and enjoyed a piece of fruit.
words.d: A limb is a large branch on a tree.

words.s: The balloon was caught in the tree.
words.sz: 這顆氣球被樹絆住了。

t: 运动；手势，眼色，动作；提议
words.s: No one supported his motion.
words.sz: 沒人支持他的動議。
words.d: A motion is a movement that someone makes.

words.s: She read a book to keep from being idle.
words.d: If you are idle, you are not doing anything.

t: 信任， 信赖； 信心， 自信
words.s: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
words.sz: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。
words.d: Confidence is a feeling of certainty or ability.

t: 随心所欲的， 专断的
words.s: The classroom had many arbitrary rules that confused me.
words.d: If something is arbitrary, it is not based on any plan or system, so it seems random.

t: 害怕的， 可怕的； 不安的， 忧虑的
口音， 腔调； 重音
words.s: Where is the accent on the word 'Australia?'
words.sz: “Australia”这个词的重音要放在哪？
words.d: An accent is a certain way of speaking that shows where a person is from.

words.s: Watching TV is a passive activity.
words.sz: 看電視是一種被動的活動。
words.d: A passive person does not take action to solve problems.

t: 运输工具， 运载工具； 带菌者； 载重架， 置物架

words.s: After the light broke, there were fragments of glass to clean up.
words.d: A fragment is a small part of something.

t: 回答， 答复； 反应， 响应
words.s: I'm sorry for the late response.
words.sz: 我很抱歉回复晚了。
words.d: A response is the answer to a question.

t: 条约， 协议， 协定
words.s: In 1978 a peace treaty was concluded between Japan and China.
words.sz: 1978年中国和日本签署了和平条约。

t: 响应的； 敏感的， 易受影响的
挑战；邀请比赛；艰巨的任务；怀疑，质问
反对， 公然反抗； 向…挑战； 对…质疑
words.s: We accept your challenge.
words.sz: 我們接受你們的挑戰。
words.d: A challenge is something difficult to complete.

t: 散发； 发射； 发表
words.d: To emit is to send out gas, heat, light, sound, etc.

t: 竞争对手，敌手；可与匹敌的人
与 …竞争； 与…匹敌， 比得上
words.s: The three rivals were all competing for the same job.
words.d: A rival is someone trying to achieve the same thing as another.

t: 想要， 打算； 意思是； 打算使
words.s: I intend to visit Australia during my spring break.
words.sz: 我打算在春假的時候去參觀澳洲。
words.d: To intend to do something means to plan to do it.

t: 咔嚓折断，啪地绷断；吧嗒一声；猛咬；厉声说话，怒声责骂
words.s: I took the drumstick and snapped it with my hands.
words.d: To snap something means to break it suddenly, which can cause a loud noise.
